# The most stunning high jewellery collections of 2024

25 Jun 2024  |  |[By Zoe Gunn](https://luxurylondon.co.uk/writers/zoe-gunn/)

Diamonds don’t come much more decadent than this

If you’re even remotely plugged into the world of fashion you’ll know that [Haute Couture Week](https://luxurylondon.co.uk/style/hers/haute-couture-ss24-dior-valentino-fendi/), with all its jaw-dropping gowns and exquisite craftsmanship, returned to Paris this week — bringing with it, as is tradition, the latest [high jewellery collections](https://luxurylondon.co.uk/style/watches-and-jewellery/jewellery/high-jewellery-collections-2023/).

Distinct from their fine jewellery counterparts by way of elevated skill, design innovation, quality of stones and, inevitably, price tag, this is jewellery in its most esteemed and rarified form. Just like a couture gown, these are pieces most of us can only dream of adding to our jewellery boxes — but that doesn’t mean window shopping isn’t still fun. From fantastical designs from big-name houses to independent jewellers displaying their wares right here in the capital, read on for the most dazzling high jewellery collections of 2024.

## De Beers Forces of Nature

![de beer sforces of nature](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/De-Beers-Forces-of-Nature-Protection-Set-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![de beers forces of nature](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/De-Beers-Forces-of-Nature-Individuality-Set-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

As is often the case with high jewellery collections, De Beers has unveiled its new range — Forces of Nature — in two chapters across the year. Chapter One was unveiled in January 2024 and the more substantial Chapter Two following in June. The latter, a 58-piece strong collection of one-of-a-kind jewels, was presented in eight sets inspired by the native fauna of South Africa – a country close to the heart of the De Beers brand.

Building on the pieces of Chapter One, which comprised of eight exceptional [solitaire diamond rings](https://luxurylondon.co.uk/style/watches-and-jewellery/jewellery/solitaire-engagement-ring-diamond-buying-guide/), each of which can be transformed via the addition of a crown or jacket, De Beers has packed some serious jewellery-making expertise into this concise collection. In the Protection set, a lion finds form in a 5.09 carat brilliant-cut diamond surrounded by a mane of beaded gold and is joined by a statement choker designed to recreate a lion’s mane in gold beads. Representing Spirituality, a giant kudu is created via a stack of cushion-cut diamonds and pavé-set antlers and finds its horns recreated in a white gold and diamond necklace and matching ear cuffs.

![de beers](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/De-Beers-Forces-of-Nature-Giraffe-Crown-Ring-and-Lion-Jacket-Ring-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![de beers](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/De-Beers-Forces-of-Nature-Greater-Kudu-Crown-Ring-and-De-Beers-Forces-of-Nature-Leopard-Jacket-Ring-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

Elsewhere, an elephant’s trunk clutching a Fancy Pink oval diamond comes twirling from beneath a stunning 3.2 carat heart-shaped diamond symbolising Tenderness. The set is now complete with a matching diamond cuff and asymmetric cocktail ring featuring a central heart-shaped pink diamond.

“The eight featured animals are an ode to the natural intoxicating beauty of the African continent, whose earth yields jaw-dropping natural treasures,” said De Beers CEO Céline Assimon. “When designing the rings, we had no constraints: we were guided by the individual character of eight extraordinary diamonds. Their incomparable beauty challenged us to create strikingly modern, abstract interpretations of the majestic creatures that roam the environment.”

*Visit [debeers.com](https://www.debeers.co.uk/en-gb/high-jewellery/)*

## Pomellato The Dualism of Milan

![pomellato galleria necklace](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/2024-POMELLATO-HIGH-JEWELRY-COLLECTION_GALLERIA-NECKLACE-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![pomellato spinalli di fuoco necklace](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/2024-POMELLATO-HIGH-JEWELRY-COLLECTION_SPINELLI-DI-FUOCO-NECKLACE-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

Paying homage to its hometown, Pomellato’s colourful 2024 high jewellery collection draws on the dual nature of Milan. A rare high jewellery outing for the brand, only its fifth high jewellery collection since its founding in 1967, the 51-piece line is divided into two parts: Monochromatic Treasures and Colour Prism.

The former takes its cues from Milan’s quieter, more understated side, toning down the house’s signature coloured stones for simplicity and elegance rendered in white diamonds, Tahitian pearls, moonstone and grey sapphires. The latter, meanwhile, turns up the vibrance with bold cocktail rings, candy-coloured diamond pavé and gobstopper-sized cabochons in a rainbow of hues.

“First and foremost, I wanted to convey the spirit of the city, a mix of rationalist architecture, skyscrapers with their sinuous lines, the night-time atmosphere of the shopping arcades,” said Vincenzo Castaldo, creative director of Pomellato. “Then I wanted to illustrate this ability that Milan has always had to focus on colour in every creation, such as the work of Gio Ponti or the Memphis Group.”

*Visit [pomellato.com](https://pomellato.prf.hn/click/camref:1011lAW5B/destination:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.pomellato.com%2Fen_intl%2Fhigh-jewelry%2Fthematic%2Fthe-dualism-of-milan)*

## Blue Book 2024: Tiffany Céleste

![Tiffany Céleste blue book 2024](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/tiffany-blue-book-2024-necklace-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![tiffany celeste blue book 2024](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/tiffany-blue-book-2024-earrings-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

The first of three phases to be revealed throughout 2024, Tiffany's latest Blue Book high jewellery collection, Tiffany Céleste, reinterprets Jean Schlumberger's cosmos-inspired designs created for the house throughout the 1960s and '70s. Now seen through the lens of current chief artistic officer Nathalie Verdeille, the first phase features six chapters: Wings, Arrows, Constellation, Iconic Star, Ray of Light and Apollo.

The collection features both literal and abstract depictions of the stars, sun, moon, and far off galaxies, as well as taking direct design cues from famed Schlumberger designs, such as the Tiffany Trophée de Vaillance brooch. White diamond and mother-of-pearl stars add a spiky edge to statement rings and earrings, diamond wings unfurl across a showstopping necklace, and red spinels take on the task of captuirng the elusive hue of a sunbeam.

"For Blue Book 2024: Tiffany Céleste, the stars provided a new lens to rediscover the extent of Jean Schlumberger’s fantasy world,” said Verdeille. “The new collection traverses all that adorns the skies, as well as that which exists far beyond them.”

*Visit [tiffany.co.uk](https://www.tiffany.co.uk/high-jewelry/blue-book/2024-tiffany-celeste/)*

## Chaumet En Scène

![Chaumet en Scène jewellery](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/chaumet-TANGO-MIX-NECKlace-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![Chaumet en Scène high jewellery](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/chaumet-ILLUSION-MIX-NECKlace-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

Celebrating the magnetic pull of the world as seen on stage, the latest high jewellery collection from Chaumet presents pieces exuding the drama and beauty of music, dance and magic. Presented in June 2024 as a collection in three parts, the first - Music - centres around three astonishing parures alternately putting diamonds, emeralds and sapphires centre stage. Offered as sets with coordinating necklaces, rings and earrings featuring bold, graphic lines, these are classical masterpieces made material.

The movement and freedom of Dance, manwhile, sees the tango embodied in a dizzying diamond spiral necklace from which is suspended a 46 carat indicolite, while a five-piece ballet-inspired parure evokes the twirl and grace of dancers in fluid rows of diamonds and independently-moving petals set with Ceylon sapphires. Finally, the energy of swing finds form in lively, contemporary designs combining custom-cut onyx bands, white diamonds and vibrant violet sapphires.

Innovative settings and unexpected stone combinations recreate the surprise and delight of Magic. Diamonds and pearls ranging from creamy white to deep grey are pressed into the service of a trompe l'oeil-effect necklace while an optical illusion is achieved across designs in which ribbons of diamonds appear to float independently of one another.

*Visit [chaumet.com](https://www.chaumet.com/gb_en/high-jewellery)*

## Graff

![graff high jewellery diamond necklace](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Graff-Fancy-Yellow-Oval-and-Round-and-Baguette-White-Diamond-Necklace-set-in-Yellow-and-White-Gold-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![graff high jewellery ruby earrings](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Graff-Cushion-Cut-Ruby-Emerald-Cut-and-Round-White-Diamond-Earrings-set-in-White-Gold-Ruby-9-73-cts-Diamond-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

The second untitled high jewellery collection of 2024 from Graff (see below for more on the first), the British jewellery house offered up 25 new pieces inspired by the modernist architecture of Paris. As ever, the focus here is squarely on incomaprable stones. Take, for example, a mesmerising 6.02 carat kite-cut emerald set within a row of baguette-cut emeralds to create the illusion that the two stones are melting into one another.

Elsewhere, a Fancy Yellow and white diamond suite features an astonishing total of 52.25 carats of diamonds yet still appearing to remain light and wearable, while a pair of drop earrings frame four crystal-clear oval-cut diamonds with layers of diamond bands and are discreetly edged with emeralds which only become visible as the wearer moves.

*Visit [graff.com](https://www.graff.com/uk-en/high-jewellery.html)*

## David Morris Mystic Cove

![david morris mystic cove atlantis cuff](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/David-Morris-Atlantis-Cuff-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![david morris mystic cove aquissima necklace](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/David-Morris-Aquissima-Necklace-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

A high jewellery collection hailing from our own fair city, London-based jeweller David Morris looked to the captivating world of life beneath the waves for its latest showstoppers. Inspired by all manner of aquatic flora and fauna, from the saturated hues of tropical coral, to the ripple of a manta ray's wings, and the promise of adventure and discovery that lies beyond the sea, the compact collection is a showcase of some of the world's finest coloured stones.

Traditional oceanic hues find favour in the dazzling Aquissima necklace, featuring a 15.22ct flawless white diamond alongside a 9.58ct turquoise paraiba, and the Oceanica ring, in which the icy hue of a pear-cut paraiba is offset by a zig zag of purple sapphires. The Passiflora necklace, meanwhile, reworks the vibrant shades of the passion flower in a graduated array of sapphires and rubies arranged in a fishbone-structure supporting Colombian emeralds.

Pink diamonds more your thing? You'll find plenty to love in a quintet of designs combining delicate rose-coloured stones with white diamonds, rubies and pink gold. But if it's the simplicity of a white diamond that gets your heart racing, the lace-like design of the Sunrise Mist earrings is an undisputed winner.

*Visit [davidmorris.com](https://davidmorris.com/product-collection/mystic-cove/)*

## Piaget Essence of Extraleganza

![piaget high jewellery 2024](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/piaget-high-jewellery-earrings-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![piaget high jewellery 2024](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/piaget-watch-necklace-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

Marking the 150th anniversary of Swiss watch and jewellery maker Piaget, the Essence of Extraleganza collection is every bit as exuberant as its name suggests. Combining the house's masterful skill in both haute horology and exquisite jewellery making, every piece in the 96-strong collection is, in fact, a high jewellery watch, with each taking its inspiration from pieces found in the Piaget archives.

“In 2022, when we began to design the 150 year anniversary collection,” says [Stéphanie Sivrière](https://luxurylondon.co.uk/lifestyle/stephanie-sivriere-design-director-piaget-interview/), Piaget jewellery and watch artistic director, “it wasn’t about identically reproducing heritage pieces, but rather taking inspiration from them. Revisiting those values of boldness, originality and elegance that characterise this maison’s soul at the dawn of modernity.”

In practice this translates to three themes - Extraleganza, Piaget Society and When Mastery Ignites Artistry - that embody the Piaget brand. For the first think house icon the Swinging Sautoir reimagined in turquoise, malachite and yellow sapphire and hiding a pendant watch which can be detached and worn on the wrist. Piaget Society, on the other hand, is all about Piaget's bold approach to jewellery as seen in richly coloured cocktail pieces, while When Mastery Ignites Artistry puts the house's craftsmanship under the microscope across pieces that highlight intricate stone setting and masterful cuts.

*Visit [piaget.com](https://www.piaget.com/high-jewelry/essence-of-extraleganza)*

## Chanel Sport

![chanel sweater ring](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/chanel-SWEATER-RING-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![chanel graphic line ring](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/chanel-GRAPHIC-LINE-RING_CUSHION-CUT-MANDARIN-GARNET-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

The quintessential French house has come over all American with a new high jewellery collection inspired by all things pitch, track, field and court. As with most things Chanel, the line takes its cues from the eponymous designer herself, who set up a 'Sport' workshop within her Haute Couture house in 1921 - marking a revolution in practical womenswear.

And while the pieces themselves undoubtedly take their aesthetic codes from the world of sport, with their team emblems, patriotic colour combinations and stars, stripes and numbers insignia, the inspiration runs far deeper than that. In creating the collection, director of the Chanel Jewellery Creation Studio, Patrice Leguéreau, re-examined the entire design process, creating functional pieces that more closely align with the anatomical reality of the human body and featuring quick-release clasps, diamond-encrusted 'sport cords' and supple weaves of precious stones.

*Visit [chanel.com](https://www.chanel.com/gb/high-jewellery/)*

## Dior Délicat

![dior delicat](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/dior-delicat-earrings-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![dior delicat](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/dior-delicat-necklace-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

Few are the brands that possess the talent and expertise to create both couture fashion and couture jewellery — but Dior is one of them. This season, the brand pays homage to its illustrious catwalk history with Dior Délicat: a new high jewellery collection designed to hug the curves of the body like a bespoke gown.

Bringing together motifs previously seen in the house’s Galons Dior and Dearest Dior high jewellery lines, coloured stones play an integral role here. White diamonds, as elegant and light as lace, provide a backdrop against which vivid rubies, emeralds, sapphires, rubellites and tanzanites shine. With 79 pieces to choose from, those with pockets deep enough to treat themselves may well find it difficult to narrow it down to just one.

*Visit [dior.com](https://www.dior.com/en_gb/fashion/jewelry-timepieces/jewelry-line)*

## Graff

![graff high jewellery](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/graff-high-jewellery-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![graff high jewellery](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/graff-sri-lankan-sapphire-cuff-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

Unusually, British brand Graff hasn’t given its latest high jewellery collection a name. All the better to let the pieces do the talking, we suppose. And what pieces they are. Highlighting Graff’s mastery in sourcing, cutting and setting truly exceptional gemstones, every stone within the new high jewellery collection was hand-selected by a member of the Graff family and underwent a rigorous process to ensure absolute perfection.

The designs, naturally, take their cues from these natural marvels. “Each creation is bold and contemporary, featuring graphic lines while retaining a design sensibility synonymous with Graff,” explains design director Anne-Eve Geffroy. “When I was first presented with this collection of gems, it took my breath away. I knew immediately that we needed to experiment, to push the boundaries of our design language while remaining true to our stone-led design philosophy.”

The result is a bold collection that blends graphic lines with fluidity and movement. Think a necklace and earring suite which sees knotted ribbons of white diamond accented by Fancy Intense Yellow pear-shaped diamonds or the fanning feathers of a bird picked out in round-cut white diamonds. The star of the show? A truly colossal 118.17 carat cushion-cut unheated Sri Lankan sapphire set on a bangle featuring another 39.7 carats of round and baguette white diamonds. Trust us, you’ve never seen anything quite like it.

*Visit [graff.com](https://www.graff.com/uk-en/high-jewellery.html)*

## Fernando Jorge

![fernando jorge](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/fernando-jorge-fine-jewellery-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![fernando jorge](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/fernando-jorge-high-jewellery-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

While the majority of the new collections are displayed in the boutiques of the Place Vendôme – the historic home of high jewellery – for Spring 2024, Brazilian jeweller Fernando Jorge has chosen our fair capital as the place to showcase his latest line – and you’re invited. On display to the public from 22 January to 2 February 2024 at Sotheby’s New Bond Street, Jorge’s unique pieces are more daring than what we’ve come to expect from many high jewellery collections.

Pushing the boundaries of the materials we define as precious, alongside the usual diamonds, gold and coloured stones are Brazilian river pebbles, marble and fossilised amber. The overall effect is softer and more organic than classic cut-stone designs, lending each piece a show-stopping quality guaranteed to have onlookers asking ‘from where did you get that?’

*Visit [fernandojorge.co.uk](https://www.fernandojorge.co.uk/)*

## Un Air de Chaumet

![un air de chaumet](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/un-air-de-chaumet-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![un air de chaumet](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/un-air-de-chaumet-jewellery-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

Following on from 2023’s Le Jardin de Chaumet, the Parisian jewellery house continues its exploration of the natural world by turning its attention to the skies — and, specifically, the birds that populate them — with Un Air de Chaumet. Eschewing the gobstopper stones seen elsewhere, Chaumet looked to its archives, where pieces in the form of peacock feathers, hummingbirds and kingfishers, some created by Joseph Chaumet himself, provided endless inspiration.

Among the highlights are a series of transformable hair ornaments and tiaras, each of which can also be worn as a brooch. Rendered in white diamonds and white and yellow gold, on one a flight of swallows flutters in a graceful ballet, while on another a spray of majestic feathers demands to be admired. Also present on statement ear cuffs, the plumes of a bird of paradise unfurl flamboyantly and feathers ruffle as flapping wings swoop elegantly through the breeze. Pure poetry.

*Visit [chaumet.com](https://www.chaumet.com/gb_en/high-jewellery)*

## Boucheron Histoire de Style: The Power of Couture

![boucheron](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/BOUCHERON-Histoire-de-Style-The-Power-of-Couture-medailles-640x0-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

![boucheron](https://b3111158.assetcdn.net/3111158/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/BOUCHERON-Histoire-de-Style-The-Power-of-Couture-Tricot-Epaulettes-Aiguillette-512x700-c-default.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

For the fourth instalment of the house’s Histoire de Style collection, Claire Choisne, creative director of Boucheron, has looked to ceremonial dress to inspire the house’s new 24-piece high jewellery collection. Taking inspiration from the medals, embroideries and buttons traditionally found on military garb, these are translated into rock crystal and diamond to create a series of statement designs that playfully toy with the disparity between feminine and masculine traditions of ornamentation.

“I decided to deconstruct the symbols of power to reappropriate them,” explains Choisne. “This collection is designed like a precious kit that may be worn in a multitude of ways, choosing among various elements to create an individual style.” Among the standout pieces is Médailles: a choker-style necklace formed of 15 white gold, rock crystal and diamond medals and pendants representing 2,230 hours of labour. Elsewhere, Aiguillette sees a braid of white gold strung between two diamond brooches and Noeud reworks grosgrain ribbons in incredibly lifelike frosted rock crystal. The most unusual of the set, however, is undoubtedly a pair of epaulettes inspired by the 1902 diadem created for Mary de Teck, Princess of Wales. Ingeniously crafted to be worn on the shoulders or as bracelets, this is the truest expression of the magic of high jewellery.

*Visit [boucheron.com](https://www.boucheron.com/gb/high-jewelry/collections-histoire-de-style/the-power-of-couture)*

# Graff High Jewelry: From Mine to Masterpiece

By Lydia Dokko | May 12, 2026

Uncover how Graff’s high jewelry collection brings rare diamonds to life, blending heritage, innovation, and exceptional artistry in every masterpiece.

Uncover how Graff’s high jewelry collection brings rare diamonds to life, blending heritage, innovation, and exceptional artistry in every masterpiece.

Founded in 1960 by Laurence Graff, [Graff](https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/luxury/jewelry/graff) has become one of the most influential names in high jewelry, renowned for extraordinary diamonds and uncompromising craftsmanship. Unlike most high jewelry houses, Graff controls the entire journey of its gemstones, from sourcing rough diamonds to cutting, polishing, and crafting finished masterpieces.

This article explores how Graff’s vertically integrated model, access to exceptional stones, and design philosophy have shaped its position at the very top of the luxury jewelry market. From major auction results to iconic diamonds such as the Graff Pink, these examples illustrate why Graff remains synonymous with rarity, scale, and excellence.

## Key Takeaways: Graff High Jewelry

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Defining Element** | **Notable Features** |
| Founding Vision | **Founded in 1960 by Laurence Graff;** focused on rarity, scale, and exceptional diamonds |
| Vertical Integration | **Full control from mine to finished jewel;** cutting, polishing, and design handled in-house |
| Diamond Sourcing | **Access to some of the world’s largest and rarest stones;** majority stake in a rough diamond supplier |
| Design and Craftsmanship | **Ultra-precise cutting and platinum settings**; emphasis on maximizing brilliance |
| Auction Performance | **Record-setting sales and headline diamonds**; strong demand for white and colored diamonds |
| Iconic Stones | **Graff Pink and major colored diamonds;** museum-quality gemstones refined by the house |
| Ethical Standards | **Strict adherence to the Kimberley Process;** conflict-free sourcing |
| Collector Appeal | **Strong interest in rare, high‑color diamonds** and impeccably documented Graff creations, particularly pieces that showcase **craftsmanship and chromatic complexity** |

[![Graff ](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHZlcnNpb249IjEuMSIgaGVpZ2h0PSI2ODRweCIgd2lkdGg9IjY4NHB4Ij48L3N2Zz4=)](https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/luxury/jewelry/graff)  

Graff Fancy Intense Yellow Diamond and Diamond Ring

## The History of Graff High Jewelry

Laurence Graff founded Graff in London in 1960 with a singular focus on exceptional diamonds. From the outset, the house distinguished itself not through volume, but through rarity—prioritizing stones of remarkable size, color, and clarity. Over the decades, Graff expanded from a boutique jeweler into a vertically integrated high jewelry house, gaining direct access to rough diamonds and refining them in‑house to exacting standards.Today, Graff remains family‑owned and operates exclusively through private boutiques, reinforcing its positioning at the highest tier of the luxury jewelry market.

## Why Graff Jewelry Commands Exceptional Prices

Graff jewelry commands premium prices due to a combination of factors rarely unified within a single house. Central to this is Graff’s vertical integration, which allows the brand to select rough diamonds at the source and oversee every step of transformation. This approach minimizes compromise and maximizes quality control.

In addition, Graff focuses almost exclusively on stones that are rare even by high jewelry standards, including large white diamonds, Fancy Intense yellow diamonds, and some of the world’s most exceptional colored stones. Combined with limited production, intricate platinum settings, and precision cutting, these elements collectively explain Graff’s positioning within the ultra‑luxury segment.

[![Graff 18 Karat Diamond Necklace](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHZlcnNpb249IjEuMSIgaGVpZ2h0PSIxMDI1cHgiIHdpZHRoPSI2ODRweCI+PC9zdmc+)](https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/luxury/jewelry/graff)  

Graff Diamond Necklace

## Graff in the High Jewelry Landscape

Within the world of high jewelry, Graff operates alongside houses such as Cartier, Harry Winston, Van Cleef & Arpels, Bvlgari, and Tiffany & Co. What sets Graff apart, however, is its consistent focus on exceptional gemstone size, rarity, and diamond‑driven design. Rather than balancing accessibility with high jewelry production, Graff positions itself firmly at the uppermost tier of the market.

## Graff Diamonds and Craftsmanship

At the core of Graff’s identity is its vertically integrated approach to diamond sourcing and craftsmanship. The house maintains direct access to rough diamonds and oversees cutting, polishing, and setting in‑house, allowing for exceptional control over proportion, light performance, and finish.

This philosophy is evident in signature creations such as Graff diamond rings, which are typically centered on diamonds of three carats or larger and mounted in streamlined platinum settings. The focus remains on maximizing brilliance and clarity rather than decorative complexity. This restraint allows individual stones to serve as the primary design element, reinforcing Graff’s reputation for gem‑first high jewelry.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Graff High Jewelry

### What makes Graff different from other high jewelry houses?

Graff stands apart through its vertically integrated model, overseeing every stage of a diamond’s journey from rough stone to finished masterpiece. This level of control allows for unmatched quality, precision, and exclusivity.

### Why are Graff diamonds so expensive?

Graff diamonds command premium prices due to their exceptional size, color, and clarity, combined with meticulous cutting and craftsmanship. Many pieces feature stones that are rare even by high jewelry standards, driving both retail and auction value.

### Does Graff high jewelry hold value on the secondary market?

Exceptional Graff pieces featuring large white diamonds or rare colored stones have shown consistent demand on the secondary market, particularly when accompanied by strong provenance and documentation. While value performance varies by piece, scale and gemstone quality are key drivers of long‑term collector interest.

### Are Graff diamonds ethically sourced?

Graff adheres to the Kimberley Process and maintains strict conflict‑free sourcing standards. Ethical sourcing and transparency are integral to the brand’s operations, an important consideration for high jewelry collectors acquiring pieces at the top end of the market.

args.summary:
This Sotheby's article (published May 12, 2026, by Lydia Dokko, Sotheby's Marketplace Jewelry Merchandising Manager) explores Graff High Jewelry, tracing the house from mine to masterpiece. Graff was founded in London in 1960 by Laurence Graff, and has become one of the most influential names in high jewelry, renowned for extraordinary diamonds and uncompromising craftsmanship. Unlike most high jewelry houses, Graff is vertically integrated, controlling the entire journey of its gemstones—from sourcing rough diamonds to cutting, polishing, and crafting finished pieces in-house. Graff remains family-owned and operates exclusively through private boutiques.

Key differentiators include: access to some of the world's largest and rarest stones (including a majority stake in a rough diamond supplier), ultra-precise cutting and platinum settings, focus on maximizing brilliance, strict adherence to the Kimberley Process for ethical sourcing, and collector appeal driven by rare high-color diamonds. Within the high jewelry landscape, Graff operates alongside Cartier, Harry Winston, Van Cleef & Arpels, Bvlgari, and Tiffany & Co., but positions itself firmly at the uppermost tier, focusing on gemstone size and rarity rather than decorative excess.

Notable auction results featured:
- Emerald and Diamond Pendant Necklace, 3.10 carats: sold for 1.7M HKD (approx. $210K) in September 2025
- Fancy Intense Yellow Diamond and Diamond Necklace, 38.45 carats: sold for 3.8M HKD (approx. $490K) in April 2025, featuring thirty cut-cornered rectangular Fancy Intense Yellow diamonds with thirty accompanying GIA reports
- Diamond Pendant-Earrings, 9.39 and 8.46 carats: sold for $780K USD in February 2025
- Emerald and Diamond Pendant-Earclips, 26.19 and 15.83 carats: sold for $902K USD in June 2025, set with sugarloaf cabochon emeralds
- Graff Diamond Necklace of graduated pear-shaped and baguette diamonds: achieved approximately 4.5M HKD in September 2025
- Coloured Diamond and Diamond Ring (bombé pavé, multicolored diamonds): featured in the Fine Jewelry sale in Geneva closing May 14, 2026, accompanied by ten GIA reports confirming Fancy Intense Blue, Fancy Purple, Fancy Vivid Yellow, and Fancy Intense Pink diamonds

The article also addresses why Graff jewelry commands premium prices (vertical integration, rarity of stones, limited production, precision craftsmanship) and answers FAQs on what makes Graff different, value retention on the secondary market, and ethical sourcing. Sotheby's promotes buying and selling Graff pieces through its auctions and Buy Now marketplace, with pieces ranging from approximately $10,000 (white gold and diamond necklaces) to over $1,000,000 (extraordinary diamond rings), available in New York, Paris, and Hong Kong. The article includes a shop section featuring Graff pieces from $4,000 (eternity band ring) to $245,000 (8.50ct emerald cut engagement ring), plus a list of upcoming Sotheby's jewelry auctions through late 2026.

args.summary:
This webpage is the official Graff (Graff Diamonds) international website homepage. Graff is a luxury jewellery and watch house, and the page serves as a navigation hub showcasing its collections, news, and brand offerings.

Key collections featured on the page include: Laurence Graff Signature, Butterfly, Wild Flower, Tilda's Bow, Classic Graff, Icon, Spiral, Foufou, Threads, Be Together, and Follow Me. The page also showcases bridal/engagement ring collections including: Promise, Paragon, Flame, Icon, Constellation, Legacy, and Laurence Graff Signature.

The "Latest News" section highlights numerous news stories and updates from the House of Graff, with featured imagery and items including:
- The acquisition of notable rough diamonds (including the 709-carat Peace Diamond, the Lesedi La Rona, the 13.33ct Lesotho Pink, the Meya Prosperity rough diamond, and a 373-carat rough diamond)
- New store openings in Osaka Shinsaibashi, Japan, and Ginza, Japan, as well as boutiques in Bal Harbour, Paris Rue Saint-Honoré, and Paris Place Vendôme
- High jewellery pieces including a Fancy Vivid Pink pear-shape diamond ring, a 33.40-carat emerald cut diamond bracelet, and various yellow diamond high jewellery items
- Watch collections including the GyroGraff Endangered Species 48mm men's watch (Panda Dial) and GyroGraff Futuristic Drive watch
- Community/social responsibility initiatives including the Graff Leadership Centre and the Graff FACET foundation
- Collections inspired by Twombly and the Foliage Collection

The page also includes a newsletter signup, location selector (North America, Europe, Asia, Middle East, Rest of the World), and links to client services, boutique visits, and social channels including WeChat.

# Haute Couture 2025: Stepping Inside ‘Caroline’s Universe’ with the Chopard Red Carpet Collection

August 13, 2025

7 min read

*The Red Carpet Collection has become something of an institution at Chopard, representing its ties to the glitz and glamour of celebrity events, especially the Cannes Film Festival. This year, the maison launched its new Red Carpet jewels – neatly named 'Caroline's Universe' - at the 78th Cannes Film Festival before bringing the pieces to Paris Haute Couture Week for a day of private appointments and viewings. Of course, we were there! Let's take a closer look at some of Caroline Scheufele's latest colourful adornments, including our 10 favourite pieces.*

As is so often the case, it is the spirit of an artistic director that informs the soul of a maison's output. Nowhere is this truer than at Chopard, which is creatively led by Caroline Scheufele and her joyful, uplifting and glamorous approach to fine and high jewellery. The first glimpses of the 2025 Red Carpet Collection, named 'Caroline's Universe', were provided at the 78th annual [Cannes International Film Festival in May 2025](https://www.katerinaperez.com/articles/best-cannes-jewellery). You will no doubt be aware that Chopard has been the Festival's official partner and artisan of the Palme d'Or since 1998, so it's able to make a big splash at the many high-profile events that make up the Cannes calendar.

![A trio of high jewellery creations from the Chopard Caroline's Universe Red Carpet Collection 2025, including a jewellery watch (left) with 7.68 carats of round-cut garnets, 2.97 carats of pink spinels, 1.14 carats of multi-coloured sapphires, tsavorites, emeralds and yellow diamond brilliants, set in 18k white gold and titanium](/_ipx/w_972&f_webp&q_90/https://api.katerinaperez.com/wp-content/uploads/Chopard-2.jpg)

Like in previous iterations, the latest Red Carpet Collection is composed of exactly 78 pieces, reflecting the number of years the Cannes Film Festival has been in existence. Of the pieces we've seen, none are diminutive. They're vibrant, colourful, dynamic, and infused with fun, whimsical touches, like cute three-dimensional animals gathered around carved jade and jumbo pearls. Rather than focusing on one of Caroline Scheufele's passions, like cinema or art, this year's suite of high jewels is more personal, acknowledging the animals, flowers, couture clothing, gems, cosmic inspirations and heartfelt moments that shape her internal world. Caroline says: "Each piece of jewellery is a stage; each precious stone tells a story in which the art of jewellery reflects both my personal journey and universal emotion."

## Chopard Red Carpet Collection 2025: 'Caroline's Universe'

This article by Sarah Jordan, published on KaterinaPerez.com (August 13, 2025), covers Chopard's 2025 Red Carpet Collection, named 'Caroline's Universe', which was launched at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in May 2025 and later presented at Paris Haute Couture Week for private appointments and viewings.

**Key Facts:**
- The collection comprises exactly **78 pieces**, reflecting the number of years the Cannes Film Festival has been in existence
- Chopard has been the Cannes Film Festival's official partner and artisan of the Palme d'Or since 1998
- The collection is creatively led by Chopard's artistic director **Caroline Scheufele**
- The collection is more personal than previous iterations, acknowledging the animals, flowers, couture clothing, gems, cosmic inspirations and heartfelt moments that shape Scheufele's internal world

**Main Themes of the Collection:**
1. **Animals** – Building on Chopard's 2010 Animal World High Jewellery collection (150 pieces for the maison's 150th anniversary), the 2025 collection features dogs, owls, dolphins, parrots, cats, peacocks, penguins, foxes and pandas in fully paved jewels, especially rings. Highlight pieces include a hippopotamus ring (17.38 carats of grey diamonds, garnets and onyx in 18k white gold), a parrot ring, an owl ring with a 16.08-carat heart-shaped rubellite, a penguin ring with a 30.91-carat South Sea pearl, a peacock ring with a 15.71-carat black opal cabochon, and a red panda ring.
2. **Flowers** – Rose-inspired brooches in pink and black versions with titanium petals, plus flower earrings with over 18 carats of white opal cabochons, heart-shaped pink sapphires, and multi-coloured sapphires in titanium.
3. **Couture** – Precious materials, attention to detail, and handcrafted precision, with a touch more edge than previous collections. Includes a jewellery timepiece with a portrait-cut diamond dial, a choker with a 158.67-carat pinkish-red ruby cabochon surrounded by diamonds in vines of titanium and 18k white gold (described as having a "Disney Villain vibe").
4. **Coloured gemstones** – The collection is fuelled by colour, shape, and contrasting cuts, including a ring with a 29.76-carat emerald-cut tanzanite, emerald pieces, and the star piece: a necklace with a **129-carat emerald cabochon** surrounded by 28.85 carats of pear-shaped diamonds and 21.56 carats of brilliant-cut diamonds.

**Top 10 Favourites** (as selected by the author) include the hippopotamus ring, a pendant necklace with amethysts and tanzanite, flower earrings, a jewellery watch with garnet petals, a choker with the 158.67-carat ruby cabochon, a tanzanite ring, emerald earrings with yellow diamonds, a jewellery watch with pear-shaped emeralds, and the 129-carat emerald cabochon necklace.

**Additional Highlights:**
- Remaining 68 creations include briolette-cut pink sapphire jewels, heart-shaped creations in lightweight aluminium, and night sky-inspired pieces like a black panther pendant lounging in a crescent moon
- Chopard also debuted a new campaign with model Bella Hadid at Paris Haute Couture Week
- The author notes that "Caroline's universe... never sleeps"

**Author:** Sarah Jordan, a specialist in content writing and branded storytelling for clients including De Beers Jewellery, Sotheby's, the Natural Diamond Council and Gem-A, and founder of The William Agency.

# RED CARPET COLLECTION 2025

## 'Caroline's Universe'

Flowers and animals. Couture and gems. The cosmos and the heart. Drawing inspiration from these themes, the Red Carpet Collection 'Caroline's Universe' paints a delicate portrait of the personality of the Maison's artistic director, Caroline Scheufele.

![](https://objects-prod.cdn.chopard.com/q_auto,f_auto,dpr_auto/q_auto,f_auto,dpr_auto,c_fill,ar_9:16/Campaigns/red-carpet-2025/B_130081-1001_Making_of_1_CITATION_1920x1080)

> “This collection is designed for actresses and allows them to choose daring pieces of jewellery that will make them sparkle on the red carpet."

Caroline Scheufele

Creativity

## A visionary approach

Among the 78 pieces in the collection is a watch encircled by openwork diamond lace and crowned with a portrait-cut diamond in place of the crystal. Another creation sees Byron, Caroline Scheufele's Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, leaping through a strikingly realistic ring composed of white, black, and cognac diamonds, while a captivating 129-carat cabochon emerald takes centre stage on a diamond choker.

![](https://objects-prod.cdn.chopard.com/q_auto,f_auto,dpr_auto/ar_0.67,w_700,c_fill/Campaigns/red-carpet-2025/Red_Carpet_Bague_Byron_82A520-1001_v1_xm2)

Craftsmanship

## Unparalleled expertise

Year after year, the jewellers at the Haute Joaillerie workshops, led by Caroline Scheufele, accomplish the remarkable challenge of making as many pieces of jewellery as there have been years of the Cannes Film Festival, of which Chopard is an Official Partner. A true combination of talent, resulting in masterpieces destined to dazzle on legendary actresses.

args.summary: This is the Chopard official website (US region) page for the Red Carpet Collection 2025, titled "Caroline's Universe." The collection is a high jewelry line inspired by flowers, animals, couture, gems, the cosmos, and the heart, reflecting the personality of the Maison's artistic director, Caroline Scheufele. The collection comprises 78 pieces, including a watch encircled by openwork diamond lace crowned with a portrait-cut diamond in place of the crystal, a realistic ring featuring Byron (Scheufele's Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) made from white, black, and cognac diamonds, and a 129-carat cabochon emerald diamond choker. Each year, Chopard's Haute Joaillerie workshops create as many jewelry pieces as there have been years of the Cannes Film Festival, of which Chopard is an Official Partner. The page also includes a full site navigation structure covering Chopard's watch collections (Happy Sport, Alpine Eagle, L'Heure du Diamant, Mille Miglia, L.U.C, Happy Diamonds, IMPERIALE, plus exceptional watches), jewelry collections (Happy Hearts, Ice Cube, Happy Diamonds, L'Heure du Diamant, Precious Lace, and high jewelry lines like Precious Lace, Animal World, The Queen of Kalahari, Caroline's Dreams, and Insofu), women's and men's accessories, gift selections, La Maison history, sustainability initiatives, and services (warranty extension, boutique finder, appointment booking, order tracking). The page also features links to other high jewelry collections and customer service options, with the site available across multiple regions (Canada, US, Australia, Hong Kong, New Zealand, UK, Saudi Arabia, UAE).
args.key_excerpts: "This collection is designed for actresses and allows them to choose daring pieces of jewellery that will make them sparkle on the red carpet." - Caroline Scheufele, "Among the 78 pieces in the collection is a watch encircled by openwork diamond lace and crowned with a portrait-cut diamond in place of the crystal.", "Another creation sees Byron, Caroline Scheufele's Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, leaping through a strikingly realistic ring composed of white, black, and cognac diamonds, while a captivating 129-carat cabochon emerald takes centre stage on a diamond choker.", "Year after year, the jewellers at the Haute Joaillerie workshops, led by Caroline Scheufele, accomplish the remarkable challenge of making as many pieces of jewellery as there have been years of the Cannes Film Festival, of which Chopard is an Official Partner."

This webpage is the official Chopard (luxury Swiss watch and jewelry maison) website for the US market, featuring the RED CARPET COLLECTION 2023 high jewelry showcase.

**Main Content - Red Carpet Collection 2023:**
Chopard's artistic director Caroline Scheufele chose "Art" as the theme for the 2023 Red Carpet Collection, celebrating 76 new Haute Joaillerie creations across various art forms:
- **Literature:** A diamond and sapphire jewelry set with feather-light volutes, crafted as earrings and a brooch.
- **Cinema:** A moon pendant evoking the 7th Art (film), symbolizing darkness needed to appreciate cinema's emotions.
- **Performing Arts:** A necklace and earrings set with diamond corollas evoking ballet tutus (inspired by Scheufele's passion for dance).
- **Music:** An ethical white gold choker with briolette-cut diamonds tracing the lines of a musical score.
- **Painting:** A butterfly ring with color play symbolizing the ephemeral nature of life.
- **Sculpture:** A ring featuring an over 127-carat yellow sapphire upheld by antique-style gold sculptures.
- **Architecture:** A necklace of tinted titanium and tanzanites (including a pear-shaped gem over 32 carats) showcasing symmetry and proportion.

**Website Navigation Overview:**
The site features extensive product categories including watches (Happy Sport, Alpine Eagle, L'Heure du Diamant, Mille Miglia, L.U.C, Happy Diamonds, IMPERIALE, Grand Complications, Métiers d'art, Poinçon de Genève, High Jewelry watches), jewelry (Happy Hearts, Ice Cube, Happy Diamonds, Precious Lace, L'Heure du Diamant), accessories (fragrances, bags, sunglasses, scarves, writing instruments, clocks), and high jewelry collections (Precious Lace, Animal World, Queen of Kalahari, Caroline's Dreams, Insofu, Red Carpet).

Key highlights featured in navigation include: Watches & Wonders 2026 novelties (including the L.U.C Strike One Titanium and L.U.C Grand Strike), The Beehive Table Clock, Cannes Film Festival 2026, Chopard x Bella Hadid collaboration, Hôtel 1 Place Vendôme, sustainability initiatives ("A Journey to Sustainable Luxury"), Mille Miglia car race partnership, and gift selections.

Customer services include complimentary shipping & returns, secure payments, wishlist, registration, product requests, and "get notified" back-in-stock alerts.

The collection features a wide range of animal-themed rings (owl, parrot, penguin, red panda, hippopotamus, peacock, panda, Cavalier King Charles dogs named "Byron"), star-themed jewelry, heart motifs, and nature-inspired pieces (dolphin bracelet, rose brooch, flower brooches).

Key pieces highlighted include: a 129-carat emerald cabochon necklace; a tanzanite bead choker (599.50 cts); a snake necklace with over 87 carats of diamonds; jewelry watches set with pear-shaped rubies (56.19 cts), emeralds (38.99 cts), and diamonds; a 29.73-carat Paraiba tourmaline ring; and a 29.76-carat emerald-cut tanzanite ring. The collection emphasizes ethical 18-carat gold (white, yellow, and rose) as the primary material, often combined with titanium and aluminum. Many pieces feature onyx cabochon eyes on animal designs and a recurring star and moon motif. The article presents detailed photos with carat weights and gemstone specifications for each piece.
args.key_excerpts: Chopard unveils a new high jewelry collection every year during the Cannes Film Festival. The 2025 edition did not disappoint.

![](https://www.buccellati.com/media/.renditions/wysiwyg/2_SP_Serenissima.jpg?format=webp&quality=80)
![](https://www.buccellati.com/media/.renditions/wysiwyg/2_SP_Serenissima.jpg?format=webp&quality=80)

Buccellati proudly unveils its new high jewellery advertising campaign for the latest launched Serenissima collection. The visual narrative is brought to life through the lens of Nathaniel Goldberg, a renowned photographer celebrated for his sophisticated style. Further enriching the campaign is the protagonist of the shots: Argentine designer and artist Conie Vallese, that perfectly embodies the modern woman Buccellati seeks to portray.

This campaign elevates high jewellery to a profound form of artistic expression, articulating a vision of modern femininity that is both instinctive and expressive, perfectly aligning with the Maison's essence.The campaign unfolds through iconic black and white studio portraits, highlighting the transparency, lightness, and flexibility of the Serenissima creations, and capturing the meticolous craftsmanship that defines them.

## ABOUT THE COLLECTION

"With Serenissima, we wanted to capture the soul of Venice, its magic, and its millennia-old history. Each jewel is a fragment of this extraordinary city, a tribute to its light, its art that has shaped entire eras, and its ability to enchant. It is a dialogue between our goldsmithing tradition and the eternal beauty of Venice, an expression of our passion for excellence and art that merges with the splendor of the Serenissima Republic." - Andrea Buccellati

Inspired by the refined tradition of lace-making, masterfully blending Buccellati’s centuries-old artisanal heritage, this collection is a heartfelt tribute to the eternal charm of the lagoon city.The collection's name itself evokes the glorious Republic of Venice: a time of unparalleled artistic and cultural splendour. It is precisely in this city, and particularly in Burano, that one of the deepest inspirations for Buccellati’s distinctive style originates. From the outset, Mario Buccellati was captivated by the delicate needle lace of Burano, aspiring to translate its lightness, transparency, and elegance into his exquisite jewellery designs.

The Serenissima collection stands as the ultimate expression of these stylistic elements, with every creation aspiring to the meticulous elegance of Venetian lace. Each detail is meticulously crafted using Renaissance techniques proudly preserved by the Maison: tiny, sculpted leaves crafted with the "modellato" engraving technique, mirror-polished settings achieved through "colpi di lucido", and invisible details enriched by the delicate "rigato" engraving technique.

<webpage_content>
# 卡地亞、寶格麗、路易威登、Dior…… 2025高級珠寶系列全精華!

By [Ming Liu](/author/ming-liu)Translated and Adapted by [Chat Hsu](/author/chat-hsu)和[Vanessa Lee](/author/vanessa-lee)

Courtesy of Louis Vuitton

在過去兩個月到巴黎高級訂製週（Couture Week）期間，全球最具歷史底蘊的珠寶品牌，紛紛選在如京都和馬略卡島等夢幻場地發表新一季的高級珠寶系列。在當前奢侈品市場略顯低迷的時刻，高級珠寶反倒成為最閃耀的亮點(就連[Richemont集團第二季業績都顯示，珠寶銷售支撐了集團成長)](https://www.vogue.com.tw/article/vogue-business-richemont%E9%9B%86%E5%9C%98%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E5%AD%A3%E6%A5%AD%E7%B8%BE%E7%8F%A0%E5%AF%B6%E9%8A%B7%E5%94%AE%E6%94%AF%E6%92%90%E9%9B%86%E5%9C%98%E6%88%90%E9%95%B7)，憑藉稀有寶石與貴金屬帶來的內在價值，市場需求不減反增，催生出一件件令人驚艷的創作。以下是Vogue整理當前最值得關注的幾大趨勢：

## **非典型寶石**

在蒐藏鑽石、紅寶石、藍寶石與祖母綠等四大貴重寶石多年後，珠寶鑑賞家們開始尋求更多驚喜與變化，轉向色彩繽紛、極具特色的非典型寶石。儘管這些寶石被稱為「非典型寶石」，設計卻絲毫不遜於傳統珠寶，反而流露出一種奔放奢華的美感。

引領潮流的品牌Piaget擅長運用鮮豔硬寶石，融合了六十年代搖擺樂（Swing music）的韻味，Piaget今年在巴塞隆納發表的Shapes of Extraleganza高級珠寶系列，向普普藝術與孟菲斯風格致敬，透過一對由環環相扣的隕石、綠玉髓與鑽石製成的幾何耳環來展現；萬花筒燈項鍊則以藍寶石、碧玉、綠帷石、綠松石、方鈉石、紫鋰輝石、葡萄石、紅紋石、紅寶石母岩、紅鋅礦與鑽石組成，打造出一場色彩盛宴。

Louis Vuitton是高級珠寶界的後起之秀，卻持續帶來令人驚豔的作品。最新Savoir項鍊以一顆30.56克拉的澳洲三角切割黑蛋白石為主石，  V型設計搭配品牌所珍視的行李箱風格，與翡翠珠點綴；同為LVMH旗下的Tiffany & Co則以海洋為靈感，以意想不到的寶石——鮮豔的藍銅鋰電氣石、鋯石、紫藍寶石與月光石，構築出如夢似幻的海底色調。

卡地亞的Motu戒指。

路易威登的Joy項鏈。

繼續閱讀

[路易威登Louis Vuitton年度Virtuosity頂級珠寶系列的化境之境　左逢傳統，右面創新](/article/路易威登louis-vuitton年度virtuosity頂級珠寶系列)

By [Chat Hsu](/author/chat-hsu)

深受Kendall Jenner與Beyoncé喜愛的巴黎品牌Messika，在新作Terres d’Instinct系列中首度使用彩色寶石，酷感十足的Hypnotic戒指，以兩顆梨形寶石 —— 鑽石與尖晶石，總重8.03克拉，呈現出納米比亞卡拉哈里沙漠迷人的金黃色調。

Cartier全新En Équilibre高級珠寶系列以令人驚艷的彩色寶石為特色，例如華麗的Motu戒指選用碧璽、綠松石、綠玉髓與鑽石；Bullio戒指則融合紅鋰輝石、祖母綠、縞瑪瑙與鑽石；最後，Graff 1963高級珠寶系列則以璀璨奪目的同心圓鑽石點綴，每個同心圓環都環繞著一顆璀璨的鑽石，將目光吸引到一個無限延伸、近乎迷幻的圓環上，邊緣則以品牌標誌性的翡翠鋪鑲，低調卻一眼識別。

## **花園頌歌**

大自然一直是珠寶創作靈感的泉源，今年幾乎所有品牌都寫下一封熱烈情書，獻給那片鬱鬱蔥蔥的花園。

Dior將目光投向南法普羅旺斯的墨山城堡 (Chteau de La Colle Noire)，克里斯汀·迪奧 (Christian Dior)本人在1950 年買下這片124英畝的土地。在墨山城堡，模特兒俯瞰盛開著玫瑰、藤蔓、茉莉和鈴蘭花的花園，身披Maria Grazia Chiuri設計的奢華天鵝絨服裝，與迪奧珠寶藝術總監Victoire de Castellane的高級珠寶相得益彰，她形容：「天鵝絨是珠寶、鑽石與寶石的最佳布料，有著皇室般的氛圍。」這些珠寶以花束與盛會為靈感，呈現宛如一幅迷人的風景畫：一枚粉漆小鹿懷抱在盛開花海中，包括白、黃鑽、祖母綠、粉紅藍寶、尖晶石、沙弗萊石與綠松石，點綴橢圓馬眼形鑽石，夢幻至極。

Chaumet的新作恰如其分地命名為Jewels by Nature，選在西班牙馬貝拉海濱田園如詩般亮相，靈感來自木蘭花、大理花、田野繁星、三葉草與蕨類交相輝映，彷彿由植物學家之眼細緻描繪，將所有細節體現在精美的珠寶中。同時，Anna Hu將自然主題與獨特的中國美學融為一體，設計出Orchid Minuet手繪蘭花胸針與蝴蝶作品。她現居摩納哥，代表作La Rose Gracieuse胸針向葛麗絲王妃致敬，以尖晶石、紅寶石、棕色鑽石、祖母綠與鑽石展現宛如真實花瓣般的生命之美。

Boucheron Composition N°3。

Dior 的 Diorexquise 系列。

David Morris新作靈感來自義大利宮殿的修剪花園，一枚戒指以 6.21 克拉橘粉鑽為主石，搭配黃鑽肩石；日本珍珠品牌Tasaki 的Éveil de la nature（自然之夜）則是一場綠寶石的純粹頌歌，致敬自然純粹之美的和諧。

今年的高級珠寶系列無疑體現了對自然本源的回歸，以及對平衡與均衡的追求。Cartier特別選擇斯德哥爾摩田園詩般的森林——位於斯德哥爾摩群島韋姆德島 (Värmdö) 的阿蒂佩拉格博物館 (Artipelag museum) ，發布En Équilibre系列；寶詩龍 (Boucheron)則以Impermanence為題，創作出六個主題共 28 件作品，並命名為“無常”。藝術總監Claire Choisne表示：「我想捕捉自然轉瞬即逝的美……從光到影，這六個構圖描繪了大自然的短暫，記錄那最珍貴的一刻，這個系列是對那脆弱瞬間的頌歌，而我希望將其永恆地凝固。」其中一件作品Composition N°5以日本插花藝術為靈感，正如作品 N°5中所體現的那樣——一顆鑽石、白金和陶瓷薊寶石和配套的甲蟲套裝，放置在可作為展示的陶瓷花瓶中，詩意十足。

## **多變設計**

隨著高級珠寶的實用需求日益提升，「可變換佩戴方式」設計越來越受歡迎。從傳統可變換為胸針或冠冕的項鍊，演進至如今能輕鬆轉換成項鍊、手鍊甚至腰鍊的多功珠寶——精心設計的珠寶比以往任何時候都更具想像力、更易於佩戴、更現代。。

Chanel Reach for the Stars高級珠寶系列選在京都寧靜的氛圍中亮相，帶來多件可自由變換造型的設計，可以根據不同場合放大或縮小，該系列的傑作Wings of Chanel（香奈兒之翼）長項鍊鑲嵌一顆19.55克拉 Padparadscha的帕帕拉恰藍寶石，可作短項鍊、手鍊或垂墜背鍊佩戴。

香奈兒的Reach for the Stars高級珠寶系列。

Dior在普羅旺斯盡情展現了多變的風格，除了綴滿精美裝飾的腰帶和腳鍊，同時推出一款名為Rouge Premier的珠寶唇膏，唇膏被封裝在用作吊墜的盒子中，外殼飾滿寶石小花，並可作為吊墜佩戴。

一個月後，Pomellato選在米蘭標誌性的畫廊Pinacoteca di Brera舉辦Collezione 1967系列晚宴，這座歷史悠久的建築被品牌用於舉辦宴會，出席嘉賓包括America Ferrera和Laetitia Castacaro。主題聚焦品牌三個重要年代，其中Precious Spring戒指以鑽石鋪鑲鍊條與皮革組合，可轉換成腰鍊、墜飾或手環。

如你所見，2025秋冬高級珠寶系列不僅回歸自然，也在創新、平衡與多變性上激盪無限靈感。在這個浮華年代中，這些珠寶正試圖抓住轉瞬即逝的永恆之美。

args.summary:
This Vogue article (translated and adapted from Vogue British) provides a comprehensive overview of the 2025 Autumn/Winter high jewelry collections from major global luxury brands, presented during and around Paris Couture Week. Despite a sluggish luxury market, high jewelry has become a standout category—even Richemont Group's second-quarter results showed jewelry sales supporting group growth. The article organizes the collections into three key trends:

**1. Atypical Gemstones**: Jewelry connoisseurs are moving beyond traditional diamonds, rubies, sapphires, and emeralds toward colorful, distinctive stones. Highlights include:
- Piaget's "Shapes of Extraleganza" series (presented in Barcelona), paying tribute to Pop Art and Memphis style, featuring a kaleidoscope necklace made from sapphires, jasper, turquoise, sodalite, kunzite, prehnite, rhodonite, and more.
- Louis Vuitton's "Savoir" necklace featuring a 30.56-carat Australian black opal as the centerpiece.
- Tiffany & Co's ocean-inspired collection using cupro-edenite, zircon, violet sapphires, and moonstones.
- Cartier's "En Équilibre" series with the Motu ring (tourmaline, turquoise, chrysoprase, diamonds) and Bullio ring (red spodumene, emerald, onyx, diamonds).
- Messika's "Terres d'Instinct" collection, its first use of colored gemstones, with the Hypnotic ring featuring two pear-shaped stones totaling 8.03 carats.
- Graff's "1963" collection with concentric diamond circles.

**2. Ode to the Garden**: Nearly all brands drew inspiration from nature and gardens:
- Dior's collection at Château de La Colle Noire in Provence (Christian Dior's 124-acre estate purchased in 1950), featuring jewelry by Victoire de Castellane paired with Maria Grazia Chiuri's velvet designs. de Castellane noted: "Velvet is the best fabric for jewelry, diamonds, and gemstones, with a royal atmosphere."
- Chaumet's "Jewels by Nature" presented in Marbella, Spain, inspired by magnolias, dahlias, clover, and ferns.
- Anna Hu's orchid and butterfly pieces blending natural themes with Chinese aesthetics, including the "La Rose Gracieuse" brooch honoring Princess Grace.
- Boucheron's "Impermanence" collection (28 pieces across six themes), with creative director Claire Choisne stating: "I wanted to capture nature's fleeting beauty... this collection is an ode to those fragile moments, and I want to freeze them forever." Composition N°5 was inspired by Japanese ikebana flower arranging.
- Cartier's "En Équilibre" launched at the Artipelag museum on Värmdö island in Stockholm.
- David Morris's ring featuring a 6.21-carat orange-pink diamond, and Tasaki's emerald-focused "Éveil de la nature."

**3. Transformable/Versatile Designs**: Multi-wear jewelry is increasingly popular:
- Chanel's "Reach for the Stars" collection (presented in Kyoto) features the "Wings of Chanel" long necklace with a 19.55-carat Padparadscha sapphire that can be worn as a short necklace, bracelet, or draped back necklace.
- Dior's "Rouge Premier" jewelry lipstick, encased in a pendant box decorated with gemstone flowers.
- Pomellato's "Collezione 1967" dinner at Milan's Pinacoteca di Brera (attended by America Ferrera), with the Precious Spring ring convertible into a waist chain, pendant, or bracelet.
- Van Cleef & Arpels' "Fleurs d'Hawaï" collection (debuting at Dumfries House in Scotland), featuring a flower-shaped secret watch in citrine, rose garnet, or aquamarine surrounded by 12 pear-shaped stones, wearable as a bracelet, clip, or pendant.

BOUCHERON, CHAUMET

# 看懂2025高級珠寶趨勢！看自然中的脆弱與野性

解析Boucheron、Chaumet、De Beers、Dior四個品牌2025高級珠寶之作，用「不理所當然」的視角看見自然之美。

EDITED By [Yijen Chiou](/tw/author/226355/yijen-chiou/ "Yijen Chiou"), TEXT BY JOING CHEN

大自然，向來是高級珠寶常見的設計主題，2025年各家不約而同以自然為靈感，看似尋常保守，但一些品牌卻不打安全牌，從概念及工藝挑戰傳統，突破典型敘事題材，用不理所當然的視角看見自然之美。

## Jump to:

* [Boucheron《Carte Blanche, Impermanence》高級珠寶系列](#boucheroncarte-blanche-impermanence)
* [Chaumet《Jewels by Nature》高級珠寶系列](#chaumetjewels-by-nature)
* [De Beers《Essence of Nature》高級珠寶系列](#de-beersessence-of-nature)
* [Dior《Diorexquis》高級珠寶系列](#diordiorexquis)

## 看見植物的脆弱與野性

## Boucheron《Carte Blanche, Impermanence》高級珠寶系列

自然界欣欣向榮的生命力與朝氣勃勃的姿態，常是珠寶定格的瞬間，但眼光獨特的Boucheron卻看到自然的脆弱與衰逝。年初[Histoire de Style, Untamed Nature高級珠寶系列](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/tw/luxury/jewelryandwatch/g64118317/boucheron-histoire-de-style-untamed-nature-high-jewelry-2025/)，以葉片被折壓的蘆葦、被視為雜草的薊花，甚至是烏蠅，演繹自然的野性與不完美。最新的《Carte Blanche, Impermanence》高級珠寶系列進一步從創意總監Claire Choisne視角，聚焦自然的流轉與脆弱，結合日式花道（Ikebana）美學，以六幅景致闡述植物花卉從盛放至凋零的剎那瞬影。

延伸閱讀>>[未被馴服的自然靈魂：解碼Boucheron Untamed Nature高級珠寶5個工藝細節](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/tw/luxury/jewelryandwatch/g64118317/boucheron-histoire-de-style-untamed-nature-high-jewelry-2025/)

![高級珠寶, 頂級珠寶, 2025, boucheron, chaumet, de beers, dior](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/boucheron-3-688726c67253f.jpg?resize=980:* "看懂2025高級珠寶趨勢！看自然中的脆弱與野性")

boucheron

Composition n°5 薊草、犀角金龜甲蟲，Boucheron。

從最輕盈的「Composition n°6」到最深沉的「Composition n°1」，色調刻意由透明、白色逐漸至全黑，道出自然不只有盛放，也因有消逝，方才彌足珍貴。花葉枝幹及昆蟲「組合」成一幅幅自成生態的景致，當被「採摘」下來成為珠寶配戴時，猶如一次消逝，但旋即重生，在身體上創造出新的風景。

args.summary:
This is a Harper's BAZAAR Taiwan article analyzing 2025 high jewelry trends across four luxury brands (Boucheron, Chaumet, De Beers, and Dior), all of which used nature as inspiration but approached it with unconventional perspectives—emphasizing fragility, wildness, and impermanence rather than typical idealized natural beauty.

**Boucheron《Carte Blanche, Impermanence》**: The article describes Boucheron's latest high jewelry collection from creative director Claire Choisne, which focuses on nature's fragility and decay through Japanese Ikebana aesthetics. It presents six compositions depicting plants and flowers from blooming to withering. Colors intentionally transition from transparent/white to full black (from the lightest "Composition n°6" to the deepest "Composition n°1"), conveying that nature is precious because of its transience. Featured pieces include thistles and rhinoceros beetle compositions. This follows Boucheron's earlier 2025 collection "Histoire de Style, Untamed Nature," which used folded reeds, thistles, and flies to portray nature's wildness and imperfection.

**Chaumet《Jewels by Nature》**: Chaumet, faithful to its "naturalism" tradition, unusually combined different flower species (oats with field stars, four-leaf clovers with fern leaves) and reinterpreted the rose—a flower the brand rarely features—drawing on a 1922 wild rose leaf tiara. The rose is obscured beneath layered diamond-encrusted leaves and branches, with a vivid yellow diamond representing the flower's imagined color. The serrated leaf edges highlight the wild rose's distinctive roughness.

**De Beers《Essence of Nature》**: The second chapter of this collection honors trees native to De Beers' diamond-producing regions, including the camelthorn tree of the Namibian desert, the baobab tree of Botswana, South Africa's jacaranda tree, and Canada's maple. The camelthorn collection uses hand-carving and polished precious metals to express bark texture, and employs basket setting (multi-prong and metal bands to elevate diamonds) with white and brown rough diamonds combined with polished diamonds for richer texture. Irregular, asymmetrical lines preserve the trees' vigorous, gnarled character.

**Dior《Diorexquis》**: This new 2025 collection recreates the fantasy of the Dior garden, debuting a doublet technique never before used in high jewelry—layering thin gemstone slices over a supporting gemstone to intensify color and brilliance. Top layers use opal and aventurine with bases of onyx or mother-of-pearl, making flowers appear to bloom over shimmering oceans, lakes, or dreamlike flower shadows under gradient light.

据全球性咨询公司贝恩预计，到2025年中国有望成为全球最大的奢侈品市场。时尚业内人士表示，随着高端化趋势加剧，奢侈品牌也开始在文化交融的基础上，加码角逐“体验”的赛道。其中，尤其聚焦产品本身的“含金量”（设计与科技应用）以及与消费者的“多元交互”（跨界与可持续发展）。

2024年上海进博会上，展示宝格丽高级珠宝与腕表系列作品的VR装置。

国际流行

腕表珠宝化成趋势

将有更多新材质与技术结合应用

“品牌创意，在高级珠宝领域是实现明显增长的关键。”广州商业分析师小唐表示，正常情况下，高级珠宝因其独特的感知价值、长期投资吸引力，一直拥有一群高净值优质客群，他们对高级珠宝的需求依然保持着强劲的势头。“但在拍卖行与古董珠宝展之外的市场，品牌依然需要开拓更多的潜力消费群，因此明年开始将会瞄准入门级珠宝的提升。”记者也发现，不少品牌正积极调整其产品系列，提升入门级设计，战略性拉高入门门槛。

记者留意到，从设计角度出发，高级珠宝有这两个明显的发展趋势：跨类别拓展 “高珠”的概念，以及小体积珠宝（比如戒指、手镯、胸针等）与科技应用的结合创新。

时尚博主任任告诉记者，比如处于高价位市场的戴比尔斯珠宝公司就推出了一系列高级订婚戒指，“每枚戒指都配有一件夹克，戴上后很容易吸引日常社交聚会场所的目光。”任任表示，价格稍低一些的品牌也顺应小型订婚戒指趋势，以满足预算有限但渴望拥有特别纪念品的新兴消费者，比如迪奥、蒂芙尼和卡地亚均推出了低于3000英镑的小巧精致款式。据悉，一些拥有计时功效或红外线功能的可穿戴珠宝品类，也受到男性消费市场的青睐。

“其实高端珠宝与腕表之间，也一直互相跨界与渗透。”商业分析师小唐告诉记者，以今年上海进博会为例，在炫技珠宝的同时，奢侈品集团也不忘秀出腕表“肌肉”，包括卡地亚、积家、江诗丹顿等。其中，江诗丹顿呈现了艺术大师系列新作，这是品牌携手北京故宫博物院前副研究馆员创作的全新时计，致敬古老繁复的掐丝珐琅工艺的“浪涌乾坤”系列款亦备受赞赏。

[*展开全文*](javascript:;)

“如今戴表有点像戴首饰，有装饰功能，且比以前更彰显个性。”博主任任认为，近年腕表珠宝化的趋势越来越明显，中高端市场也如此。值得注意的是，新一代消费者更加关注环境足迹及宝石来源，因此，践行可持续发展也是整个高奢行业的重要战略。

Les Cabinotiers阁楼工匠“Le Temps Divin时光神韵”主题作品。

中国市场

主打“年轻化”策略

聚焦更精细化的圈层市场

据全球性咨询公司贝恩近日发布的《2023年中国奢侈品市场报告》，到2030年，中国将成为全球领先的奢侈品市场之一，内地消费者消费量占全球消费总量的比例将增至35%～40%，内地市场的占比将提升至24%～26%。时尚业内分析师普遍认为，在中国市场，奢侈品集团正持续推进着年轻化策略，不论从产品设计、技术创新、跨界互动等方面，他们都需要深入全层年轻客群。

记者留意到，近年奢侈品线下体验店的焕新重启首先奠定了高品质体验的重要性。今年的北京王府中环迎来多家珠宝腕表品牌的旗舰店和精品店开业，包括梵克雅宝、万国表、积家等，进一步强化了商场珠宝腕表品类的优势之余，更为到访消费者提供一种全新的设计购买体验。比如爱马仕万象城旗舰店重启，腕表成为珠宝配饰里热门品类之一。江诗丹顿广州太古汇店焕新设计，在致敬传统工艺基础上增加了AI多元互动的视觉装置，更强调与年轻人讲述制表工艺的故事。

腕表业内资深人士透露，这并非简单的店铺翻新，而是商业模式的全面升级。传统以展示和销售为主导的门店模式正逐步被以体验和服务为核心的新型门店所取代。而这一转变的背后，体现的是腕表品牌对市场趋势的深刻洞察：在消费者日益追求个性化、高品质体验的当下，单纯的商品销售显然已难以满足需求，而以客户运营为核心的新商业模式正成为行业发展的必然趋势。

江诗丹顿腕表制作的精妙工艺。

This article, published on November 20, 2024, by Qilu Evening News/Qilu One Point, discusses the 2025 trends in the high-end watch industry. Despite a downturn in the overall luxury goods market, high-end jewelry watches have emerged as "dark horses" with record-breaking performance. At the 2024 Shanghai CIIE (China International Import Expo), the three global luxury groups—LVMH, Kering, and Richemont—appeared together for the first time, demonstrating their commitment to investing in China.

Key points covered:

1. **Market Outlook**: Bain consultancy predicts China will become the world's largest luxury goods market by 2025. Another Bain report forecasts that by 2030, China will be among the world's leading luxury markets, with mainland consumers accounting for 35-40% of global consumption and the mainland market share rising to 24-26%.

2. **International Trend - Jewelry-ification of Watches**: High-end jewelry and watches are increasingly cross-pollinating. Brands are expanding the concept of "high jewelry" and combining small-volume jewelry (rings, bracelets, brooches) with tech applications. De Beers launched high-end engagement rings, while Dior, Tiffany, and Cartier introduced smaller pieces under £3,000 to attract emerging consumers with limited budgets. Wearable jewelry with timing or infrared functions is gaining popularity among male consumers. At the Shanghai CIIE, brands including Cartier, Jaeger-LeCoultre, and Vacheron Constantin showcased new watch collections—Vacheron Constantin unveiled new works created with a former deputy researcher of the Palace Museum, paying tribute to the cloisonné enamel craft.

3. **China Market - Youth Strategy**: Luxury groups are pursuing "youth-oriented" strategies in China, targeting younger customer segments through product design, tech innovation, and cross-border interactions. New flagship stores and boutiques opened at Beijing's WF Central (including Van Cleef & Arpels, IWC, and Jaeger-LeCoultre), Hermès reopened its MixC flagship store (with watches becoming a popular category in jewelry accessories), and Vacheron Constantin's Guangzhou Taikoo Hui store was redesigned with AI interactive visual installations to engage younger audiences.

4. **Industry Insight**: Store renovations represent a full upgrade of business models—traditional display-and-sales-focused stores are being replaced by experience-and-service-centric models. This shift reflects watch brands' understanding that customer-centric operations are the industry's future direction.

5. **Expert Quotes**: Commercial analyst Xiao Tang noted that brand creativity is key to growth in high-jewelry, and brands will target entry-level jewelry enhancements starting next year. Fashion blogger Renren observed that "wearing a watch is now like wearing jewelry," with decorative functions and greater personality expression, while new-generation consumers increasingly care about environmental footprint and gemstone sources, making sustainability a key strategy for the luxury industry.

在镶嵌上，除了点缀123.35克拉的斯里兰卡糖面切割蓝宝石、131.21ct[塔吉克斯坦](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%A1%94%E5%90%89%E5%85%8B%E6%96%AF%E5%9D%A6&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLloZTlkInlhYvmlq_lnaYiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.YUBnw42ArqLWz7c00DAMFQlb-1n_0Prg7Wt0lG3tg0o&zhida_source=entity)产地枕形尖晶石等大尺寸稀有巨宝外，还通过定制切割与创新铺排，将彩宝镶嵌工艺提升至绘画艺术层面，再度巩固了宝格丽作为彩宝大师的权威地位。

*   **[Cartier](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=Cartier&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiJDYXJ0aWVyIiwiemhpZGFfc291cmNlIjoiZW50aXR5IiwiY29udGVudF9pZCI6MjcwMjc3MDE0LCJjb250ZW50X3R5cGUiOiJBcnRpY2xlIiwibWF0Y2hfb3JkZXIiOjEsInpkX3Rva2VuIjpudWxsfQ.5LWJm-DWzk6LXJ8K-R45sy92NSaib4c-R019vSzPloQ&zhida_source=entity) 卡地亚**

Cartier去年先后推出的En Équilibre 高级珠宝系列第一篇章：平衡艺境和第二篇章：[平衡艺术](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%B9%B3%E8%A1%A1%E8%89%BA%E6%9C%AF&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLlubPooaHoibrmnK8iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.EGRd3sUS18SDvknEZ2Dfk6iXp6iXQU41Hy5n9o2YXIQ&zhida_source=entity)，在设计与工艺层面都展现了非凡实力。

这一系列的设计灵感源于 Cartier [创作理念](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%88%9B%E4%BD%9C%E7%90%86%E5%BF%B5&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLliJvkvZznkIblv7UiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.GU4XQTCFF-dfo-fuc-HpnsGMW8Lk6kQbwrjkfwLONL0&zhida_source=entity)中的平衡艺术，由高级珠宝[创意总监](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%88%9B%E6%84%8F%E6%80%BB%E7%9B%91&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLliJvmhI_mgLvnm5EiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.a4EkA85ZHdJD2ERfALF3wBMsbD8v8Zjlq_KN9J8Sl2c&zhida_source=entity) Jacqueline Karachi 执掌，精准拿捏线条的纯粹性、造型的立体感、色彩的调和与虚实的互动，将抽象美学转化为可佩戴的精密艺术。

![Image 21](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-42c31cbdd988e10f32e5bbf5537e0321_1440w.jpg)

这件作品倾注6000多个小时精心打造，巧妙捕捉两只麻雀相会时那微妙而动人的瞬间。

两只[灵鸟](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%81%B5%E9%B8%9F&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLngbXpuJ8iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.A0qNoautTYnJOyX2POKyy1rCHPFJ1L4oQ1PZozVuUHQ&zhida_source=entity)的姿态被塑造得栩栩如生：一只张开翅膀，似乎在表达内心的喜悦；另一只则微微颔首，鸟啄上衔着一颗重达13.51ct水滴形浓彩黄钻，如同献宝般飞向另一半。

![Image 30](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-807d9613abbe4381d047c03740bca246_1440w.jpg)

![Image 31](https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-cbfc838a2c8f3d6c3f64bc92d2c836c6_1440w.jpg)

它们飞翔的轨迹幻化为链身，[矩形切割](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%9F%A9%E5%BD%A2%E5%88%87%E5%89%B2&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLnn6nlvaLliIflibIiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.bESr3OzquB-twic6FvdBxeWMJ5pRFkvpigZI86uC7ag&zhida_source=entity)钻石与圆钻交替点缀，独特的几何线条，棱角分明，充满了现代感和时尚气息。

那颗黄钻更是成为了视觉焦点，明媚的颜色和完美的火彩，交织成一个如梦似幻的光影世界，为整体造型增添了一丝高级感。

![Image 32](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-0706353093b4281a1592309a40b12b25_1440w.jpg)

*   **[Chopard](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=Chopard&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiJDaG9wYXJkIiwiemhpZGFfc291cmNlIjoiZW50aXR5IiwiY29udGVudF9pZCI6MjcwMjc3MDE0LCJjb250ZW50X3R5cGUiOiJBcnRpY2xlIiwibWF0Y2hfb3JkZXIiOjEsInpkX3Rva2VuIjpudWxsfQ.7rlvtMBGy-bV1ZtSeJXPhA4iXBz2lvYZdxWOd052pKQ&zhida_source=entity) 萧邦**

在2025年年末，Chopard 萧邦的Red Carpet 高级珠宝系列，推出一款以孔雀为主题的鸡尾酒戒指，以大胆的材质创新与色彩叙事成为瞩目焦点。

作品大胆摒弃传统的[贵金属](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%B4%B5%E9%87%91%E5%B1%9E&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLotLXph5HlsZ4iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.SzLc7zIOkmCVh81os5ufh0tWTWelFO2blj1NIi1R4Po&zhida_source=entity)，采用电镀蓝绿色的[钛金属](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E9%92%9B%E9%87%91%E5%B1%9E&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLpkpvph5HlsZ4iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.tq_VgsVWqOJpECV6rz75Pmt9sgI_7GxYgKne4BwJ6zo&zhida_source=entity)构筑主体，赋予孔雀灵动的现代姿态。

![Image 33](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-8914741ed33ed25def38be9a23a22819_1440w.jpg)

头部与颈羽由密镶蓝宝石点缀，尾屏以层叠的橄榄形结构铺展，每片羽毛的中央均镶嵌一颗深色蓝宝石作为“羽眼”，周围环绕浅色蓝宝石、沙弗莱石与[帕拉伊巴碧玺](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%B8%95%E6%8B%89%E4%BC%8A%E5%B7%B4%E7%A2%A7%E7%8E%BA&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLluJXmi4nkvIrlt7TnoqfnjroiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.M0tV-BWObUEuH_VIFf8VrJGGESUjf8_FgpxElhXjOo8&zhida_source=entity)，形成细腻而斑斓的色彩过渡。

整件作品的亮点，在于孔雀环抱的那颗15.71克拉弧面[黑欧泊](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E9%BB%91%E6%AC%A7%E6%B3%8A&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLpu5HmrKfms4oiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.FQIb7WcwfyfD_h64CdQ_4u23ZBUhJZP-UrIdEBaajSM&zhida_source=entity)。孔雀羽毛间的蓝绿彩韵与欧泊的奇幻变彩相互映照，在光影间形成一场静谧而绚烂的对话，展现出色彩、材质与形态高度统一的视觉感染力。

**【巧思美】**

*   **Fabergé 法贝热**

来自于[俄罗斯](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E4%BF%84%E7%BD%97%E6%96%AF&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLkv4TnvZfmlq8iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.68xpnqbK47ZCIjYtHu7McpAA7itfMUcPoQpjn14rArM&zhida_source=entity)的珠宝商[Fabergé](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=2&q=Faberg%C3%A9&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiJGYWJlcmfDqSIsInpoaWRhX3NvdXJjZSI6ImVudGl0eSIsImNvbnRlbnRfaWQiOjI3MDI3NzAxNCwiY29udGVudF90eXBlIjoiQXJ0aWNsZSIsIm1hdGNoX29yZGVyIjoyLCJ6ZF90b2tlbiI6bnVsbH0.HlRX8IsYdfUujM4TO7U3iqTJFzpdbbd6YwFUPcDvfRM&zhida_source=entity)，去年推出的两大彩蛋系列新作中，【Heritage】系列尤为引人注目。

![Image 35](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-78786dedf2f6f09143ea40b0aa84c96c_1440w.jpg)

该系列延续品牌经典的“隐藏惊喜”传统，以精湛的玑镂雕刻、细腻的珐琅和瑰丽的宝石镶嵌工艺，打造出高级而精致的彩蛋外壳。

![Image 36](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-4b22ef46fb846990ab9851757f129a40_1440w.jpg)

轻启彩蛋，仿佛打开了一扇通往微缩动物世界的大门——考拉、天鹅、蝴蝶、变色龙、蜻蜓5种小动物跃然于眼前，动物的表情可爱、自然，每一个都有着自己独特的生命和灵魂。

![Image 37](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-6af25a0cb990bbcc3e35c2895db53e4d_1440w.jpg)

这一枚枚富有巧思美的彩蛋，不仅延续了法贝热自1885年以来的创作精髓，更通过[当代设计](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%BD%93%E4%BB%A3%E8%AE%BE%E8%AE%A1&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLlvZPku6Porr7orqEiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.z6Tz6rRPkneTxNVSVD-ZgB-g1qRCTusqkzpdWZTLc-I&zhida_source=entity)语言，将承载着祝福、守护与生命力的动物意象，凝练为一枚枚可握于掌心的艺术品，在开阖之间，传递出如童话般美好而珍贵的情感共鸣。

![Image 38](https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-03e9bda488cf672b9a48ffccf9c29874_1440w.jpg)

![Image 39](https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-a473544b061684a4d64831f948a28244_1440w.jpg)

![Image 40](https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-cca94f41400ecbe2b251f29e651f1e66_1440w.jpg)

![Image 41](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-0fad2fa3184ab556ca69e5cf38edc7e7_1440w.jpg)

彩蛋以电影中的**【[诺克斯堡](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%AF%BA%E5%85%8B%E6%96%AF%E5%A0%A1&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLor7rlhYvmlq_loKEiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.Lawle555aFnAwRT9m-9_VYkBZRzMbvToPhxzX4MqEf4&zhida_source=entity)黄金保险箱】**为原型，蛋壳为黄金材质，经镜面[抛光处理](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%8A%9B%E5%85%89%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLmipvlhYnlpITnkIYiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.N4MAwa6GGjWb0o3yH2k7rkvnW6ie-rpYfQYRjYruowM&zhida_source=entity)，呈现出夺目的金属光泽。

![Image 42](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-f5829e60f7cce86441cc88ab30f9e6f7_1440w.jpg)

设计中最具巧思之处，在于彩蛋被塑造成一台微缩保险箱，精密还原密码锁造型，中央镌刻经典“007”字样。
