来自于[瑞士](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%91%9E%E5%A3%AB&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLnkZ7lo6siLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.rBvYfj6eDJHCHQ3tP27eeWLTcbD1FW8hjHL4USJzuMI&zhida_source=entity)的百年珠宝品牌Piaget，在2025发布的新一季高定系列【Shapes of Extraleganza】中，则上演了一场艺术大乱炖。

![Image 44](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-d44902ffa959db7939e212940e608db7_1440w.jpg)

[欧普艺术](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%AC%A7%E6%99%AE%E8%89%BA%E6%9C%AF&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLmrKfmma7oibrmnK8iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.XLylON9Np2DyX_yTWQ1cUjqXduwh7DP5JKuul89NjJM&zhida_source=entity)是西方二十世纪兴起的[艺术思潮](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%89%BA%E6%9C%AF%E6%80%9D%E6%BD%AE&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLoibrmnK_mgJ3mva4iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.-eAHuQvx7WyXxutTLG5t4EGEKVF6c3H7oGKqGMw-tLQ&zhida_source=entity)，它利用人类视觉上的错觉所绘制而成的绘画艺术，而【缤纷虹彩】主题的设计灵感正是来源于此。

采用弧面定制切割的绿松石、[菱锰矿](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%8F%B1%E9%94%B0%E7%9F%BF&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLoj7HplLDnn78iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.z6peS0-6Gx-XuZflAafLCq8U28AWAVu5bLcQG6t7KBo&zhida_source=entity)、舒俱来等彩宝，演绎出标志性的欧普[艺术风格](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%89%BA%E6%9C%AF%E9%A3%8E%E6%A0%BC&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLoibrmnK_po47moLwiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.5X9Oi1fET7buqI0wVHmu4_vchBiW2ZPQQRRgqwx1ocI&zhida_source=entity)。

![Image 45](https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-6a45b46fbb3c114c5922b9cfe2202b82_1440w.jpg)

一颗3.01ct水滴形切割钻石镶嵌在正中，外围双圈蓝宝石和[孔雀石](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%AD%94%E9%9B%80%E7%9F%B3&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLlrZTpm4Dnn7MiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.hXmUzx1v1th7LzymM2qRufaRaJ8Zwks4A9DA1K7EQLE&zhida_source=entity)，缤纷多彩的配色，形成了一种独特而迷人的艺术效果。

![Image 46](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-bb67f3d492c8b894c64c1435c3d30caf_1440w.jpg)

除了欧普艺术风格，在Shapes of Extraleganza高级珠宝系列中，还能够看到[孟菲斯](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%AD%9F%E8%8F%B2%E6%96%AF&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLlrZ_oj7Lmlq8iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.GAEcar1XbweLeWnIG_eUmOPY2Ya9ZmKYHjbhK2jWbMA&zhida_source=entity)艺术风格的影子。

孟菲斯艺术风格，兴起于20世纪80年代的意大利，它打破了传统设计的束缚，强调色彩的鲜明对比、几何形状的组合和不规则的构图。

![Image 47](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-9b00f9b0e98c551ed9b4968f6da50cf8_1440w.jpg)

![Image 48](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-cbf8b5e200abe2b983a4558f2e0f6a4f_1440w.jpg)

这件耗时500多个小时打造的Wave Illusion 金质项链，通过尖晶石、红宝石、钻石的错落排列，不仅增加了项链的视觉冲击力，还体现了孟菲斯艺术风格中对个性和创新的追求。

![Image 49](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-6e444bd12424e1c92e387d0fe8e397a2_1440w.jpg)

![Image 50](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-1c04a69f2c2410ee5ca2bbe0ebf3f753_1440w.jpg)

*   **[Boucheron](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=Boucheron&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiJCb3VjaGVyb24iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.2DpIcE_k9K5cEncRrOHs4nX0m2p-EdoBbIlMCkytS5Q&zhida_source=entity)宝诗龙**

2025年7月，Boucheron推出的Carte Blanche, Impermanence 高级珠宝系列，在创作理念与材质运用上均实现了突破性创新。

![Image 51](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-d6bde4c398016525812a1a4c7c8dc773_1440w.jpg)

这一系列从[日本花道](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%AC%E8%8A%B1%E9%81%93&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLml6XmnKzoirHpgZMiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.FOlN26oJSc2JYuKtovsmfGK7tBxDjoHJDfsvdX7cB9U&zhida_source=entity)（Ikebana）与侘寂（Wabi-sabi）哲学中汲取灵感，以28件作品构建出六组植物主题的艺术构境。

![Image 52](https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-c397381dad14b4fbaf2033d94e4821a0_1440w.jpg)

![Image 53](https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-171b05ef87bdf8b27be2f8dd0e3aae94_1440w.jpg)

创意总监 Claire Choisne大胆将高级珠宝与花道之艺相结合，精准呈现植物花卉的真实形态与生动气韵，演绎自然由盛转衰的轨迹。

> 小知识：
> 
> 侘寂，日本美学意识的组成部分，指的是朴素又安静的事物。源自小乘佛法中的[三法印](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E4%B8%89%E6%B3%95%E5%8D%B0&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLkuInms5XljbAiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.ofcpMGodG1MPJrepWb0NhXok-GJXM7audXRUY4ap5gw&zhida_source=entity)（诸行无常、诸法无我、涅槃寂静）。

![Image 54](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-cd0b8b3c35b18ab356a46549d8fd81e7_1440w.jpg)

![Image 55](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-74ae280d2a85f312a754f9adf176a149_1440w.jpg)

系列最为瞩目的突破在于对非传统材质的运用。

尤其是对于[硼硅酸玻璃](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%A1%BC%E7%A1%85%E9%85%B8%E7%8E%BB%E7%92%83&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLnobznoYXphbjnjrvnkoMiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.7ZmV7djE6cu6i5h1MKl-9jYNp8OpDKDEOqzdCaBbz60&zhida_source=entity)、陶瓷涂层、钛金、Vantablack®涂层等创新材质的引入，更是突破高定珠宝对传统贵宝的依赖，对于光影的极致控制以及可转换结构的动态设计，使得珠宝不再只反射光芒，而成为承载时间痕迹的容器，呼应侘寂美学中“无常、不完美、寂静”的核心意境。

**【换汤不换药——系列延伸】**

*   **[Tiffany](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=Tiffany&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiJUaWZmYW55IiwiemhpZGFfc291cmNlIjoiZW50aXR5IiwiY29udGVudF9pZCI6MjcwMjc3MDE0LCJjb250ZW50X3R5cGUiOiJBcnRpY2xlIiwibWF0Y2hfb3JkZXIiOjEsInpkX3Rva2VuIjpudWxsfQ.V6hYqWvyrBDUy7M5QBTeIC8QGwnHLeFAKnq4JJtSaqA&zhida_source=entity) 蒂芙尼**

论，有个才华横溢、天赋异禀的先祖有多重要？

这在高级珠宝的世界里，答案几乎等同于——**拥有了一座永不枯竭的创意金矿与无可替代的品牌灵魂**。来自美国的珠宝品牌Tiffany，便是这一命题的生动例证。

![Image 58](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-0cc630add5ca589aa97837903007dadf_1440w.jpg)

最近这两年，Tiffany的高定珠宝系列可以说是“换汤不换药”。

![Image 59](https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-cd51bffeb63931b550d22940bb7b1848_1440w.jpg)

例如，去年Tiffany推出的Bird on a Pearl系列、Bird on a Rock系列、以及blue book秋季系列，依旧是可着先祖——传奇珠宝大师让·史隆伯杰Jean Schlumberger一个人[薅羊毛](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%96%85%E7%BE%8A%E6%AF%9B&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLoloXnvormr5siLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.2sP5kXpKGdnZnVm3ivTk03vO2vvK4NU2wfoeBgvlzKs&zhida_source=entity)，从经典的[石上鸟](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%9F%B3%E4%B8%8A%E9%B8%9F&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLnn7PkuIrpuJ8iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.XbD0wKxOksWbwPfweynR86pKJsx6w02G12kOJo0oLbU&zhida_source=entity)系列到奇幻的海洋创想，翻来覆去的重新演绎。

![Image 60](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-9963457396bed30fbd75e24ab9959c77_1440w.jpg)

![Image 61](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-15b40ccd4a315414e8ab3104d1aafa3d_1440w.jpg)

虽然，[史隆伯杰](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=2&q=%E5%8F%B2%E9%9A%86%E4%BC%AF%E6%9D%B0&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLlj7LpmobkvK_mnbAiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MiwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.4KRBT8RtosPMA5skWYeQ7yOMbRqXQ6W8P8U753JTeuk&zhida_source=entity)的设计足够经典：其充满生命力的[有机形态](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%9C%89%E6%9C%BA%E5%BD%A2%E6%80%81&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLmnInmnLrlvaLmgIEiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.VE4v7_wPv01McXtzBGf-IUpNkNE5QsP_d0_OpGB00kc&zhida_source=entity)、对色彩与材质的大胆运用、以及将自然奇幻化的叙事能力，构成了蒂芙尼无可替代的美学基石。

![Image 62](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-04f4eb5a6ec30c7b4469bbde4d0be769_1440w.jpg)

但当致敬成为年复一年的主题，再惊艳的设计，看多了也难免让人产生[审美疲劳](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%AE%A1%E7%BE%8E%E7%96%B2%E5%8A%B3&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLlrqHnvo7nlrLlirMiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.wxYc1U1C9rC1Ph6XJxC9dvRJwlODjYeBZitTNk336iU&zhida_source=entity)。

真正的传承，从来不是原地致敬，而是带着先辈的精神，走向他未曾抵达的远方，希望2026年Tiffany能够在设计上有新的突破~

*   **Boucheron宝诗龙**

Boucheron宝诗龙的Histoire de Style高级珠宝系列，自2021年诞生问世以来，始终以跨越时代的审美对话为核心，从异域风情、高级定制时装、Art Déco装饰艺术等诸多经典元素中汲取灵感，跨越性别的界限，再现Boucheron百年经典历史，为我们带来了全新的视觉感受。

![Image 65](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-a208902f07534d4f525df128eda4ef28_1440w.jpg)

2025年，该系列再度演进，推出 **“Untamed Nature”** 子系列，以28件独一款设计，展开一场人与自然的诗意共鸣。

![Image 66](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-362b382e6840d2a1751a4ad1eb409e27_1440w.jpg)

![Image 67](https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-03671dcf28c847daff787e5987b8d40a_1440w.jpg)

系列分为植物和昆虫两个篇章，呈现十六个主题，从充满神秘与魅力的大自然汲取无限灵感，精心塑造出新艺术主义风格的植物花蔓与昆虫意象。

![Image 68](https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-af7afb18e5ca4191ba506d9639d4643c_1440w.jpg)

在工艺层面，宝诗龙巧妙运用**金属锻造与宝石镶嵌的[虚实对比](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%99%9A%E5%AE%9E%E5%AF%B9%E6%AF%94&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLomZrlrp7lr7nmr5QiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.idHt_kej2TCl7YuBMEQRYcZ5017KUCDvwNCab-nAn2s&zhida_source=entity)**，再现植物卷须的柔韧与昆虫翅膀的轻盈。可转换式的设计，更为作品带来无限可能。

![Image 69](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-a184f815eb8272003dbca24fc6899f5b_1440w.jpg)

![Image 70](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-5611385c68e3ea3bf03b9de013910c1f_1440w.jpg)

*   **Cartier 卡地亚**

2025年年初，Cartier Nature Sauvage 高级珠宝系列第三篇章，在巴黎高定[时装周](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%97%B6%E8%A3%85%E5%91%A8&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLml7boo4XlkagiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.jH01etNJnUkzSxIkG5JgrZ6pq9yQwGamgTP96h3Js8o&zhida_source=entity)亮相。

![Image 71](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-83cddbf395357c5f4f4ce1ed68ae54c5_1440w.jpg)

这一篇章共包括5件独一款设计，从栖息于深海中的海胆到森林中的霸王老虎，从翱翔于天空中的翠鸟到草原上的极速王者猎豹，这藏于世间的奇珍异兽，在这个天马行空的剧院中依次登场，仿佛是从梦幻的画卷中走出来的生灵，每一个都带着独特的故事和魅力。

![Image 72](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-328307444b34094e2b44a37f89ef784c_1440w.jpg)

尤其是品牌的标志性元素——猎豹，5件独一款设计中就占据了两件，足以见其在Cartier不朽的地位。

Panthère Canopée 白金项链，呈现出的是猎豹护宝的场景。

![Image 73](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-fd0bd8a4842dcd5f8929485e7cb52ca8_1440w.jpg)

璀璨的钻石与缟玛瑙镶嵌而成的树叶，一只由钻石和缟玛瑙勾勒的猎豹，静静地趴伏其中，身下是一枚重达26.53克拉的斯里兰卡枕形切割蓝宝石。

猎豹的姿态，看似慵懒随性，但祖母绿镶嵌的眼睛，却透露出一丝机敏，似乎能够看穿一切，时刻保持警觉。

![Image 74](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-6e2f4066b8414362689a4626403d27d1_1440w.jpg)

而Panthères Versatiles 白金项链，则呈现出的是猎豹捕食的一幕。

![Image 75](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-aa5f4feb73bd462771dc8a575fff5e9c_1440w.jpg)

钻石镶嵌而成的豹头点缀祖母绿眼睛，身体化为链节环绕颈间，这些链节流畅自然，充满了艺术的张力，它们如同猎豹灵动的身姿，在森林间肆意纵横。

猎豹蠢蠢欲试的看着那颗重达10.1克拉的[赞比亚](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%B5%9E%E6%AF%94%E4%BA%9A&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLotZ7mr5TkupoiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.RcNcI1EN5mOTQgN1xpYUSk_EtjfFXr3Q4vsvnKSOWms&zhida_source=entity)祖母绿，是整条项链最大的亮点，独特的糖包山设计，吸睛又独特。

![Image 76](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-f9e97fcfd021682be497fdb90739ec27_1440w.jpg)

## 2025最丑珠宝盘点

Mikimoto 推出 Les Pétales高级珠宝系列中的碧玺玫瑰冠冕，在设计很难评。

一朵[红碧玺](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=270277014&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%BA%A2%E7%A2%A7%E7%8E%BA&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODY2MjQ4NDMsInEiOiLnuqLnoqfnjroiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNzAyNzcwMTQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.yTbHaTawKeelfJT_Y8k6ECsxx8hNMBfjr0-81sJSnFM&zhida_source=entity)玫瑰钻石花点缀在一侧，本意是融合经典玫瑰意象与现代冠冕形式，但最终呈现的效果却介于传统老派与当代时尚之间，给人一种土不土、时尚不时尚的感觉~

相比于去年以缎带为灵感、曾轰动一时的“The Bows”高珠系列，该系列中其他的珠宝设计也显得有些死板，过于中规中矩，没有给人带来视觉上的冲击和新鲜感。

不过，相比于Tiffany和BVLGARI高定新品的大气奢华，Butterfly新作则显得有点小家子气，款式也与以往的设计大同小异，缺乏新鲜感。

*   **法国珠宝商 Lydia Courteille**

在“珠宝匠群像”系列中，J先生曾经介绍过这位珠宝界的“鬼才”：Lydia Courteille，她设计的珠宝要不就美的十分震撼，要不就诡异的让人惊世骇俗，呈现出两极分化的趋势。

（相关阅读：[香奈儿老佛爷是她粉丝，刘嘉玲钟爱她：珠宝鬼才Lydia Courteille](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//www.toutiao.com/i6682646148546560526/%3Fgroup_id%3D6682646148546560526)）

![Image 94](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-d106e039f3af6b30e67623daa9b9c24b_1440w.jpg)

2025年7月，Lydia Courteille发布的【粉红畅想】高级珠宝系列，构建了一个极具个人风格的粉色世界。

在这里，每一种生灵都是由粉色蓝宝石、黑钻与粉色尖晶石镶嵌，虽然用材奢华、色彩统一，却在视觉上呈现出单调的堆砌感，看着有些说不出的惊悚感~

![Image 95](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-c9c8b6f27475046c5c1471a156940999_1440w.jpg)

![Image 96](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-18858e3205e071adc3d370f8527677a5_1440w.jpg)

![Image 97](https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-3823847eca102a35588a23a3e70b919e_1440w.jpg)

> J先生说：
> 
> 美丽的珠宝总是能找到共性，而乏味的设计却各有各的平庸。
> 
> 回顾2025年，传统珠宝大牌在维系其工艺与宝石权威的同时，正悄然进行一场自我革新。
> 
> 它们不仅依托珍稀材质与百年工艺，更以前瞻姿态引入钛金属、陶瓷涂层、Vantablack®超黑涂层等科技材质，重新定义珠宝的感官边界。
> 
> 相比之下，部分新兴品牌或独立设计师却显得步履谨慎。在经典与流行之间，它们往往选择安全的跟随，而非勇敢的突破，以致作品虽工整，却难见令人心动的锋芒。
> 
> 由此可见，行业的分野已日益清晰：真正的价值并不在于规模与声量，而在于是否具备重塑规则的视野与胆识。当创新本身成为新的经典，平庸便成了这个时代最大的风险~

This is a Zhihu (知乎) column article by "珠宝匠" (Jewelry Craftsman) presenting a 2025 annual jewelry "red list" (best) and "black list" (worst) ranking of high-end jewelry collections. The article is divided into two main sections.

**2025 BEST JEWELRY (红榜):**

1. **CHAUMET (尚美巴黎)** — "Jewels by Nature 绿野芳踪" collection: 54 one-of-a-kind pieces with three chapters ("永生"/Eternal, "芳华"/Bloom, "重生"/Rebirth) inspired by naturalism, Napoleon and Josephine's romantic aesthetics. Uses traditional gems (diamonds, emeralds, sapphires) including a 36.44ct Sri Lankan sapphire, with deep craftsmanship.

2. **BVLGARI (宝格丽)** — "Polychroma 瑰彩罗马" collection: 250 one-of-a-kind designs including 5 heritage pieces and 60 "ten-million-level" works. Roman Empire and Sicily inspired, featuring a 123.35ct Sri Lankan sugarloaf sapphire and 131.21ct Tajikistan cushion-cut spinel, reinforcing BVLGARI's status as color-gem master.

3. **Cartier (卡地亚)** — "En Équilibre" collection (balance art), two chapters directed by Jacqueline Karachi. Features the "Traforato" platinum necklace with 2 emerald-cut emeralds as axis, surrounded by diamonds, emeralds, and onyx mesh. Includes a 58.08ct Sri Lankan sapphire, 51.70ct aquamarine, 74.10ct green tourmaline. Emphasizes visual storytelling over mere stone stacking.

4. **Graff (格拉夫)** — "The Gift of Love" one-of-a-kind necklace: 6,000+ hours of work, depicting two sparrows meeting, one holding a 13.51ct fancy intense yellow pear-shaped diamond. Features rectangular-cut and round diamonds forming the chain.

5. **Chopard (萧邦)** — Red Carpet collection peacock-themed cocktail ring: uses electroplated blue-green titanium instead of traditional precious metals, with sapphires, tsavorite, and Paraiba tourmaline. Centerpiece is a 15.71ct black opal cabochon.

6. **Fabergé (法贝热)** — Two egg collections: Heritage series with hidden surprises featuring 5 miniature animals (koala, swan, butterfly, chameleon, dragonfly); and Fabergé x 007 Goldfinger collaboration egg modeled after Fort Knox gold vault with a working combination lock revealing miniature gold bars.

7. **Piaget (伯爵)** — "Shapes of Extraleganza" collection: Op Art style using turquoise, rhodonite, sugilite with a 3.01ct pear-cut diamond; also features Memphis art style including the "Wave Illusion" gold necklace (500+ hours) with spinel, ruby, and diamond arrangement.

8. **Boucheron (宝诗龙)** — "Carte Blanche, Impermanence" collection (July 2025): Inspired by Japanese Ikebana flower arrangement and Wabi-sabi philosophy, 28 pieces in 6 plant-themed groups. Notable for innovative non-traditional materials: borosilicate glass, ceramic coating, titanium, and Vantablack® coating. Creative director Claire Choisne.

9. **Tiffany (蒂芙尼)** — Criticized as "换汤不换药" (old wine in new bottles): continues to reinterpret Jean Schlumberger's classic designs (Bird on a Pearl, Bird on a Rock, Blue Book autumn series). Author notes aesthetic fatigue from year-after-year homage.

10. **Boucheron Histoire de Style** — "Untamed Nature" sub-series: 28 one-of-a-kind pieces in plant and insect chapters (16 themes), Art Nouveau style with metal forging and gem inlay contrasting, convertible designs.

11. **Cartier Nature Sauvage** — Third chapter: 5 one-of-a-kind designs featuring sea urchins, tigers, kingfishers, and cheetahs. Panthère Canopée necklace: leopard guarding a 26.53ct Sri Lankan cushion sapphire; Panthères Versatiles necklace: leopard with 10.1ct Zambian emerald.

**2025 WORST JEWELRY (黑榜):**

1. **Mikimoto (御木本)** — "Les Pétales" tourmaline rose tiara: awkward mix of traditional and modern, neither classic nor fashionable; other pieces in the series deemed too rigid compared to last year's "The Bows" collection.

2. **Boghossian** — "Inlay Crush" collection: innovative double-stone inlay technique (round diamonds set in aquamarine, morganite, peridot bases) but designs deemed ordinary and lacking highlights.

3. **Graff Butterfly 50th anniversary** — New pieces considered too modest ("小家子气") and too similar to previous designs.

4. **Qeelin** — "Snake Bo Bo" pendant for the Year of the Snake: combines snake and panda elements with diamonds and rubies, deemed cute but strange; "Hanfu Bo Bo" (Hanfu + panda) also not appreciated by the author.

5. **Tasaki x Nicolo Pasqualetti** — Collaboration inspired by the ocean, combining Akoya pearls with gold in 4 themed series; the author notes trypophobia-inducing results.

6. **Lydia Courteille** — "粉红畅想" (Pink Reverie) collection: all creatures set with pink sapphires, black diamonds, and pink spinels; visually monotonous and somewhat eerie despite luxurious materials.

**Author's conclusion:** Beautiful jewelry shares commonalities while boring designs each have their own mediocrity. Traditional luxury brands are innovating with tech materials (titanium, ceramic coatings, Vantablack®) while some emerging brands play it safe. The real value lies not in scale but in the vision to reshape rules — when innovation becomes the new classic, mediocrity becomes the era's biggest risk.
args.key_excerpts:
"真正的传承，从来不是原地致敬，而是带着先辈的精神，走向他未曾抵达的远方" (True heritage is never about paying homage in place, but carrying the spirit of predecessors to places they never reached — regarding Tiffany's repetitive Schlumberger reissues.)

"美丽的珠宝总是能找到共性，而乏味的设计却各有各的平庸。" (Beautiful jewelry always shares commonalities, while boring designs each have their own mediocrity.)

"行业的分野已日益清晰：真正的价值并不在于规模与声量，而在于是否具备重塑规则的视野与胆识。当创新本身成为新的经典，平庸便成了这个时代最大的风险。" (The industry's divide is increasingly clear: true value lies not in scale or volume, but in the vision and courage to reshape rules. When innovation itself becomes the new classic, mediocrity becomes the era's biggest risk.)

"Cartier则用实际行动证明了'豪镶'的真谛在于视觉叙事，而非单纯堆砌。" (Cartier proved through action that the true essence of luxurious stone-setting lies in visual storytelling, not mere stacking.)

Boucheron Impermanence collection: "对于光影的极致控制以及可转换结构的动态设计，使得珠宝不再只反射光芒，而成为承载时间痕迹的容器，呼应侘寂美学中'无常、不完美、寂静'的核心意境。" (Extreme control of light and shadow and convertible structural designs make jewelry no longer just reflect light, but become containers carrying traces of time, echoing the Wabi-sabi aesthetic core of impermanence, imperfection, and stillness.)

# 全球珠宝格局：2025-2026的珠宝趋势

宝希兰 · 2025年10月23日

2025年，全球珠宝行业正迎来一场前所未有的深度转型。随着消费者价值观的演变、数字技术的迅猛发展，以及人们对传统文化的重新审视，珠宝早已不再只是装饰品——它成为了身份、信仰与情感的具象表达。

本文将为你全面解析全球珠宝行业格局、关键消费趋势、四大设计风潮与未来战略洞察，助你在剧烈变革中抓住先机，赢得市场。

## 全球市场格局：谁在引领珠宝消费？

根据最新数据显示，**2024年全球珠宝市场规模可达**：

* **中国：1193亿美元**（全球第一）
* **印度：972.5亿美元**
* **美国：612.4亿美元**
* **欧洲与非洲**分别贡献**373.7亿与230.7亿美元**
* **日本**与**澳大利亚**则分别为**200.1亿与26.4亿美元**

其中，**奢侈珠宝占全球收入的40%**，时尚珠宝30%，高级珠宝20%，服饰珠宝10%。这清晰地反映出一个趋势：**消费者对“独家性”与“可及性”有着双重强烈追求**。

## 新一代消费者画像：价值导向正在重塑购买决策

2025-2026年，珠宝消费者不再只是追求外在的美丽，他们更渴望珠宝能与**内在价值观产生共鸣**。

### 主要趋势包括：

* **个性化至关重要**：珠宝要讲述佩戴者的故事。
* **可持续与透明性成标配**：消费者不再容忍模糊与不道德来源。
* **全渠道数字体验**：Z世代与千禧一代通过社交媒体、App、线上平台接触并决定购买。

## 设计风向标：2025-2026 四大珠宝美学趋势

### 1️⃣ 数字新艺术（Digital Nouveau）

融合20世纪新艺术风格与AI算法设计。典型元素如：

* **AI Nouveau**：抽象几何、数字纹理
* **有翼生物**：蝴蝶、鸟类图案与宝石融合
* **粗粝奢华**：自然原矿与抛光材质对撞

> **战略建议**：品牌需通过**故事讲述**与**数字化表达**，在年轻一代中占据心智高地。

### 2️⃣ 华丽盛宴（Opulent Extravaganza）

在不确定的时代，人们渴望纪念、庄重与永恒的美。

* **摄政风格**：富丽堂皇的宝石与金属工艺
* **情感珠宝**：唤起记忆的设计
* **大君风范**：强烈色彩、史诗感设计

> **代表作品**：蒂芙尼的“岩石上的鸟”、星爆项链（64克拉水晶蛋白石+69克拉钻石）

> **战略建议**：**传统品牌应激活档案灵感**，新品牌则应**以情感共鸣打动人心**。

### 3️⃣ 街头酷炫（Street Cool）

全球城市文化、潮流艺术与数字部落融合催生新的“城市奢侈品”美学。

* **文化融合**：多民族图腾与材质
* **XL叠戴**：大件、多链、混搭
* **都市部落风**：前卫轮廓、变形设计

> **代表作品**：18克拉浓彩黄钻变形项链、坦桑石与绿[碧玺](https://shop.baoxilan.com/gemstone-info/view/Tourmaline?referrer=36 "碧玺")孔雀胸针

> **战略建议**：**强调产品可定制与自我表达**，满足“数字原住民”的个性需求。

### 4️⃣ 仙境幻想（Wonder Escape）

珠宝作为情绪疗愈、现实逃离的媒介正当时。

* **超现实设计**：动物、花朵呈现童话感
* **流行抽象**：意想不到的结构与配色
* **奇幻色调**：变色宝石、珐琅和彩虹效果

> **战略建议**：“**社交媒体拍照友好**”的设计正成为商业成功的关键因素。

## 未来五大策略建议：传统与科技的深度融合

1. **投资品牌叙事**：讲好珠宝背后的故事，提升品牌记忆点。
2. **增强透明度**：用可追溯、可验证的数据与消费者建立信任。
3. **加速数字化布局**：引入AR试戴、NFT证书，拓展社交销售渠道。
4. **优先定制化设计**：模块化、限量版成为稀缺性与高溢价的来源。
5. **探索新材料组合**：大胆融合传统宝石与数字元素，打造新一代“标志性”作品。

## 结语：未来属于创造未来的人

2025年不是渐变，而是跳跃。珠宝行业正在重塑：**从材质到故事，从工艺到科技**。那些敢于拥抱变化、勇于表达自我价值的品牌与匠人，将在新时代中脱颖而出。

> **特别鸣谢：**本文参考泰国宝石和珠宝学院副主任 Sitthichai Parinyanusorn 所撰《2025年珠宝趋势》报告，由《宝石与珠宝杂志》发布。

Luxury jewelry accounts for 40% of global revenue, followed by fashion jewelry (30%), high jewelry (20%), and costume jewelry (10%).

The article identifies four major jewelry design trends for 2025-2026: (1) Digital Nouveau — blending Art Nouveau style with AI algorithms, featuring abstract geometry, winged creatures, and rough-luxury contrasts; (2) Opulent Extravaganza — regency-style ornate pieces, emotional jewelry, and maharaja-style designs, exemplified by Tiffany's "Bird on a Rock" and a 64-carat crystal opal/69-carat diamond starburst necklace; (3) Street Cool — urban luxury mixing multicultural motifs, XL layering, and tribal aesthetics; and (4) Wonder Escape — surreal, whimsical designs with color-changing gems and enamel for emotional escape and social media appeal.

Key consumer trends include the growing importance of personalization (jewelry telling the wearer's story), sustainability and supply chain transparency as standard requirements, and omnichannel digital experiences driven by Gen Z and millennials. The article concludes with five strategic recommendations: investing in brand storytelling, enhancing transparency with traceable data, accelerating digitalization (AR try-ons, NFT certificates, social selling), prioritizing customization and limited editions, and exploring new material combinations. The article references a report by Sitthichai Parinyanusorn, Deputy Director of the Thai Gem and Jewelry Institute, published in Gems & Jewelry magazine.

2. [Jewelry & Watches](/style/jewelry-and-watches/)

# Can High Jewelry Be Sporty? Chanel Has the Answers

A high jewelry collection inspired by sports, and hoodie drawstrings, and team colors, and performance materials? C’est impossible! Non, c’est Chanel.

By [Stellene Volandes](/author/2263/stellene-volandes/ "Stellene Volandes")

When is a one-of-a-kind [Chanel](https://www.townandcountrymag.com/style/jewelry-and-watches/a61915513/chanel-premiere-sound-watch/) diamond cuff most like a ski boot? When it’s hand-molded from carbon fiber and designed to form perfectly around its owner’s wrist. “The objective,” says Frédéric Grangié, president of Chanel Watch and Fine Jewelry, of this highlight from Chanel’s new [high jewelry collection](https://www.townandcountrymag.com/style/jewelry-and-watches/g61427690/the-best-high-jewelry-from-fall-2024-collections/), Haute Joaillerie Sport, “was to get the cuff exactly as our designer Patrice Leguéreau created it, meaning that you have four parts, three ways to wear it: all diamond, all carbon, diamond-carbon. And you have this incredible opening feature here, which is like a zip, and inside there is a fitting system on your wrist, very similar to a ski boot. It makes it fit perfectly, because the point of this collection is that it has to be comfortable, and comfortable in terms of performance. This cuff, when you wear it, it has to fit like a glove.”

![chanel high jewelry 2024](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/tcx100124wchanel-002-66ee01527dfd1.jpg?resize=980:* "chanel high jewelry 2024 ")

photographs by Martin Vallin

The theme of the new Chanel High Jewelry collection is Sport. Team colors include ruby, sapphire, and diamond. **C****hanel High Jewelry** Sport Icons Collector transformable brooches. LEAD IMAGE: **Chanel High Jewelry** Sport Graphic Line Prestige Necklace

To perform in a Chanel high [jewelry cuff](https://www.townandcountrymag.com/style/jewelry-and-watches/a46697670/how-to-style-cuff-guide/)? It is a notion both tongue-in-cheek and supremely serious. Grangié delivers the idea with a bit of mischievous pride: “We made sure the cuff fit perfectly, like great sports equipment. Your safety is important to us.” But the process of creating the cuff, of molding the material rather than the more traditional technique of cutting it, is painstaking, and likely never to be repeated.

![chanel high jewelry 2024](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/tcx100124wchanel-004-66ee026c8fb1e.jpg?resize=980:* "gabrielle chanel ")

©Rue des Archives/PVDE

Yes, Gabrielle Chanel had a sporty side.

![chanel high jewelry 2024](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/tcx100124wchanel-005-66ee034119d65.jpg?resize=980:* "chanel high jewelry 2024 ")

courtesy of Chanel

The collection was inspired by a 1921 Chanel business card in the archives.

The parallel paths of joy and rigor are hallmarks of all athletic victories, and they were both visible when this jewelry collection inspired by sport was presented last June in Monaco. A diamond chain fashioned after the drawstring of a hoodie? Clever, yes, but made possible by an intricate diamond tubing technique. The idea began with a foundational [element of the sports uniform.](https://www.townandcountrymag.com/leisure/sporting/g60885990/best-team-usa-paris-olympics-merch/) “You know athletes, they put their hoodies on. Patrice started thinking, Maybe we can add a drawstring lace to high jewelry. I thought it was genius. So I told him do it: ‘There are no limits. Go as far as you can,’ ” Grangié says. Bright blue lacquered stripes across a chunky diamond ring? “I mean, if you haven’t won the Super Bowl this is the next best ring.” And at the center, an enormous and rare red spinel. A necklace of rubies and diamonds and an important sapphire that somehow delivers athletic impact? How? Upon closer inspection it’s clear the rubies are scattered randomly in their line, as if in team formation. “It’s meant to be that way,” Grangié says. It gives you that perception of speed. Only the greatest craftsmen can do this.” The uneven placement of the rubies is craftsmanship visible, a reminder of the presence of superior hands and imagination.

![chanel high jewelry sport chanel print lion brooch, 8005500005](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/tcx100124wchanel-006-66f573a38e2af.jpg?resize=980:* "CHANEL HIGH JEWELRY SPORT CHANEL PRINT LION BROOCH, 800-550-0005")

Courtesy of Chanel

**Chanel High Jewelry Sport** Chanel Print Lion Brooch

“Pure symmetry,” Grangié says, “when it comes to this type of human creation, but even in terms of beauty standards, is abnormal. There is that test where you take the greatest-looking people, like the greatest movie stars, and you make them symmetrical. All of a sudden it’s terrible, because nothing is the same. And I think, with high jewelry, you see that human touch. In this necklace we call the Graphic Line, the sapphire is exceptional. But to me what is most extraordinary is that ruby line.”

![even as a new collection is launched, house codes remain behold the chanel sport quilted necklace chanel high jewelry sport quilted 255 necklace, 8005500005](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/tcx100124wchanel-001-66f5735c6f994.jpg?resize=980:* "Even as a new collection is launched, house codes remain. Behold the Chanel Sport Quilted necklace. Chanel high jewelry SPORT QUILTED 2.55 NECKLACE, 800-550-0005")

photographs by Martin Vallin

Even as a new collection is launched, house codes remain. Behold the Chanel Sport Quilted necklace. **Chanel High Jewelry** Sport Quilted 2.55 Necklace

It is serious work that reflects hundreds and hundreds of hours in the atelier, and it is play, but with seriously major stones. The Sport collection marks a leap of ambition in Chanel High Jewelry history. The concept itself, launched when Leguéreau discovered a 1921 business card that read “Chanel Couture • Sport” in the archives, is audacious in this high-stakes jewelry arena. So is the absolutely thorough execution of it. A theme is one thing; to interpret sport using colored lacquer and diamond tubing and hand-molded carbon and aluminum and spinels, rubies, sapphires, and mandarin garnet is another. There are odes to craftsmanship embedded in each of the 80 pieces, but it is also quite clear the atelier put a premium on joy. “We do,” says Grangié, “take fun seriously.”

Let’s return now to that carbon and diamond bracelet and the idea of peak performance infused in its design. It is an idea rooted in the pursuit of living freely and spiritedly while wearing one. And as much as camellias, and tweed, and [two-tone sling backs](https://www.townandcountrymag.com/style/fashion-trends/a60952356/inside-private-archives-chanel-dior-paris-photos/), and stars, and comets, and quilted handbags, independence is a code of this house. Founder Gabrielle “Coco” Chanel laid that foundation of freedom from ideas of what should be—especially what women should be—from the beginning. She tanned when translucent skin was prized, wore trousers and pearls to the beach, adopted the suiting and fabrics of a man’s wardrobe for a new generation of women. And in 1932 she presented a collection of diamond jewelry to the world, the first fashion house to venture into this guarded realm. One really can’t view any Chanel High Jewelry collection without acknowledging that original leap, a pivot away from costume jewelry in support of a diamond industry and an economy that needed a boost. Chanel Haute Joaillerie was not reintroduced until 1993, but Chanel remains the first fashion house to have a fine jewelry collection of its own.

Another first: Some of the high jewelry pieces in the Sport collection have the word Chanel written into the design. It is often obscured, almost like a hieroglyphic, but once you know what to look for, it’s clearly there. “Patrice thought about sports jerseys,” Grangié says. “You see the team name. Most likely you see the name of the player, too. So it’s pushing the concept to the maximum. Of course, it says Chanel. It’s our team name. The team is Chanel.”

# Chanel: Haute Joaillerie Sport – Elegance in Motion

In 2024, Chanel unveils a groundbreaking approach to high jewellery, one that marries luxury with the vibrant spirit of movement and sports-inspired elegance. Meet the Haute Joaillerie Sport Collection.

In 2024, [Chanel](https://www.chanel.com/gb/) unveils a groundbreaking approach to [high jewellery](https://highjewellerydream.com/category/chanel-high-jewellery/), one that marries luxury with the vibrant spirit of movement and sports-inspired elegance.

Chanel Haute Joaillerie Sport – Graphic Line Necklace.

 

The “Haute Joaillerie Sport” collection, conceived by Patrice Leguéreau, Director of the Chanel Jewelry Creation Studio, breathes life into this vision, celebrating Chanel’s legacy of freedom and fluidity.

> *« For creating the ‘Sport’ High Jewelry collection, I was inspired by Chanel’s sporty style,* *which is such an integral part of the house’s history: the elegance of the line and the* *freedom of movement. »*
>
> *Patrice Leguéreau, Director of the CHANEL Jewelry Creation Studio*

Rooted in Gabrielle Chanel’s innovative spirit, this collection draws on the essence that first shaped her sporty chic aesthetic—a timeless blend of ease, elegance, and dynamic expression. The soul of “Haute Joaillerie Sport” resonates within each piece.

Gabrielle Chanel was a pioneer in bringing sporty sophistication to high fashion. In 1921, she established her “Sport” atelier, bringing a fresh vision emphasizing freedom of movement alongside refined style—a heritage that this collection honours.

The “Haute Joaillerie Sport” collection captures this core concept through the lens of high jewellery, offering a modern and luxurious homage to the allure of a woman in motion.

### An Aesthetic in Motion

The collection’s aesthetic is a tribute to Chanel’s commitment to refined lines and rhythmic, anatomical design. Each piece is crafted to echo the body’s natural movement, much like Chanel’s original sportswear philosophy. The “Haute Joaillerie Sport”‘s inspiration is evident in this detailed craftsmanship.

The clean, smooth contours and the chevron motif evoke a sense of speed, while vibrant lines of colour inject an energetic flow throughout.

args.summary:
This webpage from High Jewellery Dream (highjewellerydream.com), authored by Claudia Carletti Camponeschi, is a detailed feature article on Chanel's 2024 "Haute Joaillerie Sport" high jewellery collection. The collection, conceived by Patrice Leguéreau, Director of the Chanel Jewelry Creation Studio, celebrates Chanel's heritage of freedom, fluidity, and sporty chic aesthetics that originated with Gabrielle Chanel's 1921 "Sport" atelier.

The article is organized into several thematic sections:

1. **Aesthetic in Motion**: The collection emphasizes clean contours, chevron motifs evoking speed, and vibrant color lines. Key pieces include the "Graphic Line" series (necklaces, earrings, rings featuring cushion-cut sapphires, rubies, emeralds, tsavorite and mandarin garnets, and red spinels, some up to 30.67 cts), along with "Sporty 5" pieces featuring the number "5" in chronometer typography, lion motifs, and star symbols. The collection also debuts Chanel's signature as an openwork imprint ("Chanel Print" pieces).

2. **Technical Savoir-Faire Reimagined**: The collection introduces visible connection systems, quick-release clasps, karabiners redesigned as the number "5," the swivel clasp from the 2.55 bag, and a special "sport cord" tube chain developed exclusively for the collection. Quilted motifs appear as openwork mesh reminiscent of high-performance fabrics.

3. **The Gemstone Showcase**: The crown jewel is a rare set of five Kashmir sapphires unearthed after years of research. Notable gemstones include a 35.10 ct rectangular-cut sapphire, an 18.00 ct cushion-cut sapphire, a 17.76 ct round-cut sapphire, and others ranging from 14-17 cts.

4. **Transformable & Modular Design**: Many pieces are transformable—rings that detach into separate elements, necklaces with multiple wearing options (choker/sautoir formats), interchangeable pendants, and cuffs with interchangeable shells.

5. **Innovative Materials**: The collection combines classic precious metals with high-tech elements including lightweight colored aluminum, resilient carbon fibre, and lacquer in matching gemstone hues.

Notable pieces detailed include: the Sporty 5 ring with a 10.24 ct octagonal-cut emerald that transforms into a pendant, the Sweater necklace featuring 11 emerald-cut emeralds totaling 37.18 cts, the Quilted Stars necklace with a 7.06 ct emerald-cut yellow diamond, and the Gold Slider necklaces with asscher-cut diamonds (up to 5.19 cts D FL).
args.key_excerpts: "For creating the 'Sport' High Jewelry collection, I was inspired by Chanel's sporty style, which is such an integral part of the house's history: the elegance of the line and the freedom of movement." – Patrice Leguéreau, Director of the CHANEL Jewelry Creation Studio

# Chanel Elegantly Embraces Sport with New High-Jewelry Collection

The Haute Joaillerie Sport 80-piece assortment nods to Coco Chanel's active lifestyle with sapphires, diamonds, rubies, and onyx

By [Jill Newman](https://galeriemagazine.com/author/jillnewman/)

 

![Chanel Sport's Quilted 2.55 necklace](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201920%201200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Chanel Sport’s Quilted 2.55 necklace. Photo: Courtesy of Chanel

 

Bright red stripes, sleek carbon fiber, and a playful carabiner are some of the surprising elements in Chanel’s latest [high-jewelry](https://galeriemagazine.com/chanel-watch-jewelry-boutique/) collection, [Haute Joaillerie Sport](https://www.chanel.com/us/high-jewelry/sport-collection/), inspired by its pioneering founder, [Gabrielle “Coco” Chanel](https://galeriemagazine.com/explore-gabrielle-coco-chanel-revolutionized-modern-fashion/). In the 1920s, she led an active lifestyle—horseback riding, skiing, golfing—and devised a wardrobe to suit her needs.

![Black and White earrings by Chanel](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20575%20575'%3E%3C/svg%3E) 

Black and White earrings. Photo: Courtesy of Chanel.

Unveiled for VIP clients in Monte Carlo in late June, the new offerings echo that energetic style. “The line is refined and streamlined to [create jewelry](https://galeriemagazine.com/chanel-tweed-high-jewelry/) that embraces the body’s anatomy, in the same way as sportswear,” explains Patrice Leguéreau, director of the [Chanel](https://galeriemagazine.com/chanels-diamond-encrusted-chess-set-dazzles-at-watches-and-wonders-2026/) Jewelry Creation studio. He leaned into the house’s technical savoir faire to realize transformable pieces such as the diamond and lacquer Sporty 5 necklace, which has a number 5, a wink to the iconic perfume, cleverly fashioned into an outsize link that can be attacked to the necklace or an earring.

![Graphic Line ring by Chanel.](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20575%20575'%3E%3C/svg%3E) 

Graphic Line ring. Photo: Courtesy of Chanel

The house reimagined Coco Chanel’s signature codes in both subtle and graphic ways. The Quilted 2.55 necklace, for example, is constructed in flexible diamond and black lacquer openwork patterns with a smart swivel closure borrowed from the 2.55 handbag. Other pieces boast vibrant stripes (an homage to the famed Breton sailer shirts) and bold star shapes (Coco’s first-ever fine jewelry in 1932 featured a celestial motif).

With six distinct themes underscoring the [house’s](https://galeriemagazine.com/chanel-coming-to-metropolitan-museum-art/) revolutionary roots, the 80-piece assortment brims with rare gemstones, including Kashmir sapphires, rubies, diamonds and onyx, some set into necklaces, earrings, watches and rings with bands of matching lacquer.

*A version of this article first appeared in print in our 2024 Fall Issue under the headline “Active Interest.”  [Subscribe to the magazine](https://ezsubscription.com/gal/subscribe).*

# Chanel to Receive Gem Award for High Jewelry Excellence

The luxury brand is being honored for excellence in high jewelry design in its “Haute Joaillerie Sport” collection.

[![](https://uploads.nationaljeweler.com/uploads/37e8e5ec6f9e34b2d9d1e44bb8357354.jpeg)](/search_by_authors?query=Natalie++Francisco)[Natalie Francisco](/search_by_authors?query=Natalie++Francisco)[natalie.francisco@nationaljeweler.com](mailto:natalie.francisco@nationaljeweler.com)

French luxury brand Chanel will receive the 2025 Gem Award for High Jewelry Excellence for its “Haute Joaillerie Sport” collection. Pictured is the collection’s “Quilted Stars” necklace.

New York—Jewelers of America and the Gem Awards committee have announced Chanel as the recipient of the 2025 Gem Award for High Jewelry Excellence.  
  
The award honors a brand for excellence in high jewelry design and is given to a company for a collection or series of collections that increased consumer demand for high jewelry.  
  
The 2025 award recognizes Chanel for its “Haute Joaillerie Sport” collection, introduced earlier this year.  
  
Since Gabrielle Chanel founded the high-end fashion and jewelry house at the beginning of the 20th century, it has become a leader in creating, developing, manufacturing, and distributing luxury products.   
  
JA said that Chanel high jewelry embodies the traditional French savoir faire.  
  
Each of the brand’s pieces is made entirely by hand, from the initial sketch by the Fine Jewelry Creation Studio to the construction and creation of the piece by the craftspeople in Chanel’s atelier.  
  
  [![Chanel Sweater Earrings](https://nationaljeweler.com/rails/active_storage/representations/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbmRiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19----ea15daad36a7f7266e7d591867d534d851352260/2-20241217_Chanel%20Earrings.jpg "The “Sweater” earrings by Chanel")](/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbmRiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--94e2acd9a3f66fae3bad823c1d3955d2da702f3d/2-20241217_Chanel%20Earrings.jpg)  

The “Sweater” earrings by Chanel

   
  
“The Gem Awards Committee is thrilled to present Chanel with the Gem Award for High Jewelry Excellence,” said JA’s Director of PR and Events Amanda Gizzi.  
  
“The ‘Haute Joaillerie Sport’ collection showcased the artistic creativity and the craftsmanship that Chanel is famous for, while simultaneously providing fresh designs that have consumers excited about the high jewelry category.”

 Related stories will be right here …

The Gem Award for High Jewelry Excellence will be presented along with awards in the categories of Lifetime Achievement, [Jewelry Design, Media Excellence, and Retail Innovation](https://nationaljeweler.com/articles/13369-these-designers-journalists-and-retailers-are-up-for-a-gem-award%20) at the Gem Awards gala.  
  
As previously announced, New England jeweler [John Green](https://nationaljeweler.com/articles/13256-longtime-new-england-jeweler-to-receive-gem-award-for-lifetime-achievement%20) will receive the Lifetime Achievement award.  
   
The winners in the categories of Jewelry Design, Media Excellence, and Retail Innovation will be revealed live at the gala.  
  
The 2025 Gem Awards gala is set to take place March 14 at Cipriani 42nd Street in New York City.  
  
For more information and to purchase sponsorships, tickets, and advertising opportunities, visit the Gem Awards [website](https://gemawards.jewelers.org/).

1. Identify and preserve the main topic or purpose of the webpage.

3. Keep important quotes from credible sources or experts.
4. Maintain the chronological order of events if the content is time-sensitive or historical.
5. Preserve any lists or step-by-step instructions if present.
6. Include relevant dates, names, and locations that are crucial to understanding the content.
7. Summarize lengthy explanations while keeping the core message intact.

When handling different types of content:

- For news articles: Focus on the who, what, when, where, why, and how.
- For scientific content: Preserve methodology, results, and conclusions.
- For opinion pieces: Maintain the main arguments and supporting points.
- For product pages: Keep key features, specifications, and unique selling points.

Your summary should be significantly shorter than the original content but comprehensive enough to stand alone as a source of information. Aim for about 25-30 percent of the original length, unless the content is already concise.

This article from National Jeweler (Dec 17, 2024) reports that French luxury brand Chanel will receive the 2025 Gem Award for High Jewelry Excellence, presented by Jewelers of America (JA) and the Gem Awards committee. The award honors Chanel for its "Haute Joaillerie Sport" collection, introduced earlier in 2024, which JA says increased consumer demand for high jewelry. Chanel, founded by Gabrielle Chanel at the beginning of the 20th century, is recognized for its traditional French savoir faire, with each piece made entirely by hand from initial sketch by the Fine Jewelry Creation Studio to construction by craftspeople in the Chanel atelier. JA's Director of PR and Events Amanda Gizzi praised the collection for showcasing Chanel's artistic creativity and craftsmanship while providing fresh designs that excite consumers about the high jewelry category. The award will be presented at the 2025 Gem Awards gala on March 14 at Cipriani 42nd Street in New York City, alongside awards for Lifetime Achievement, Jewelry Design, Media Excellence, and Retail Innovation. New England jeweler John Green was previously announced as the Lifetime Achievement award recipient, with other category winners to be revealed live at the gala.

The article also includes the National Jeweler homepage with navigation for its sections (Industry, Diamonds & Gems, Style, Opinions, Videos, Magazines) and features numerous recent jewelry industry news stories, including: Mike Alexander succeeding Scott Murphy as Jewelers Mutual CEO in 2027, Spinelli Kilcollin's trade-in program for "dupes" rings, two California men arrested in a fatal vehicle smash robbery, Vasant Mehta (diamond industry leader) passing at 81, Zales' new "You Are The Occasion" campaign, Ring Concierge's collaboration with Kendall Jenner's 818 Tequila, a 2,488-carat diamond from Botswana finding a new owner, Pandora's second-quarter results, a new AI-powered gemstone identification app, The Plumb Club's 2026-2027 board election, and various other jewelry industry updates.
args.key_excerpts: "The Gem Awards Committee is thrilled to present Chanel with the Gem Award for High Jewelry Excellence," said JA's Director of PR and Events Amanda Gizzi. "The 'Haute Joaillerie Sport' collection showcased the artistic creativity and the craftsmanship that Chanel is famous for, while simultaneously providing fresh designs that have consumers excited about the high jewelry category."

# Chanel Reveals Haute Joaillerie Collection Inspired by Sport

Chanel captures the spirit of Gabrielle Chanel in its new Haute Joaillerie Sport collection.

Words

[Ella Danson](https://elitetraveler.com/author/elladanson)

Share

![](https://elitetraveler.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/8/2024/07/GOLDSLIDERSAPPHIRERING_J659031-min-1024x960.jpg)  

Chanel Gold Slider Ring in 18K white gold, yellow gold, diamonds, sapphire and rubies

Chanel has unveiled its latest high-end [jewelry](https://elitetraveler.com/shopping-lifestyle/jewelry/bulgari-high-jewelry-aeterna-rome) collection, ‘Haute Joaillerie Sport, ‘ inspired by the iconic sporty style integral to the house’s history. Crafted by visionary jewelry designer Patrice Leguéreau, the collection brings a fresh perspective to high jewelry in a celebration of timeless elegance and freedom of movement.

Gabrielle Chanel revolutionized fashion by introducing elements of sportswear into high fashion. Her designs reflected her lifestyle, creating clothes for the “active and independent woman.” She believed clothing should not restrict but enhance a woman’s natural grace and mobility. In 1921, she established a “Sport” atelier within her couture house, introducing innovative materials such as tweed and jersey, which had been prominently used for men’s underwear, emphasizing movement, functionality, and comfort in a time of corsets and bustiers.

[*[See also: Spring into Style with Nature-inspired Jewelry*]](https://elitetraveler.com/shopping-lifestyle/jewelry/spring-nature-jewelry-2024)

![Chanel Sporty 5 Black & White Necklace](https://elitetraveler.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/8/2024/07/SPORTY5BLACKWHITENECKLACE_J65949-min-2560x2560.jpg)

Chanel Sporty 5 Black & White Necklace in 18K white gold, diamonds, red and black lacquer

 ![Chanel Print Necklace](https://elitetraveler.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/8/2024/07/CHANELPRINTNECKLACE_J657341-min.jpg)

Chanel Print Necklace in 18K white gold, diamonds and black lacquer / ©Chanel

 ![Chanel Sweater Transformable Ring](https://elitetraveler.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/8/2024/07/SWEATERTRANSFORMABLERING_J65759-min.jpg)

Chanel Sweater Transformable Ring in 18K white gold, diamonds and onyx / ©Chanel

This new collection reinterprets this legacy, integrating the dynamism and functionality of sportswear into haute joaillerie for the first time. “I was inspired by Chanel’s sporty style, which is such an integral part of the house’s history: the elegance of the line and the freedom of movement,” explains Leguéreau.

The Haute Joaillerie Sport collection symbolizes the fusion of elegance and performance. Sport is synonymous with discipline, dedication, and the pursuit of excellence, qualities that are also central to high jewelry craftsmanship. Each piece is created to celebrate the dynamic lifestyle of modern wearers in a blend of fashion and function. The collection emphasizes ergonomic and transformable design, with pieces designed to move with the body, celebrating the freedom of movement.

*[[See also: The Girard-Perregaux Casquette Gets its 2024 Update]](https://elitetraveler.com/shopping-lifestyle/watches-shopping-lifestyle/girard-perregaux-casquette-saint-laurent-02)*

![Chanel Gold Slider Black White Necklace](https://elitetraveler.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/8/2024/07/GOLDSLIDERBLACKWHITETRANSFORMABLENECKLACE_J658701-min.jpg)

Chanel Gold Slider Black & White Necklace in 18K white gold, diamonds, red lacquer, black and white ceramic / ©Chanel

Iconic symbols from Chanel’s legacy are reimagined in a fusion of art, design and athleticism. The timeless N°5 is reimagined in a bold “Chronometer” typography, the lion set in a coat of arms and the star as a symbol of victory.

For the first time, the Chanel logo appears in haute joaillerie, introduced as an openwork imprint, a technique of meticulous metal cutting to create intricate patterns that are both delicate and durable. The chevron motif, symbolizing rhythm and speed, is a recurring element. The designs also feature tapered volumes and smooth contours, with dynamic lines of color infusing energy into each piece.

The collection showcases Chanel’s technical expertise by merging traditional craftsmanship with modern technology. Innovative connection systems and quick-release fittings are inspired by sports equipment and serve as both functional elements and aesthetic features. Clasps are reimagined; the N°5 karabiner, the swivel clasp from the 2.55 bag, and an array of buckles and loops enhance the jewelry’s practicality and style. The qui ted motif is transformed into a supple openwork mesh, embellished with sport motifs, and a specially developed “sport cord” tube chain adds to the collection’s uniqueness.

![Chanel Sporty 5 Earrings](https://elitetraveler.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/8/2024/07/SPORTY5EARRINGS_J658853-min.jpg)

Chanel Sporty N°5 Earrings in 18K white gold and diamonds / ©Chanel

The collection also showcases a blend of precious and high-tech materials. Aluminum, known for its lightweight and resistant properties, is introduced in unusual colors. Carbon fiber, renowned for its low density and high resistance, is used to create an ultra-lightweight sports cuff. Lacquer is employed to expand the color palette, perfectly matching the hues of precious stones and adding vibrancy to the collection.

Offering a stunning array of vivid gemstones, among the highlights is a set of five Kashmir sapphires, a remarkable achievement resulting from years of research. The collection uses two-tone and three-tone contrasts to enhance the vibrancy of the colored stones, while their shapes subtly emphasize the ergonomic design of the jewelry.

Designs inspired by nature, underwater worlds, and celestial bodies reflected technical virtuosity and craftsmanship mastery.

![Lazy loaded image]()

Milan Bureau Chief

### Recent Articles by Luisa Zargani

![Dior High Jewelry photographed for WWD in on May 26, 2026 in Venice, Italy.](https://wwd.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/dior-high-jewelry-2026-GG-05.jpg?w=1000&h=563&crop=1)

Models wearing the delicately sparkling gems and [couture](https://wwd.com/tag/couture-2/) gowns designed by creative director [Jonathan Anderson](https://wwd.com/runway/resort-2027/los-angeles/christian-dior/review/) weaved their way around the burgundy velvet seats and gaming tables in the 1930s building, which is peppered with [Art Deco](https://wwd.com/home-design/furniture/deco-design-future-1238679209/) references.

Talking to clients, she realized “they really understand that the mood of the collection is joyful and that there is something childish in the pieces that touches them, because I am told they love this spirit, the little scenes. ![Dior High Jewelry photographed for WWD in on May 26, 2026 in Venice, Italy.](https://wwd.com/wp-content/themes/vip/pmc-wwd-2021/assets/public/lazyload-fallback.gif)

The Diorissima lucky clover set with a 6.51-carat untreated emerald from Colombia stood as the central stone, surrounded by leaves created by an opal doublet on a chrysoprase base, or a green chalcedony doublet on a turquoise base.

Another standout was the Glycines bib necklace with pink rubies and light pink sapphires and 12 certified pink spinels from Tanzania totaling 12.52 carats, and more than 4,100 stones.

Seaweed, corals, anemones and bubbles were part of the underwater worlds theme. Here, the Fleur Aquatique necklace shimmered around a central Paraiba-type tourmaline of 4.75 carats.

The celestial bodies group dripped in constellations, stellar forms, shining suns, shooting stars, clouds and rainbows. The Voie Lactée necklace with 3,000 stones sparkled with white diamonds around the central 7.03-carat diamond with an interplay of round-cut and pear-cut diamonds.

![Dior High Jewelry photographed for WWD in on May 26, 2026 in Venice, Italy.](https://wwd.com/wp-content/themes/vip/pmc-wwd-2021/assets/public/lazyload-fallback.gif)

Lacquer, applied in technical touches or as bold flat surfaces in pastel or fluo tones, brought depth, intensity and contrast to each composition. Intricate layered motifs, in the spirit of collage, created volumes and a sense of movement. Precious backgrounds were created using the doublet technique, which involves layering one thin stone over another — such as opal over chrysoprase — to bring out subtly hued gradations — and reflecting the intense craftsmanship involved. Opaque lacquers or lacquered mother-of-pearl created intense colors, enhancing the brilliance of the gems.

“I like to play with colors because I love them and I always want to push them, even more than the stones,” said de Castellane.

The designer said that the Diorissima moniker was a way “to play with the original Diorissimo [fragrance] and offer a feminine version. Also, it a superlative, referencing more color, more daring designs and techniques, and more precious jewels.”

The playful mood was also reflected by the modular pieces since brooches can be worn as hair clips and bracelets transformed into choker necklaces. Also, she underscored how collections are timeless and can be mixed and matched together.

![Dior High Jewelry photographed for WWD in on May 26, 2026 in Venice, Italy.](https://wwd.com/wp-content/themes/vip/pmc-wwd-2021/assets/public/lazyload-fallback.gif)

“I’m still the same, I have been designing for Dior for 30 years and I have the same way of working, with a lot of freedom. My inspiration starts more with words or feelings and I draw a common thread between the previous collection to develop the next one.

 “I love my work and I’m very happy, because I work with fantastic people, very good and nice teams,” she concluded. “It’s a real privilege to work with the most beautiful stones, and to see also people who are creating the dream that you had at the beginning, and then the dream is realized. That is fantastic for me.”

The event took place on Tuesday evening and featured a cocktail, gala dinner, and fashion show with couture gowns designed by Christian Dior creative director Jonathan Anderson, who created 20 specially designed gowns for the presentation.

The collection combines abstract themes with naturalism across three groups: botanical universe, underwater worlds, and celestial bodies—all reflecting founder Christian Dior's personal passions. The designs feature whimsical interplay of shapes, cutouts, colors, overlapping motifs, and sculptural volumes celebrating the art of collage, paying tribute to artists admired by Dior's founder including Henri Matisse and Pablo Picasso.

Key pieces from the 141 total creations (112 presented in Venice) include: the Diorissima lucky clover set with a 6.51-carat untreated Colombian emerald; the Glycines bib necklace with pink rubies, light pink sapphires, and 12 certified pink spinels from Tanzania totaling 12.52 carats with over 4,100 stones; the Fleur Aquatique necklace featuring a central 4.75-carat Paraiba-type tourmaline; and the Voie Lactée necklace with 3,000 stones around a central 7.03-carat diamond. The Diorissima name plays on the original Diorissimo fragrance, offering "a feminine version" and serving as a superlative referencing more color, daring designs, and more precious jewels. args.summary:
This webpage is a YouTube vlog (by creator "Kara | Fashion Style Shopping Trends") documenting her experience at the Van Cleef & Arpels "The Poetry of Time" Exhibition 2024 in London. The exhibition ran from 26 May to 9 June 2024 (preview event attended by the vlogger before the public opening) and was set in an "Enchanted Forest" immersive experience. The exhibition showcased the maison's finest watches and jewellery.

Key pieces highlighted in the vlog include:
- Heritage/museum section featuring original pieces: hidden bracelet watches, lighters, a 1965 watch with a very small face (indicative of the era when women were discouraged from wearing watches), and an iconic Alhambra necklace from 1973/1976.
- Zodiac range watches representing different star signs.
- Brise d'été (new collection) — watches with flower self-winding movement where the bottom three flowers move as time passes.
- Féerique (Fairy) collection — enamel, white gold, and sapphire watches featuring fairies with butterflies, with diamond-set minute displays.
- Éveil du Cyclamen — the exhibition's centrepiece automaton; on the hour, cyclamen flowers open slowly to reveal a flickering butterfly with a melody, then close again until the next hour.
- Papillon automatic watch — features a butterfly on the left; the more the watch is worn, the more the battery recharges and the more the butterfly moves.
- Ballerina collection — on the hour, the petals of the ballerina's skirt flutter.
- Perlée jewellery collection — including a new addition combining diamond Perlée with the newest pieces, available in diamond, sapphire, and emerald versions with yellow gold.
- Pont des Amoureux (Lovers' Bridge) — four seasonal-inspired dials featuring a Parisian bridge; at midnight, the lady and man meet and kiss. The lady represents hours, the man represents minutes. Straps are made of diamonds.
- Floral collection — self-winding watches inspired by different flower species opening and closing at different times; time is read by counting opened flower heads rather than numbers. The message is "take the time to read the time."

The exhibition was only open for two weeks in London and was expected to move to a different city afterward. The vlogger was invited by "my ESS" (likely a sponsor/partner) to the preview.

## 2. Manhattan Adornment

Like the exquisite adornments of Manhattan’s celebrated landmarks, sapphires, pink sapphires, aquamarines, and diamonds form a spectacular display.

![Portrait of a man with glasses and short black hair against a plain background.](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB3aWR0aD0iMSIgaGVpZ2h0PSIxIiB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciPjwvc3ZnPg==)

Synonymous with spectacular style, the jewel makes a brilliant statement upon its wearer.

## 3. 718 Marble Marquetry

High jewelry designs from the Marble Marquetry suite recall the intricate marble detailing of the House’s Fifth Avenue Flagship Salon.

![Portrait of a man with glasses and short black hair against a plain background.](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB3aWR0aD0iMSIgaGVpZ2h0PSIxIiB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciPjwvc3ZnPg==)

Nodding to the elaborate marble detailing of the House”‘s Fifth Avenue Flagship Salon, this high jewelry necklace captivates with geometric motifs and opulent accents. Handcrafted with vibrant precious gemstones and sparkling diamonds, jewels from the Brownstone suite are exquisite odes to the stately architecture of New York City.

![Portrait of a man with glasses and short black hair against a plain background.](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB3aWR0aD0iMSIgaGVpZ2h0PSIxIiB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciPjwvc3ZnPg==)

# Winston With Love

This exceptional fine jewelry collection chronicles the extraordinary phases of love with diamonds and colorful gemstones. Like an acrostic poem, each letter represents a different phase of love, from the first light of affection, to a passionate obsession, to the ultimate vow and an eternity together. With each phase, the feelings of love grow stronger and more meaningful. This gemstone jewelry collection offers a modern interpretation of the signature Harry Winston aesthetic and consists of 39 pieces separated into 4 unique chapters: L ─ Winston Light, O ─ Winston Obsession, V ─ Winston Vow, and E ─ Winston Eternal. Discover all of love's magnificent possibilities in this exceptional collection of gemstone rings, earrings, and necklaces.

![Letters "L", "O", "V", "E" on a colorful background]()

## The Power of Love

The intensity of love is unrivaled. The House of Harry Winston explores this inimitable experience through incredible jewels. Like rare diamonds and gemstones, love is a force of nature not to be reckoned with. This is Winston with Love.

![The Brilliant Glow Necklace on a layered yellow platform]()

## L. Winston Light

The first phase of love glows with excitement and light, expressed in colorful, luminous jewels assembled with extraordinary artistry. The exquisite high jewelry suite Brilliant Glow demonstrates the House’s breathtaking gem-setting expertise. The centerpiece of the suite is a one-of-a-kind necklace that exudes the fluidity of a piece of fabric as it delicately graces the neck with a brilliant composition of diamonds, yellow diamonds, pink sapphires, spessartites, and rubies.

![Harry Winston jewel on a yellow letter L on a yellow background]()
![Harry Winston jewels on a layered yellow background]()
![The Dancing Flames Necklace on a layered red platform]()

## O. Winston Obsession

Fiery, breathtaking gems in shades of orange, purple, and red express the intense heat of the second phase of love, obsession. The Dancing Flames series consists of two high jewelry suites that pair vibrant gems with diamonds in splendid and modern settings.

![Dancing Flames jewel on a red letter O on a red background]()
![Harry Winston gemstone earrings on a red layered background]()
![Harry Winston gemstone rings and earrings on a red layered background]()
![The Winston Promise Pendant and Earrings]()

## V. Winston Vow

In the third phase of love, romantic rubies, yellow and white diamonds, and pink sapphires express true commitment with a resonant and symbolic heart motif. The Winston Promise pendant, ring, and earrings take the shape of elaborately designed hearts set in rose gold.

![Harry Winston diamond and ruby necklace on an orange letter V on an orange background]()
![Harry Winston diamond and ruby ring and earrings on an orange layered background]()
![Harry Winston Endless Love Necklace on a purple layered background]()

## E. Winston Eternal

Remarkable gemstone jewelry that seems to have no beginning or end marks the fourth phase of love, eternity. These ideal representations of undying love are made to astonish. The signature twist motif of the Endless Love suite is an inspiring symbol of the intertwining of two destinies.

![Harry Winston Sweet Heart earrings on a purple letter E on a purple background]()
![Harry Winston Sweet Heart earrings on a purple letter E on a purple background]()
![Luxury showroom featuring jewelry display case of the Harry Winston Salon]()

Three Necklaces from the Talk to Me, Harry Winston Collection

A fair-skinned female model in a white evening gown is shown wearing three necklaces from the Talk to Me, Harry Winston Collection. First, the camera zooms in on the Paraiba and Diamond Necklace featuring a 16.10 carat triangular turquoise Paraiba tourmaline, and a 5.01 carat pear-shaped yellow diamond surrounded by pear-shaped diamonds. Next, the model is shown wearing the Cabochon Sapphire Necklace before the camera zooms in the necklace's stunning 65.61 carat sugarloaf sapphire center stone. Finally, the model is shown wearing the necklace, tiara and earrings from the Yellow Diamond and Diamond Suite.

## 

### Talk to Me, Harry Winston

The Talk to Me, Harry Winston Collection tells the story of the House through extraordinary one-of-a-kind jewels, capturing its glamour, artistry, and brilliance. Divided into three chapters—"King of Diamonds," "Rare Jeweler of the World," and "Jeweler to the Stars," — the collection celebrates the House’s unrivaled heritage and enduring vision. Each jewel is a dazzling conversation between past and present, illuminating the genius of Mr. Winston for today’s collectors.

![]()
![]()

## 

### "King of Diamonds"

Crowned the “King of Diamonds” by Cosmopolitan magazine in 1947, Mr. Winston built his reputation on transforming the world’s most extraordinary gems into incredible jewels. From legendary diamonds to coveted rubies, emeralds, and sapphires, his discerning eye and daring acquisitions made his name synonymous with rarity and brilliance. The "King of Diamonds" chapter celebrates this enduring legacy through one-of-a-kind creations that showcase the magnificence of the finest gemstones.

![]()

### Triangular-Cut Paraiba and Diamond Necklace

The 16.10 carat triangular Paraiba tourmaline center stone, accented by a luminous 5.01 carat yellow diamond and more than 65 carats of diamonds, embodies Mr. Winston's philosophy that the most beautiful gems deserve to be celebrated and shared with the world.

Talk to Me, Harry Winston Art Deco Suite

The video opens with a close-up of the Sapphire and Diamond pendant-style necklace from the Talk to Me, Harry Winston Collection. This stunning necklace is presented on a pale gray background that highlights the exceptional quality and intense color of the large octagonal-cut sapphire, which is surrounded by glittering baguette-cut and pear-shaped diamonds.

### Art Deco Sapphire Suite

With rare octagonal sapphires, this exceptional suite exemplifies Mr. Winston's reputation as the "Genius of Gems," uniting the structured elegance of the Art Deco era with contemporary sophistication.

![]()
![]()

The "King of Diamonds" chapter celebrates the House's unmatched commitment to extraordinary gemstones and its ability to transform them into iconic, one-of-a-kind jewels.

### Oval-Shaped Paraiba and Diamond Necklace

Among the rarest gemstones on earth—just one Paraiba tourmaline for every 10,000 diamonds mined—this remarkable 29.09-carat oval is even rarer for its size, color saturation, and transparency.

![]()![]()

### Yellow Diamond Necklace

Cradled in light, the setting fluidly carries the eye toward the 40.81-carat radiant-cut yellow diamond. The design embodies the philosophy at the center of the House: that the world's most extraordinary gems deserve nothing less than extraordinary settings.

### Yellow Diamond and Diamond Timepiece

The timepiece elevates horological artistry to new heights, with a pavé yellow diamond dial complemented by Asscher-cut yellow diamonds along the bracelet.

![]()
![]()

## 

### "Rare Jeweler of the World"

Known as the “Rare Jeweler of the World,” Mr. Winston possessed a remarkable eye for gemstones and knew how to set them to their best advantage. The “Rare Jeweler of the World” chapter explores one-of-a-kind creations that transform incredible gemstones and designs into veritable works of art, full of movement and life.

Talk to Me, Harry Winston Cabochon Sapphire Necklace

The video opens with a head shot of an elegantly dressed, fair-skinned model wearing the Cabochon Sapphire necklace from the Talk to Me, Harry Winston Collection. The camera zooms in on this pendant-style necklace, highlighting the incredible beauty of the magnificent 65.61 carat sugarloaf sapphire , which is surrounded by a diamond necklace comprised of custom-cut pyramid-shaped diamonds.

### Cabochon Sapphire Necklace

The necklace showcases a magnificent 65.61 carat sugarloaf sapphire. Embodying Mr. Winston's legacy as the "Rare Jeweler of the World," the center stone is poised at the center of a diamond necklace comprised of custom-cut pyramid-shaped diamonds.

## Being in the right hands is the ultimate responsibility of every diamond buyer.

![]()

Talk to Me, Harry Winston Yellow Diamond and Diamond Suite

A close-up shot shows the Yellow Diamond and Diamond Necklace from the Talk to Me, Harry Winston Collection posed against a white background. The camera zooms in on this collar-style necklace, highlighting the incredible beauty of the two rows of pear-shaped diamonds separated by rows of round brilliant diamonds, which create a harmonious cascade composition that frames the magnificent 6.53 carat fancy intense yellow diamond center stone.

### Yellow Diamond and Diamond Suite

From a necklace to a tiara, the suite dazzles with a medley of pear-shaped diamonds crowned by exceptional fancy intense yellow center stones—with each piece radiating golden brilliance.

![]()

### Yellow Diamond and Diamond Necklace

The Yellow Diamond and Diamond Suite celebrates the elegance of pear-shaped diamonds—a signature of Winston design for nearly a century. With two rows of pear-shaped diamonds separated by rows of round brilliant diamonds leading to a striking 6.53 carat fancy intense yellow diamond, the jewels demonstrate the House's continued commitment to the iconic diamond shape.

![]()![]()

## 

### "Jeweler to the Stars"

Mr. Winston understood the transformative power of jewels on the red carpet, where diamonds could turn a moment into legend. Under flashing lights and the gaze of the world, his creations sparkled like no other, earning him the title of “Jeweler to the Stars." This chapter celebrates the House's enduring legacy with high jewelry creations designed to capture light, command attention, and embody cinematic allure.

Talk to Me, Harry Winston Diamond Cascading Necklace

A close-up shot shows a fair-skinned female model dressed in a white evening gown wearing the Diamond Cascading Necklace from the Talk to Me, Harry Winston Collection. The camera zooms in on the 266 diamonds set in a flattering and flowing V-shaped design. The center stone is a magnificent 5.03 carat pear-shaped diamond.

### Diamond Cascading Necklace

Glittering with 266 diamonds in a fluid V-shaped design, this one-of-a-kind creation evokes Mr. Winston's belief that Hollywood's brightest moments deserve jewels as exceptional as the stars themselves. Finished with a magnificent 5.03 carat pear-shaped diamond, the piece captures the red carpet glamour that has made Harry Winston synonymous with unforgettable moments.

![]()

The "Jeweler to the Stars" chapter shines with bold, theatrical designs that dazzle with movement and light. Each jewel embodies drama and elegance, crafted to transform life’s grandest stages into unforgettable moments.

### Yellow Diamond Brooch

This Brooch captures Mr. Winston’s flair for spectacle, centered on a 9.81 carat fancy intense yellow diamond. Cascading strands and looping ribbons of diamonds add drama and movement, making it a true celebration of incredible gems.

This webpage is Harry Winston's official presentation of the "Talk to Me, Harry Winston" high jewelry collection, which tells the story of the House through one-of-a-kind jewels. The collection is divided into three chapters celebrating the legacy of founder Harry Winston.

**Chapter 1: "King of Diamonds"** — Named after the title Cosmopolitan magazine gave Mr. Winston in 1947 for his mastery of transforming extraordinary gems into incredible jewels. Key pieces include:
- **Triangular-Cut Paraiba and Diamond Necklace**: Features a 16.10 carat triangular Paraiba tourmaline, a 5.01 carat yellow diamond, and over 65 carats of diamonds.
- **Art Deco Sapphire Suite**: Comprised of rare octagonal sapphires uniting Art Deco elegance with contemporary sophistication.
- **Oval-Shaped Paraiba and Diamond Necklace**: Features a 29.09-carat oval Paraiba tourmaline (noting that only one Paraiba tourmaline exists for every 10,000 diamonds mined).
- **Yellow Diamond Necklace**: Features a 40.81-carat radiant-cut yellow diamond.
- **Yellow Diamond and Diamond Timepiece**: Features a pavé yellow diamond dial with Asscher-cut yellow diamonds along the bracelet.

**Chapter 2: "Rare Jeweler of the World"** — Celebrates creations that transform gemstones into works of art full of movement and life. Key pieces include:
- **Cabochon Sapphire Necklace**: Features a magnificent 65.61 carat sugarloaf sapphire surrounded by custom-cut pyramid-shaped diamonds.
- **Yellow Diamond and Diamond Suite**: Includes a necklace featuring two rows of pear-shaped diamonds with a 6.53 carat fancy intense yellow diamond center stone, plus a matching tiara and earrings.

**Chapter 3: "Jeweler to the Stars"** — Celebrates the House's legacy of red carpet glamour and cinematic allure. Key pieces include:
- **Diamond Cascading Necklace**: Contains 266 diamonds in a fluid V-shaped design with a 5.03 carat pear-shaped diamond center stone.
- **Yellow Diamond Brooch**: Features a 9.81 carat fancy intense yellow diamond with cascading strands and looping diamond ribbons.

The page also includes a quote: "Being in the right hands is the ultimate responsibility of every diamond buyer." It showcases product imagery, subscription options, and standard Harry Winston corporate/social media links.
