Tatler Singapore visits the Eternal City, the home of Bvlgari, for the unveiling of the Aeterna collection, created in celebration of its 140th anniversary

When it comes to high jewellery launches, no brand does it quite like Bvlgari. The Italian luxury watch and jewellery house pulls out all the stops for each one, hosting the most magnificent galas and exclusive events in breathtaking locations attended by a star‑studded guest list.

*Tatler Singapore* was present at the launch of its Mediterranea high jewellery collection in the grand Doge’s Palace in Venice last year and was invited back to Italy in May this year, on Bvlgari’s 140th anniversary, to witness the unveiling of yet another incredible range of high jewellery crafted to mark the milestone. The pieces this time hail from the brand’s Aeterna collection, comprising more than 500 creations spanning high jewellery, high jewellery watches, luxury bags and fragrances.

***In case you missed it: [Exclusive: All roads lead to Rome with Bvlgari’s Aeterna high jewellery collection](https://www.tatlerasia.com/style/jewellery/tatler-exclusive-bulgari-aeterna-high-jewellery-collection-rome)***

![Tatler Asia](//assets.tatlerasia.com/common/tatler-placeholder.svg)

 ![]()

Di atas The showroom presentation of select high jewellery pieces from Bvlgari’s Aeterna collection in Rome, Italy

The showroom presentation of select high jewellery pieces from Bvlgari’s Aeterna collection in Rome, Italy

![](https://cdn.tatlerasia.com/tatlerasia/i/2024/08/13143752-31a9516-2_cover_1600x900.jpg)

Going back to its roots as a Roman jeweller, Bvlgari had once again looked to the Eternal City, its birthplace and boundless source of inspiration, to create a collection that encapsulates its rich legacy with masterpieces that will endure for time to come—like how the brand has. And indeed, the Aeterna jewels are the most extraordinary high‑end examples the brand has ever presented. These precious expressions were officially launched at an exclusive gala dinner held at one of Rome’s hidden treasures: the Terme di Diocleziano—the largest public bath complex in ancient Rome spanning more than 32 acres, built between 298 and 306 AD. While not as famous as some of the other landmarks in the Italian capital, it is known as one of the world’s most monumental antique architectural complexes and is part of the National Roman Museum.

The ancient ruins and stately sculptures amidst the sweeping grounds of the baths made for the perfect setting for the event. The historic site mirrored the sheer magnitude and magnificence of the Roman brand. The occasion was even more significant as it was the first time a private company had been authorised to occupy the whole site for a major event.

Some of the biggest celebrities, including Bvlgari’s brand ambassadors Anne Hathaway, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Liu Yifei, Shu Qi, Hikari Mori and Alessandro Gassmann, were in attendance and dazzled in Aeterna high jewellery pieces. Chopra Jonas, in particular, stole the show with the star piece of the collection: the Serpenti Aeterna necklace, the most precious high jewellery piece ever crafted by the Roman brand. The jaw‑dropping necklace features seven D flawless diamond drops, all cut from the same rough and totalling 140 carats, symbolising the brand’s 140th anniversary. It is further enhanced with 698 baguette diamonds weighing 61.81 carats.

Upon arrival, guests were invited to enjoy cocktails and canapés before being ushered to the Chiostro Ludovisi, a veranda built over the Terme di Diocleziano’s large outdoor pool, to be seated for the show. As the sun started to set, a moving dance duet by Italian ballet dancer Eleonora Abbagnato and choreographer and dancer Sadeck Berrabah began, followed by a unique and captivating choreography by Berrabah and 80 dancers who moved in sync, performing with just their upper bodies.

Then, it was time for the main event: the jewellery show. To a rousing rendition of Nina Simone’s *Feeling Good*, models strutted out in spectacular Aeterna creations that sparkled in the night. Guests were delighted to see some surprise familiar faces on the runway, such as the iconic Italian models Mariacarla Boscono, Elisabetta Dessy, Isabella Rossellini and Carla Bruni.

The breathtaking show was followed by a gala dinner at Chiostro di Michelangelo, a cloister in the Terme, with a menu specially designed by Italian chef Massimiliano Alajmo of the three‑Michelin‑starred Le Calandre. Ending the night on a high note was internationally acclaimed Italian singer‑songwriter Elisa, who treated guests to a live performance.

#### Once in a Lifetime

Ahead of this memorable evening, *Tatler Singapore* had a preview of the Aeterna high jewellery creations, which we got up close to at a showcase held within the Terme di Diocleziano earlier that day. A selection of key pieces, including the one‑of‑a‑kind Serpenti Aeterna necklace, were presented in displays inspired by the work of Italian architect Lina Bo Bardi.

These were set against stunning reinterpretations of architect Giovanni Battista Piranesi’s prints, rendered on exquisite custom‑made tapestries realised with the high‑density jacquard technique by historic Venetian weaving specialists Rubelli.

Speaking to *Tatler Singapore* in an interview at the Terme, Bvlgari’s chief executive officer Jean‑Christophe Babin reflects on the brand’s momentous milestone: “When I think about the [past] 140 years, what crosses my mind is that we’re crafting for eternity. Pieces we crafted one century ago are probably worn by some of our clients’ daughters, granddaughters or great‑granddaughters today. We’ve left them a legacy [that] till today is still important emotionally to many people who trusted Bvlgari back in the late 19th century, in the mid‑20th century, and till more recently. Therefore, we stand for eternity. Every single piece we craft is made not only with precious materials that last forever, like diamonds, rubies, gold and platinum, but also, our style is timeless. So you buy eternity in two ways: timeless value and timeless wearability.”

***Read more:*** ***[How Bulgari’s Serpenti has evolved over 75 years](https://www.tatlerasia.com/style/jewellery/how-bulgari-serpenti-has-evolved-over-75-years)***

The new Serpenti Aeterna necklace is a fitting embodiment of this concept of eternity. Requiring more than 2,800 hours to complete, this gem of a necklace is testament to the house’s dedication to pushing boundaries. A rough diamond of a whopping 200 carats acquired by Bvlgari was cut to create the seven D flawless diamond drops on the necklace, which are seemingly embraced by a sinuous three‑dimensional wave structure in platinum that comes fully set with baguette diamonds. With the flexibility of a snake, this structure undulates across the neck, culminating in a clasp at the back that takes the form of a serpent’s head with its tail in its mouth, like an ouroboros (an ancient symbol depicting a serpent eating its own tail) guarding this masterpiece and representing an eternal cycle of rebirth.

“We’ve all seen big diamonds before, but you’ve probably never seen big diamonds that come from one single rough, all of the same D flawless quality. This, I think, is a once‑in‑a‑century occurrence, so at the moment, this is the single most important diamond necklace of this current century,” says Babin.

“Hidden” [Serpenti motif](https://www.tatlerasia.com/style/jewellery/tatler-gmt-ion-orchard-watches-jewellery-2023-event-bulgari-serpenti) aside, the CEO notes that the Serpenti Aeterna surprises also because the creation, made entirely of platinum and set with only white diamonds, is an unexpected showpiece for a brand that is renowned for its prowess in coloured gemstones.

![Tatler Asia](//assets.tatlerasia.com/common/tatler-placeholder.svg)

“Usually, when people define Bvlgari, they say we’re the master of coloured gems, which is true. I think no one is better than Bvlgari in daring to combine such unexpected shapes and colours together, and this has been the signature of the brand,” he expounds. However, Babin reveals that the Roman jeweller’s first high jewellery creations were made only in platinum and predominantly featured diamonds.

“If you go to our heritage collections from the 1920s and ’30s, you won’t find [many] coloured gems,” he says. “Save for a combination of diamonds with maybe one sapphire or one ruby, we’ve been in diamonds [almost] exclusively till the Second World War. Restrictions on platinum and diamonds during that war led us to turn to gold and coloured gems. We adapted and evolved our style, which then became our signature, as it was totally new in high jewellery and made us go from an Italian darling to a global one.”

The Serpenti Aeterna, therefore, is Bvlgari’s way of reminding the world of its beginnings. “It’s a way to pay tribute to our founders and show that not only are we an expert in coloured gems, [but] we’ve also always been and still are a master of diamonds,” says Babin.

#### Now and Forever

Many more exceptional high jewellery creations can be found in the Aeterna collection, including the Aurea Chandra, an attention‑grabbing spherical choker that channels the daring spirit of the exuberant 1980s. Five alternating rows of plain and diamond‑set pink gold spheres coil around the neck, their gentle curves lending a softness to the strong statement piece.

In honour of Bvlgari’s Roman origins and heritage, the Monete Aeterna Augustus Emerald sautoir encapsulates the brand’s past, present and future with its central imperial bronze coin. Minted during the reign of former Roman emperor Tiberius, it depicts the profile of the first Roman emperor, Augustus, for whom the Ara Pacis Augustae, a monument symbolising the empire’s power and prosperity, was commissioned and whose mausoleum faces the Bvlgari Hotel Roma. This necklace, which was modelled by Rossellini during the jewellery show, is completed with 149 identical emerald beads totalling 615.04 carats, 80 buff‑top emeralds, and pavé diamonds.

Looking ahead to the rest of 2024, Babin shares a hint of what else is in store for the 140th anniversary celebrations. “As the name suggests, Aeterna is something that’s limitless. We’ve started in Rome with the global collection presentation, but this collection is like a living animal; like a snake,” says Babin. “As we speak, we have more pieces in our laboratory still being crafted, which will then join our other events, following this one, in other regions and countries. We’ll continue to craft Aeterna for at least the next six months because we know that it should sell reasonably well. 1. The Aeterna collection comprises more than 500 creations spanning high jewellery, high jewellery watches, luxury bags, and fragrances.

2. The star piece is the Serpenti Aeterna necklace—the most precious high jewellery piece ever crafted by the brand. It features seven D-flawless diamond drops cut from a single 200-carat rough diamond, totalling 140 carats (symbolizing the 140th anniversary), plus 698 baguette diamonds weighing 61.81 carats. The necklace required more than 2,800 hours to complete and is set entirely in platinum with only white diamonds—an unexpected departure for a brand renowned for coloured gemstones. It features an ouroboros-style serpent head clasp (tail in mouth) symbolizing eternal rebirth.

3. The event was attended by brand ambassadors including Anne Hathaway, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Liu Yifei, Shu Qi, Hikari Mori, and Alessandro Gassmann. Chopra Jonas wore the Serpenti Aeterna necklace at the gala.

4. The evening included a dance duet by Italian ballet dancer Eleonora Abbagnato and choreographer Sadeck Berrabah, followed by a choreography by Berrabah with 80 dancers. The jewellery show featured surprise runway appearances by models Mariacarla Boscono, Elisabetta Dessy, Isabella Rossellini, and Carla Bruni, set to Nina Simone's "Feeling Good." A gala dinner followed at Chiostro di Michelangelo with a menu by Italian chef Massimiliano Alajmo of three-Michelin-starred Le Calandre, ending with a live performance by Italian singer Elisa.

5. Other notable pieces include the Aurea Chandra (a spherical choker in pink gold with alternating plain and diamond-set spheres channeling 1980s exuberance), the Monete Aeterna Augustus Emerald sautoir (featuring a bronze coin minted during Emperor Tiberius's reign depicting Emperor Augustus, with 149 emerald beads totalling 615.04 carats), the Earth Song necklace (three rows of colourful gems totalling 345.68 carats), the Lotus Cabochon necklace, and the Serpenti Sapphire Echo (a two-headed snake necklace with 37.34-carat pear-cut Sri Lankan sapphires that can detach into earrings).

6. CEO Jean-Christophe Babin shared insights about the brand's history—noting that Bvlgari's first high jewellery creations were exclusively in platinum and diamonds until World War II, when restrictions led the brand to pivot to gold and coloured gems, which became its signature. He described the Serpenti Aeterna as "a once-in-a-century occurrence" and "the single most important diamond necklace of this current century." He also indicated the Aeterna collection is "limitless" and would continue to be crafted for at least six more months, with more pieces to travel worldwide.

The collection was previewed in displays inspired by architect Lina Bo Bardi, with custom-made jacquard tapestries by Venetian weaving specialists Rubelli reinterpreting Giovanni Battista Piranesi's prints.

"When I think about the [past] 140 years, what crosses my mind is that we're crafting for eternity. Pieces we crafted one century ago are probably worn by some of our clients' daughters, granddaughters or great-granddaughters today... So you buy eternity in two ways: timeless value and timeless wearability." — Jean-Christophe Babin, Bvlgari CEO

"We've all seen big diamonds before, but you've probably never seen big diamonds that come from one single rough, all of the same D flawless quality. This, I think, is a once-in-a-century occurrence, so at the moment, this is the single most important diamond necklace of this current century." — Jean-Christophe Babin on the Serpenti Aeterna necklace

"It's a way to pay tribute to our founders and show that not only are we an expert in coloured gems, [but] we've also always been and still are a master of diamonds." — Jean-Christophe Babin

"As the name suggests, Aeterna is something that's limitless... This collection is like a living animal; like a snake... We'll continue to craft Aeterna for at least the next six months because we know that it should sell reasonably well." — Jean-Christophe Babin

# Bvlgari looks to eternity for its 140th anniversary

By Isabelle Cerboneschi

# Bvlgari looks to eternity for its 140th anniversary

By Isabelle Cerboneschi

December 2024

![Bvlgari looks to eternity for its 140th anniversary](local/cache-gd2/3c/13f188ef4af6c0e4dba4e05f5c05a9.jpg?1779024935)

Presented in Rome this year, the Aeterna collection is an encapsulation of Bvlgari’s design codes: necklaces in bold colour combinations, cabochon centrestones, sinuous forms but also diamonds. The collection could not have existed without Lucia Silvestri, who is Jewellery Creative Director as well as Gems Buying Director. We met her at the GemGenève fair.

S

ome birthdays are celebrated in style. For its 140th anniversary, Bvlgari has created the largest collection in its history, which the house unveiled in May at the Terme di Diocleziano baths in Rome. Its name, Aeterna, is the Latin word for eternity and, if diamonds are indeed forever, the star of the collection - the Serpenti Aeterna necklace – is adorned with seven diamonds totalling 140 carats, all cut from a single rough stone.

This exceptional array of diamonds aside, the collection is an explosion of colour replete with stunning gemstones as well as hard stones; nowhere more beautifully expressed than in the Lotus Cabochon necklace. Crafted using the tappetino setting technique, it is resplendent with turquoise, rubellite, amethyst and emerald cabochons mixed with diamonds, creating a tapestry of bold colour in true Bvlgari style.

The Terra Mater Serpenti necklace features a Colombian cabochon emerald of 63.86 carats, while the Sapphire Brocade necklace weaves diamonds, emeralds and a suite of Sri Lankan sapphires. “We started to work on the collection sixteen months before the launch,” says Lucia Silvestri, “but we began gathering the gemstones two years in advance. It’s a slow process.”

![Lucia Silvestri, Jewellery Creative Director and Gems Buying Director, at Bvlgari's 140th anniversary.](local/cache-vignettes/L720xH1082/bulgari_01-2-6a6f9.jpg?1779024935) 

**Lucia Silvestri, Jewellery Creative Director and Gems Buying Director, at Bvlgari’s 140th anniversary.**

©Getty/Bvlgari

Lucia Silvestri not only selects the rarest, most beautiful gemstones for Bvlgari’s high jewellery collections; since 2013 she is also the creative director. Two professions that call on sometimes opposing qualities: boundless creativity for one; a hard business head for the other. She had planned to become a biologist but discovered a different passion when she met Gianni, Nicola and Paolo, the three sons of Giorgio Bulgari. At that time, the brand had just five stores worldwide.

A few weeks before the launch of the collection, Lucia Silvestri was at GemGenève where she gave a keynote alongside jewellery expert and historian Amanda Triossi – an opportunity for us to ask her about the Aeterna collection and learn more about her remarkable journey.

![Bvlgari's Lotus Cabochon necklace is set with round diamonds, turquoises, rubellites, amethysts and cabochon emeralds. Crafted using Bvlgari's ‘tappetino' technique, each stone is held by claw-like architectural elements.](local/cache-vignettes/L720xH900/bulgari_05-2-46071.jpg?1779024935) 

**Bvlgari’s Lotus Cabochon necklace is set with round diamonds, turquoises, rubellites, amethysts and cabochon emeralds. Crafted using Bvlgari’s ‘tappetino’ technique, each stone is held by claw-like architectural elements.**

**Europa Star: What sparked your passion for gemstones?**

**Lucia Silvestri:** Seeing Gianni, Paolo and Nicola Bulgari’s worktable, strewn with precious stones. It was the start of a love affair. That was 44 years ago, almost a lifetime.

**When did you start designing jewellery yourself?**

In the late Eighties. I was helping Paolo source stones. I travelled to Sri Lanka, just me, where I selected yellow and blue sapphires. I asked the seller to recut them as ovals, then suggested to Mr Bulgari that we mix the colours and use them together. They became a necklace.

![Priyanka Chopra wears the Serpenti Aeterna necklace, the centrepiece of the high jewellery collection for Bvlgari's 140th anniversary.](local/cache-vignettes/L720xH1080/bulgari_02-2-9b908.jpg?1779024935) 

**Priyanka Chopra wears the Serpenti Aeterna necklace, the centrepiece of the high jewellery collection for Bvlgari’s 140th anniversary.**

©Getty/Bvlgari

**What takes precedence, the design or the stones?**

The stones, although one of the first things Paolo Bulgari taught me was to never buy a stone if I didn’t know how to use it. The gemstones I choose have to “speak” to me in some way. Once I’ve made my selection, I play around with them until I find the most harmonious combination. Then I give the designers a few ideas. It’s a team effort. Our job is to create something new, something contemporary, but with a definite identity. It has to say Bvlgari from across the room.

**It’s rare to be both a creative director and a gemmologist. The first is traditionally a woman’s job and the second more a male profession. What does it take to combine the two?**

When I started out as a buyer, I was a shy, young woman in an intimidating, male-dominated world. Some sellers wouldn’t negotiate with me, but I was determined, passionate about gemstones and prepared to make sacrifices, and it’s thanks to this, and a little feminine charm, that I was able to make my way. I’m a woman but I’m a powerful woman. I often say there are two sides to me. One is creative and the other is business-oriented. I drive a hard bargain.

**The ranks of collectors and connoisseurs have grown over the past decade, there is heightened competition between the most storied jewellers and exceptional stones are becoming harder to find. What has this changed for you, in your profession?**

It’s become more difficult, because of the scarcity of gems and because of competition, but the way I choose stones is more or less the same. We’re always on the lookout for new gemstones. Over the past ten years we’ve used more semi-precious stones, which we should really call coloured stones. We mix them with the precious stones [diamond, sapphire, emerald and ruby]. Our collections are growing in size, at around 150 pieces, and this requires us to be more and more creative.

![Fenice High-Jewelry Secret Watch](local/cache-vignettes/L720xH645/bulgari_04-2-791db.jpg?1779024935) 

**Fenice High-Jewelry Secret Watch**

**Which stone most caught your imagination?**

Where to begin! Possibly the 93.83-carat cabochon emerald that became the centrepiece of the Hypnotic Serpenti necklace that Zendaya wore for the Venice Film Festival in 2021. Buying that beautiful emerald, with the cut I wanted, is one of the highlights of my career.

![A model wears a suite from the Aeterna collection.](local/cache-vignettes/L720xH1080/bulgari_03-3-cde16.jpg?1779024935) 

**A model wears a suite from the Aeterna collection.**

©Getty/Bvlgari

**Do you have a favourite gemstone?**

I like them all but I would have to say sapphire. When I started out, I thought all sapphires were blue, then I found out they can be many colours. The sapphire corresponds to who I am deep down. I can be one colour on the outside but multiple colours on the inside.

**Which is the most extraordinary piece in the Aeterna collection?**

The Serpenti Aeterna necklace. Its starting point was the discovery of a huge rough diamond from Lesotho. Initially, I was looking more for coloured stones, then I thought to myself, we’re an innovative house, why make only coloured jewellery when we can introduce light with diamonds! I began discussions with the owner of the rough two years ago. We studied the diamond, looked into its heart, and little by little we found our way, the size, the proportions, the cut. I wanted a set of seven diamonds totalling 140 carats for Bvlgari’s 140th anniversary.

![The Serpenti Aeterna necklace is set with seven pear-cut diamonds from the same 200-carat rough, discovered in Lesotho. They weigh a total of 140 carats, one carat for each year in Bvlgari's history.](https://www.europastarjewellery.com/local/cache-gd2/8e/1ad7bafd3c3018269deb7cbaddec5c.jpg?1779024935)

**How much did the rough stone weigh?**

Around 200 carats. Lesotho has some superb rough stones.

**How long did it take to source all the gemstones for this collection?**

I started gathering the stones two years ago. There’s a lovely story behind the two Sri Lankan sapphires in the Serpenti Sapphire Echo necklace. I found them on a pair of vintage Bvlgari earrings which I bought from an elderly lady, two years ago. When she decided to sell them to us, she was happy to know they would be going back to where they had originated. We recut them and set them in a Serpenti necklace, a symbol of fertility and transformation. The sapphires can be detached from the necklace and worn as earrings. So a pair of legacy earrings has come back to life through a new creation.

**Which is the most complex piece, in terms of the actual making?**

The Serpenti Aeterna necklace, because the baguettes had to be set not on a flat structure but on a three-dimensional, serpentine form. This requires remarkable expertise.

![Gouache of the Serpenti Aeterna necklace.](local/cache-vignettes/L720xH1018/bulgari_07-2-2e385.jpg?1779024936) 

**Gouache of the Serpenti Aeterna necklace.**

**How long did it take to gather the sapphires for the Sapphire Brocade necklace?**

It took me three years to find stones of the same colour, then have them recut, certified and bring them all together. It takes time.

**Bvlgari was already a pioneer of coloured stones when you joined. Did you foresee that the market would take off and that the surging popularity of gemstones such as Paraiba tourmalines, Padparadscha sapphires, mandarin garnets and spinels would send prices through the roof?**

I’ve always liked coloured stones. If they have gained in value, it’s because of us, because we started a trend. Bvlgari has always worked with coloured stones and everyone followed suit. Last year, for example, we introduced our Kumo collection, a portmanteau of kunzite and morganite. We bought the stones at a good price but they would cost us more than twice that today, just two years later! You can say the same for mandarin garnets. We were the first to use them as centrestones in our high jewellery collections, ten years ago. And the same is true of citrine, spinel, tourmaline, tanzanite and topaz. There is a magic inherent to coloured stones and we weave this magic into our jewels.

![Serpenti Sapphire Echo necklace. The two Sri Lankan sapphires can be detached from the serpents' heads and transformed into earrings.](local/cache-vignettes/L720xH744/bulgari_08-2-8a758.jpg?1779024936) 

**Serpenti Sapphire Echo necklace. The two Sri Lankan sapphires can be detached from the serpents’ heads and transformed into earrings.**

args.summary:
This Europa Star Jewellery article (December 2024, by Isabelle Cerboneschi) covers Bvlgari's Aeterna collection, created for the house's 140th anniversary and presented in May at the Terme di Diocleziano baths in Rome. The collection is the largest in Bvlgari's history and encapsulates the brand's design codes: bold colour combinations, cabochon centrestones, sinuous forms, and diamonds.

The centrepiece is the Serpenti Aeterna necklace, adorned with seven pear-cut diamonds totalling 140 carats (one carat per year of Bvlgari's history), all cut from a single ~200-carat rough diamond discovered in Lesotho. Other notable pieces include the Lotus Cabochon necklace (turquoise, rubellite, amethyst, and emerald cabochons mixed with diamonds using the 'tappetino' setting technique), the Terra Mater Serpenti necklace (a 63.86-carat Colombian cabochon emerald), the Sapphire Brocade necklace (diamonds, emeralds, and Sri Lankan sapphires), and the Serpenti Sapphire Echo necklace (with detachable sapphires that convert to earrings).

The article features an interview with Lucia Silvestri, Bvlgari's Jewellery Creative Director and Gems Buying Director, conducted at the GemGenève fair alongside historian Amanda Triossi. Silvestri discusses her 44-year career with Bvlgari (starting at age when the brand had just five stores worldwide), her dual role combining creativity and business acumen, and her preference for coloured stones — noting Bvlgari pioneered trends in Paraiba tourmalines, Padparadscha sapphires, mandarin garnets, and spinels, which have since surged in value. She highlights the 93.83-carat cabochon emerald in the Hypnotic Serpenti necklace worn by Zendaya at the 2021 Venice Film Festival as a career highlight. Sapphire is her favourite gemstone. The collection required sourcing gemstones two years in advance, with the Sapphire Brocade sapphires taking three years to gather. The most complex piece to make was the Serpenti Aeterna necklace due to setting baguettes on a three-dimensional serpentine form.
args.key_excerpts: "We started to work on the collection sixteen months before the launch, but we began gathering the gemstones two years in advance. It's a slow process." — Lucia Silvestri

**Bvlgari unveils Aeterna, the most extraordinary High-end collection ever created by the Roman High Jeweler with a magnificent event in Rome**

# Bvlgari unveils Aeterna: the event, the collection (media heavy article)

By: [Dan-Andrei](https://watchilove.com/author/kluand/)

On:

Reading Time:   10 minutes

**Bvlgari chooses the Eternal city of Rome, its hometown and everlasting source of inspiration, to unveil [Aeterna](https://www.bulgari.com/en-int/high-jewellery/aeterna), its new High-End Collection, presenting for the occasion a precious assortment of over 500 creations, including High Jewelry and High Jewelry Watches, High-End Bags and Very High-End Fragrances. An occasion to celebrate, with a breathtaking event, its 140th anniversary, a major milestone for the Roman Maison.**

Highlighting the uniqueness of the event, [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/tadao-ando-x-bulgari-serpenti-an-ode-to-the-seasons/) staged its sophisticated extravaganza in a location, made accessible exclusively to the Maison for this momentous occasion, Rome’s Terme di Diocleziano, one of the world’s most extraordinary antique architectural complexes and beautiful open-air museums in the Eternal City, part of the Museo Nazionale Romano,

Considered the largest Baths of ancient Rome, spanning a surface of 13 hectares that was able to accommodate up to 3,000 people at once, the breathtaking complex, built between 298 and 306 AD, is adorned with splendid sculptures and fascinating ruins.

International guests, including [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/bulgari-octo-finissimo-sketch-the-art-of-drawing/)’s Brand Ambassadors Anne Hathaway, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Liu Yifei, Shu Qi, Hikari Mori and Alessandro Gassman, enjoyed a journey into eternity where the layered beauty of the Terme di Diocleziano, the timelessness of Bvlgari’s High Jewelry creations and the state-of-the-art spirit of the event’s performances overcome the boundaries of time.

To celebrate the special anniversary, [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/bulgari-at-lvmh-watch-week-2024-beyond-time-time-is-gold/) Brand Ambassador Priyanka Chopra Jonas wore the Serpenti Aeterna necklace, the most precious High Jewelry piece ever crafted by the Roman Maison. Featuring seven D flawless diamond drops totalling 140.00 carats, one for each year of the brand’s history, and 698 baguette diamonds weighting 61.81 carats, this incredible necklace required over 2,800 to complete, revealing an outstanding combination of creativity, expertise and audacity, values that have always defined the brand’s vision.

* ![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/PIT_6973_uHrL5aX0.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

  ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: <> attends the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Pietro S. D’Aprano/Getty Images for Bulgari)
* ![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/L1250406_ZKxWIvyX.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

  ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: Elisa performs during the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Claudio Lavenia/Getty Images for Bulgari)
* ![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/L1240092_Gb5iwKDU.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

  ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: Carla Bruni attends the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Claudio Lavenia/Getty Images for Bulgari)

  ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: Sabin Marcelis and attends the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Elisabetta Villa/Getty Images for Bulgari)
* ![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/EV3_4797_QxfEiJzg.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

  ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: Refik Anadol and attend the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Elisabetta Villa/Getty Images for Bulgari)
* ![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/EV3_4761_zaK1MqbF.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

  ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: Zita d’Hauteville attends the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Elisabetta Villa/Getty Images for Bulgari)
* ![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/EV3_4499_sEPmLgC4.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

  ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: Carla Bruni and attend the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Elisabetta Villa/Getty Images for Bulgari)
* ![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/EV3_4694_XixCNfNy.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

  ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: <> attends the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Elisabetta Villa/Getty Images for Bulgari)

During the evening, the Terme di Diocleziano, that recently reopened to the public after long restoration works, hosted a spectacular jewellery show that took place in the Chiostro Ludovisi, an intimate space built over the Terme’s large outdoor pool. Styled by Carine Roitfeld, the show featured an iconic casting, including Mariacarla Boscono, Blesnya Minher, Elisabetta Dessy, Isabella Rossellini, Carla Bruni and Giacomo Cavalli.

![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/PIT_7054_F04lLxKk.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: <> attends the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Pietro S. D’Aprano/Getty Images for Bulgari)

Before the show started, guests had the chance to assist to a special, poetic duet by choreographer and dancer Sadeck Berrabah and ballet dancer Eleonora Abbagnato, the director of Teatro dell’Opera di Roma. Mixing classic and contemporary dance, they celebrated Bvlgari’s ability to fuse past, present and future giving life to eternal works of art.

![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/PIT_7070_drOvu1tc.jpg?resize=1024%2C683&ssl=1)

ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: <> attends the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Pietro S. D’Aprano/Getty Images for Bulgari)

Their performance was followed by a fascinating choreography by Sadeck Berrabah and 80 dancers, who moved synchronously, perfectly embodying his signature artistic direction.

![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/EV3_5145_FYiHPjMu.jpg?resize=1024%2C683&ssl=1)

ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: <> attends the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Elisabetta Villa/Getty Images for Bulgari)

At the Baths’ Chiostro di Michelangelo, named after the famous painter and sculptor to who it is traditionally attributed, [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/bulgari-time-is-a-jewel-divas-dream-allegra-serpenti/) delighted its guest with a gala dinner conceived by Italian Michelin-starred chef Massimiliano Alajmo, who developed a menu specifically designed for the event.

![Bvlgari unveils Aeterna](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/L1250406_ZKxWIvyX.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: Elisa performs during the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Claudio Lavenia/Getty Images for Bulgari)

The dinner was followed by a live performance by internationally acclaimed artist and songwriter Elisa.

For the occasion, “Vista Aeterna” an immersive installation created by Dutch designer Sabine Marcelis, has been gifted to the city of Rome under the patronage of the Fondazione [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/bulgari-serpenti-misteriosi-romani/). The artwork will be at the iconic Piazza di Spagna from May, 19th to June, 15th, and offers a contemporary interpretation of Rome’s urban landscape. It consists of twelve travertine-based pillars adorned with reflective coloured mirrors that continuously rotate throughout the day, tracing the path of the sun from dawn to dusk. As they move, they capture and refract sunlight, projecting a spectrum of warm, sun-inspired tones onto the surroundings. Providing an ever-changing vista, it is a perpetual celebration of the luminosity of the eternal city and its architectural heritage.

Continuing its pioneering spirit and unwavering commitment to innovation in luxury, the Maison has also introduced the [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/bulgari-serpenti-misteriosi-high-jewellery-secret-watches/) Digital Passport. This immutable digital record stores the unique characteristics and certificates of each High Jewelry creation on the Aura private blockchain, which safeguards product data indefinitely with the highest standards of transparency and security.

 

## BVLGARI AETERNA SHOWROOM

Offering an immersion into the collection, [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/bulgari-lvcea-intarsio/) showcased the Aeterna’s unique creations in the Aula X of the Terme di Diocleziano. A timeless space showing the grandeur of the ancient Roman thermal bath with a spectacular height of approximately 22 meters. The extraordinary Serpenti Aeterna necklace shined in the middle of Ara Aeterna, a prominent dedicated space inside the showroom and a video revealing the craftsmanship behind its creation is presented in a customized theatre.

 

A range of Aeterna key creations were unveiled in displays inspired by Italian architect Lina Bo Bardi and sitting in front of stunning reinterpretation of architect Giovanni Battista Piranesi’s prints, rendered on precious custom-made tapestries realized with the high-density jacquard technique by the historic Venetian weaving Rubelli.

 

The prints show the reproductions of the antique floor plan of Terme di Diocleziano and the Forma Urbis Severiana, an antique map of Rome engraved on marble slabs dating from the time of Septimius Severus (between 203 and 211 AD) that Piranesi collected in the *Antichità Romane* tome, published in 1756. A masterpiece that celebrates Rome’s historical heritage and Italian art, craftsmanship and technology and made possible by the collaboration between Bvlgari, the Istituto Centrale per la Grafica and Rubelli.

The *table d’artiste* showcasedthe magnificent High Jewelry creations in one-of-a-kind displays crafted in Italy from alabaster, the stone of light, putting the focus on the unique light of Rome, a timeless source of inspiration in the development of the Maison’s jewellery collections.

BVLGARI “AETERNA” HIGH-JEWELRY 2024 COLLECTION

## BVLGARI “AETERNA” HIGH-JEWELRY 2024 COLLECTION

Each day brings a new sunrise, manifestation of beauty that we never get tired of contemplating. Every day the intimate light of dawn bathes Rome, always offering a new vision of the Eternal City, the everlasting source of inspiration of [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/bulgari-octo-roma-masterpieces-of-sound/) founded in 1884 by Sotirio Bulgari.

Infused with the same splendour, “Aeterna”, the new High-Jewelry and High-End watches collection -marking Bvlgari’s 140th anniversary – pays tribute to the Roman Maison’s ability to reinvent itself, continuously interpreting the spirit of each era.

Loyal to its authentic nature, [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/a-light-review-of-a-butterfly-bulgari-octo-roma-central-tourbillon-papillon/) refines its aesthetic vision and elevates its manufacturing expertise to deliver creations that feel both contemporary and timeless, ultimately eternal.

Creations that through the combination of boundless creativity and high-end craftsmanship, the creations celebrate remarkable gems. Forged by Mother Earth over millennials, they are themselves precious fragments of eternity, evidence of the past and premises for the future.

In keeping with its pioneering spirit, for Aeterna, [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/mbf-x-bulgari-legacy-machine-flyingt-allegra/) pushes the limits of creativity and craftsmanship further than ever in a magnificent expression of its bold yet always sophisticated audacity.

## AN ODE TO ETERNITY: THE SERPENTI AETERNA NECKLACE

Marking the 140th anniversary of the Roman jeweller, the “**[Serpenti Aeterna Necklace](https://www.bulgari.com/de-de/high-jewellery/aeterna-serpenti-necklace)**” fully embodies Bvlgari’s quintessentially groundbreaking spirit. Revealing an outstanding combination of creativity, expertise and audacity, values that have always defined the brand’s vision, this extraordinary piece is the most precious work of art ever crafted by the jewellery house.

This incredible necklace requires over 2,400 hours to complete and stuns with its absolute purity conveyed through diamonds. Along with symbolizing eternity, they highlight [the Maison](https://watchilove.com/bulgari-divina-mosaica/)’s vocation to always push new boundaries and to surprise, celebrating this important milestone by giving diamonds the leading role instead of colour gemstones, as many would have expected.

![SERPENTI AETERNA](https://i0.wp.com/watchilove.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/priyanka20_LkbGM4tH.jpg?resize=683%2C1024&ssl=1)

ROME, ITALY – MAY 20: <> attends the Bulgari Aeterna High Jewelry Brand Event at Altare Della Patria on May 20, 2024 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Elisabetta Villa/Getty Images for Bulgari)

Breaking new grounds in jewellery making, [Bvlgari](https://watchilove.com/bvlgari-aluminium-gmt-smeraldo-chronograph-solotempo/) approached this project with bravery: a rough diamond of over 200.00 carats was cut to create seven diamond drops totalling 140 carats, one for each year of the brand’s history – instead of focusing on carats, Bvlgari gave priority to the beauty of the layout and its harmonious balance. Adding an extra challenge, the drops are embraced in a sinuous three-dimensional wave structure in platinum, embellished with baguette diamonds integrated over five months. The seductive structure flows, with the flexibility of a snake, toward the back of the necklace revealing the iconic symbol that, with the role of a clasp, guards this masterpiece representing the eternal rebirth that comes to life.

## THE AETERNA COLLECTION

Flexibility and sinuous dynamism also take centre stage in **Sapphire Aeterna Waves**, a stunning platinum necklace defined by a sophisticated combination of diamonds and sapphires – their shimmering shades evoking the wavy ocean of Sri Lanka, the country of origin of this creation’s magnificent 38.93-carat cushion-cut sapphire. The detachable pendant highlights Bvlgari’s passion for transformative and versatile jewellery.

In 2022, Bvlgari started collecting the precious gems cut to create the thirteen cushion sapphires characterizing the exquisite layout of the **[Sapphire Brocade necklace](https://www.bulgari.com/de-de/high-jewellery/sapphire-brocade-necklace)**. Developed with the same delicacy of an haute couture piece, this outstanding creation is designed to sit around the neck with lightness and gentleness. Diamonds and sapphires are matched with buff-top emeralds in a signature colour combination celebrating 140 years of unparalleled High Jewelry craftsmanship. The necklace is presented with matching earrings, revealing two central sapphires paired with buff-top emeralds, as well as pavé and round-cut diamonds.

Bold design and ultimate lightness find a perfect balance in **[Aurea Chandra](https://www.bulgari.com/en-ca/high-jewellery/aurea-chandra-necklace)**, a choker revisiting Bvlgari iconic 1980s’ Chandra Line that, with its opulence and vibrancy, embodied the daring spirit of the bold and exuberant decade when it was created. Five rows of alternating pink gold and pave diamond spheres gracefully wrap around the neck in a feather-weight yet eye-catching construction evoking the cyclical nature of creativity and its celestial nature.

Bulgari’s iconic Tubogas design, a symbol of ultimate modernity, meets the eternal grace of the romantic floral motif engraved on the striking oval-cut 31,07-carat Zambian emerald protagonist of the Tubogas Flower of Time necklace. The outstanding gem is exalted by a graphic layout of 16 buff-top rubellites and pavé-set diamonds, adding extra preciousness to this remarkable creation, spreading a message of visual marvel and tactile delight. The necklace is unveiled with matching earrings, that combine natural lines with striking colours and a sleek, modern vibe. Featuring a drop-style design, they include cabochon rubellites mixed with buff-top emeralds and diamond pavé.

Both timeless and contemporary, the **[Bvlgari Lotus Cabochon](https://www.bulgari.com/de-de/high-jewellery/bvlgari-lotus-cabochon-necklace)** necklace surprises with its flamboyant colours and the intriguing pebble-like texture. This vibrant creation, evoking the silhouette of a sartorial collar, shows organic, sinuous lines recreating the shape of a lotus flower, a universal symbol of eternal rebirth. Rubellite, turquoise, emerald and amethyst cabochons are set on a carpet-like gold base guaranteeing a plush effect.

Always fascinated by the enchanting colour combinations, Lucia Silvestri conceived a kaleidoscopic yet elegant creation, [**Earth Song**](https://www.bulgari.com/de-de/high-jewellery/earth-song-necklace). An ode to the multifaceted vital strength of Nature, this necklace combines a thick pink gold chain with three strands mixing an array of colourful gems, including rubellites, amethysts, kunzites, green tourmalines and diamonds, cut in three different shapes, rounded, oval and squared. Bvlgari’s mastery reflects in the lightweight bezel settings, managing the significant carat weights to maintain harmonious spacing across three compact strands. In addition, the choice to leave the settings open at the back allows them to rest sumptuously on the skin and maximizes the light and energy that pours through their facets. The result is a masterwork of harmonious balance and joyful sophistication.

Breaking new ground in jewellery making, the **Serpenti Chiseled** necklace was born from a successful synergy between artisanal manufacturing expertise and refined, innovative technology. Taking inspiration from classical Roman sculpture, the body of the snake was conceived with grandiose, sinuous movement achieved through expertly joined element guaranteeing supple dynamism. An awe-inspiring almost 77.78 carat pear shape rubellite in a vibrant strawberry red hue, is suspended from the snake’s mouth. Pavé sets are juxtaposed to amethyst exalting the creation’s sensual vibrancy, while black onyx inlays between diamonds enhance the piece’s graphic quality.

Epitomizing metamorphosis and transformation, the Snake, one of Bvlgari’s most celebrated icons, finds a new interpretation in the **[Serpenti Sapphire Echo](https://www.bulgari.com/de-de/high-jewellery/serpenti-sapphire-echo-necklace)** necklace. A white gold snake with two heads – featuring scales covered with a combination of diamonds and buff-top sapphires – holds two pear-cut Sri Lanka sapphires, each of them weighting over 37.34 carats. These precious gems were sourced from a pair of Bvlgari earrings dating back to the Thirties that an Italian noblewoman client sold back to the Roman jeweller after having worn them for decades. The two stunning pendants are detachable and have been conceived to be also worn as earrings, showcasing Bvlgari’s passion for transformative jewellery.

A tribute to Rome’s enduring transcendence, the **Mosaic of Time** is one of the most intricate and technically challenging creations in the Aeterna High-Jewelry collection. One hundred-fifty distinct modules are perfectly joined to create a mosaic of diverse colours and gem cuts, vibrating with splendour and elegance. Revealing a delicate scalloped silhouette, this incredible necklace, worked in a gentle pastel palette, combines pear-shaped Paraiba tourmalines, cushion-cut pink tourmalines, turquoise, buff-top emeralds, pavé diamonds, as well as contrasting onyx and mother-of-pearl details, in a balanced and refined celebration of creativity and craftsmanship. The necklace is unveiled with a coordinated timepiece and matching ring. The ring features an intricate design where a striking central cushion Paraiba tourmaline is surrounded by a mosaic of turquoises, onyx and 20 buff-top emeralds.

Past, present and future coexist in the **[Monete Aeterna Augustus Emerald](https://www.bulgari.com/de-de/high-jewellery/augusts-aeternus-emerald-monete-sautoir)** sautoir, celebrating Bvlgari’s Roman origins and heritage. The rare bronze coin, minted during the reign of Tiberius, shows the magnificent profile of the first Roman emperor, Augustus, who commissioned the building of the Ara Pacis, a splendid monument symbolizing the establishment of peace in the Roman Empire. This necklace is completed with 149 identical emerald beads weighting over 615 carats, 80 buff-top emeralds, and pavé set diamonds.

Conveying an ethereal sense of perpetual movement, the **Sequence of Eternity** earrings show a directional arrangement of diamonds, symbolizing a radiant future. At the centre of these stunning pieces, two Mozambican oval-cut rubies, weighing 8.92 and 8.06 carats, steal the spotlight with outstanding magnificence, further exalted by three diamond drops representing the past, present, and future.

Creativity, invention, ingenuity, craftsmanship and passion. Bvlgari marks its 140th anniversary with a breathtaking collection, infused with the sense of boldness and bravery that have always distinguished the Roman High Jeweler. Connecting past, present and future, Bvlgari celebrates the uniqueness of gemstones creating unparalleled creations, being aware that jewels are a universe within our reach. Fragments of a primordial magic emitting its own light. Moments of eternity.

This article from Watch I Love covers Bvlgari's unveiling of "Aeterna," its most extraordinary High-End collection ever created, launched at a spectacular event in Rome on May 20, 2024, to celebrate the Roman Maison's 140th anniversary. The event was staged at the Terme di Diocleziano (Rome's ancient Baths, built between 298-306 AD, spanning 13 hectares and accommodating up to 3,000 people), which recently reopened after restoration. International brand ambassadors in attendance included Anne Hathaway, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Liu Yifei, Shu Qi, Hikari Mori, and Alessandro Gassman.

The centerpiece of the collection is the Serpenti Aeterna necklace worn by Priyanka Chopra Jonas — the most precious High Jewelry piece ever crafted by Bvlgari. It features seven D-flawless diamond drops totaling 140.00 carats (one for each year of the brand's history), plus 698 baguette diamonds weighing 61.81 carats, requiring over 2,800 hours to complete. A rough diamond of over 200 carats was cut to create the seven drops.

The event featured a jewellery show styled by Carine Roitfeld in the Chiostro Ludovisi with models including Mariacarla Boscono, Blesnya Minher, Elisabetta Dessy, Isabella Rossellini, Carla Bruni, and Giacomo Cavalli. There was a dance duet by choreographer Sadeck Berrabah and ballet dancer Eleonora Abbagnato, followed by a choreography with 80 dancers. A gala dinner at the Chiostro di Michelangelo was conceived by Michelin-starred chef Massimiliano Alajmo, followed by a live performance by artist Elisa.

Key elements of the launch included: a "Vista Aeterna" immersive installation by Dutch designer Sabine Marcelis (twelve travertine pillars with rotating reflective mirrors) displayed at Piazza di Spagna from May 19 to June 15, 2024; and the introduction of the Bvlgari Digital Passport, an immutable digital record on the Aura private blockchain storing characteristics and certificates of each High Jewelry creation.

The article details numerous collection highlights: Sapphire Aeterna Waves (38.93-carat cushion-cut Sri Lanka sapphire necklace), Sapphire Brocade necklace (thirteen cushion sapphires with buff-top emeralds), Aurea Chandra (choker revisiting the 1980s' Chandra Line with five rows of pink gold and pavé diamond spheres), Tubogas Flower of Time (31.07-carat Zambian emerald with rubellites), Bvlgari Lotus Cabochon (rubellite, turquoise, emerald, amethyst cabochons), Earth Song (three strands of colorful gems by Lucia Silvestri), Serpenti Chiseled (77.78-carat pear-shape rubellite from snake's mouth), Serpenti Sapphire Echo (two pear-cut sapphires each over 37.34 carats sourced from 1930s Bvlgari earrings), Mosaic of Time (150 modules with Paraiba tourmalines, designed by Lucia Silvestri), and Monete Aeterna Augustus Emerald (sautoir with a rare bronze coin from Tiberius's reign featuring Emperor Augustus, 149 emerald beads over 615 carats). The Sequence of Eternity earrings feature two Mozambican oval-cut rubies (8.92 and 8.06 carats) with three diamond drops representing past, present, and future.

The showroom at Aula X of the Terme di Diocleziano featured displays inspired by Italian architect Lina Bo Bardi with reinterpretations of Giovanni Battista Piranesi's prints on custom tapestries by Venetian weaver Rubelli, and alabaster displays showcasing the creations.

# Bvlgari Unveils Its Most Extraordinary High-End Collection Ever: Aeterna

Luxferity, 27.05.2024

[Brand news](/brand/bulgari)[Recommend ![Recommend](/assets/img/blog/u3502.png)](#!)

## Infused with the same visionary spirit of the Eternal City, the everlasting source of inspiration of [Bvlgari](https://www.bulgari.com), the Roman Jeweler unveils to the world “Aeterna”, the new High-End collection, paying tribute to the Maison’s 140th anniversary and to its ability to reinvent itself, continuously interpreting the spirit of each era.

Through an exquisite and sensational works of art proposal that extends beyond the limits of excellent craftsmanship and extraordinary gemstones, the collection is a precious blend of past, present, and future, showcasing an unprecedent Masterpiece, the Serpenti Aeterna necklace, as the quintessence of Bvlgari unrivalled ability to master the most precious gems of nature.

*“I’m extremely proud of my creative teams led by Lucia Silvestri and Fabrizio Buonamassa Stigliani, together with our master craftsmen, for having developed the most extraordinary High-End collection ever, not only in Bvlgari unparalleled 140 years of history, but probably overall in the 21st century. Serpenti Aeterna represents the pinnacle of excellence. It blends the most extraordinary  
diamonds recently crafted together with Serpenti, the most desired jewelry and watch symbol of the last decades, brought by Cleopatra to Rome in 46 BC and reborn in 1948 thanks to the visionary Bulgari family with the jewelry secret watches.”* states **Jean-Christophe Babin**, **CEO Bvlgari Group**.

The new collection presents an unprecedented richness that is rooted in a deep legacy and projected into the future with a contemporary and timeless aesthetic, ultimately eternal. Consisting of over 500 masterpieces, including High Jewelry and High Jewelry Watches, High-End Bags and Fragrances, Aeterna epitomizes the superlative Art of the Magnificent Roman High Jeweler for gems, time, precious skins and olfactive emotions.

Creations that, through the combination of boundless creativity and high-end craftsmanship, celebrate remarkable gems. Forged by Mother Earth over millennials, they are themselves precious fragments of eternity, evidence of the past and premises for the future.

This outstanding collection is set to be revealed in Rome, at Terme di Diocleziano, one of the world’s most extraordinary antique architectural complexes. This secretly hidden precious treasure will be hosting, for the first time ever, a major private event thanks to the unique cooperation between the Italian Culture Ministry and the Fondazione Bvlgari; a collaboration forged over decades by multiple and continuous philanthropic restorations run together with the State of Italy and Rome’s authorities.

On the wake of this grand tribute to Bvlgari’s 140th anniversary, **Paolo Bulgari - President of the Bvlgari Group** - reflects on the emotional journey that has characterized the Maison in this incredible path of experimentation and audacity: *“As Chairman of the Board and passionate expert of extraordinary gems, I am very proud and happy to see that 140 years after my Grand Father created his small workshop, Bvlgari today sparkles over the planet and creates and crafts the most desirable masterpieces of High Jewelry and Jewelry Watches of our times”.*

##### AN ODE TO ETERNITY: THE SERPENTI AETERNA NECKLACE

Marking the 140th anniversary of the Roman jeweler, the Serpenti Aeterna necklace, the most extraordinary and precious diamond High Jewelry piece ever crafted and displayed by the Roman Maison, fully embodies Bvlgari’s quintessentially groundbreaking spirit. Revealing an outstanding combination of creativity, expertise and audacity, values that have always defined the brand’s vision, this extraordinary piece is the most precious work of art ever crafted by the jewelry house.

*“Serpenti Aeterna necklace is a tribute to Bvlgari 140 anniversary, it is the most precious necklace we ever crafted. We wanted to create something unique in a Bvlgari way, keep challenging ourselves and surprising everyone with the decision to give diamonds the role of the protagonist, while including it into the Serpenti family. A necklace that symbolizes the eternity, as eternal is Bvlgari and as Eternal is Rome, the city where it all started, and the ability of the brand to continuously keep reinventing itself.”* commented **Lucia Silvestri Bvlgari Jewelry Creative Director**.

This incredible necklace required over 2,800 hours to complete and stuns with its absolute purity conveyed through diamonds. Along with symbolizing eternity, they highlight the Maison’s vocation to always push new boundaries and to surprise, celebrating this important milestone by giving diamonds the leading role instead of color gemstones, as many would have expected.

Breaking new grounds in jewelry making, Bvlgari approached this project with bravery: a rough diamond of over 200.00 carats was cut to create seven D flawless ultra clear and pure pears diamond drops totaling 140.00 carats, one for each year of the brand’s history. Adding an extra challenge, the drops are embraced in a sinuous three-dimensional wave structure in platinum, embellished with 698 baguette diamonds weighting 61.81 carats. The seductive structure flows, with the flexibility of a snake, toward the back of the necklace revealing the iconic symbol that, with the role of a clasp, guards this masterpiece representing the eternal rebirth that comes to life.

##### THE HIGH JEWELRY COLLECTION

Flexibility and sinuous dynamism also take center stage in Sapphire Aeterna Waves, a stunning platinum necklace defined by a sophisticated combination of diamonds and sapphires - their shimmering shades evoking the wavy ocean of Sri Lanka, the country of origin of this creation’s magnificent 38.93 carats cushion-cut sapphire. The detachable pendant highlights Bvlgari’s passion for transformative and versatile jewelry.

It took two years for Bvlgari to collect the precious gems cut to create the thirteen cushion sapphires characterizing the exquisite layout of the Sapphire Brocade necklace. Developed with the same delicacy of an haute couture masterpiece, this outstanding creation is designed to sit around the neck with lightness and gentleness. Diamonds and sapphires (63.48 carats) are matched with buff-top emeralds in a signature color combination celebrating 140 years of unparalleled High Jewelry craftsmanship. The necklace is presented with matching earrings, revealing t wo central sapphires paired with buff-top emeralds, as well as pavé and round-cut diamonds.

Bold design and ultimate lightness find a perfect balance in Aurea Chandra, an unexpected spherical choker revisiting Bvlgari iconic 1980s’ Chandra Line that, with its opulence and vibrancy, embodied the daring spirit of the exuberant decade when it was created. Five rows of alternating pink gold and pavé-set diamonds spheres gracefully wrap around the neck in a feather-weight yet eye-catching construction evoking the cyclical nature of creativity and its celestial nature.

Bvlgari’s iconic Tubogas design, a symbol of ultimate modernity, meets the eternal grace of the romantic floral motif engraved on the striking oval-cut 31.07 carats Zambian emerald protagonist of the Tubogas Flower of Time necklace. The outstanding gem is exalted by a graphic layout of 16 buff-top rubellites and pavé-set diamonds, adding extra preciousness to this remarkable creation, spreading a message of visual marvel and tactile delight. The necklace is unveiled with matching earrings, that combine natural lines with striking colors and a sleek, modern vibe. Featuring a dropstyle design, they include cabochon rubellites mixed with buff-top emeralds and diamond pavé.

Both timeless and contemporary, the Bvlgari Lotus Cabochon necklace surprises with its flamboyant colors and the intriguing pebble-like texture. This vibrant creation, evoking the silhouette of a sartorial collar, shows organic, sinuous lines recreating the shape of a lotus flower, a universal symbol of eternal rebirth. Rubellite, turquoise, emerald and amethyst cabochons are set on a carpet-like gold base guaranteeing a plush effect.

Always fascinated by the enchanting color combinations, Lucia Silvestri conceived a kaleidoscopic yet elegant creation, Earth Song, an ode to the multifaceted vital strength of Nature. This necklace combines a thick pink gold chain with three strands mixing an array of colorful gems of 345.68 carats, including rubellites, amethysts, kunzites, green tourmalines and diamonds, cut in three different shapes, rounded, oval and squared (22.21 carats). Bvlgari’s mastery reflects in the lightweight bezel settings, managing the significant carat weights to maintain harmonious spacing across three compact strands. In addition, the choice to leave the settings open at the back allows them to rest sumptuously on the skin and maximizes the light and energy that pours through their facets. The result is a masterwork of harmonious balance and joyful sophistication.

Breaking new ground in jewelry making, the Serpenti Chiseled necklace was born from a successful synergy between artisanal manufacturing expertise and refined, innovative technology. Taking inspiration from classical Roman sculpture, the body of the snake was conceived with grandiose, sinuous movement achieved through expertly joined elements guaranteeing supple dynamism. An awe-inspiring 77.78 carats pear shape rubellite in a vibrant strawberry red hue, is suspended from the snake’s mouth. Pavé sets are juxtaposed to nine pear amethysts and twenty cabochon pear rubellites (193.69 carats) exalting the creation’s sensual vibrancy, while black onyx inlays between diamonds enhance the piece’s graphic quality.

Epitomizing metamorphosis and transformation, the snake, one of Bvlgari’s most celebrated icons, finds a new interpretation in the Serpenti Sapphire Echo necklace. A white gold snake with two heads - featuring scales covered with a combination of diamonds and buff-top sapphires - holds two pear-cut Sri Lanka sapphires, each of them weighting 37.34 carats. These precious gems were sourced from a pair of Bvlgari earrings dating back to the Thirties that an Italian noblewoman client sold back to the Roman jeweler after having worn them for decades. The two stunning pendants are detachable and have been conceived to be also worn as earrings, showcasing Bvlgari’s passion for transformative jewelry.

A tribute to Rome’s enduring transcendence, the Mosaic of Time is one of the most intricate and technically challenging creations in the Aeterna High Jewelry collection. One hundred-fifty distinct modules are perfectly joined to create a mosaic of diverse colors and gem cuts, vibrating with splendor and elegance. Revealing a delicate scalloped silhouette, this incredible necklace, worked in a gentle pastel palette, combines pear-shaped Paraiba tourmalines, cushion-cut pink tourmalines, turquoises, buff-top emeralds, pavé-set diamonds, as well as contrasting onyx and mother-of-pearl details, in a balanced and refined celebration of creativity and craftsmanship. The necklace is unveiled with a coordinated timepiece and matching ring. The ring features an intricate design where a striking central cushion Paraiba tourmaline is surrounded by a mosaic of turquoises, onyx and 20 buff-top emeralds.

Past, present and future coexist in the Monete Aeterna Augustus Emerald sautoir, celebrating Bvlgari’s Roman origins and heritage. The rare imperial bronze coin, minted during the reign of Tiberius, shows the magnificent profile of the first Roman emperor, Augustus, who commissioned the building of the Ara Pacis as well as of his Mausoleum, facing the new Bvlgari Hotel in Rome. This necklace is completed with 149 identical emerald beads weighing 615.04 carats, 80 buff-top emeralds, and pavé set diamonds.

Conveying an ethereal sense of perpetual movement, the Sequence of Eternity earrings show a directional arrangement of diamonds, symbolizing a radiant future. At the center of these stunning pieces, two Mozambican oval-cut rubies, weighing 8.92 and 8.06 carats, steal the spotlight with outstanding magnificence, further exalted by three diamond drops representing the past, present, and future.

##### HIGH JEWELRY WATCHES

Bvlgari’s unparalleled creativity and craftsmanship, showcased in the Aeterna collection, meets Swiss watchmaking expertise in a new irresistible line of High-End watches designed to amaze and pioneer the fusion between the best of High Jewelry and feminine watches.

An homage to the Maison 140th anniversary, Fuochi D’Artificio is a collection of timepieces reflecting the joyful atmosphere of a starry Italian summer night, lit up by vivid fireworks. Radiant motives, vibrating with a burst of colors, are obtained through the daring combination of precious and color gemstones, matched with different metals, from pink and white gold to titanium and platinum. Flexibility and dynamism are infused into the watches, all equipped with the exclusive Bvlgari Piccolissimo, the smallest micro mechanical movement in the world.

Brilliance and sophistication find a perfect balance in the Fuochi D’Artificio High Jewelry Manchette, which required more than 1,450 hours to be completed. Portraying an explosion of bright fireworks in the sky, this precious watch features a semi rigid cuff in rose gold and blue titanium which enhances the color of the sky and contrasts with the dark onyx. A sweeping variety of colorful gemstones are carefully selected and combined with sparkling diamonds and hand-cut and polished onyx inserts. The result is an extraordinary ode to joy, further exalted by the dynamism of moving elements.

Bvlgari Watch Division Creative Director Fabrizio Buonamassa Stigliani wanted to celebrate eternity with a mythological animal, a breathtaking work of art that required over 3,000 hours to be finished. With the Fenice High Jewelry Watch, the Roman Maison Reaffirms its position of Master of colored gemstone. Bvlgari selected over 160 carats of stones, including blue, pink and purple sapphires, amethysts, rubies, pink garnets, tanzanites, iolites, aquamarines and diamonds, to create an incredible degradé effect in a color palette, spanning from blue and red to pink and purple. This secret watch reveals a rare central 9.78 carats Paraiba tourmaline, that hides the watch dial. The delicate and dashing mobile feathering embraces the wrist thanks to a unique openwork construction allowing the bird to spread its wings and fly away. In this timepiece, the splendid Phoenix is surrounded by spikes, that symbolize the light of the resurrection enhancing the creation’s unparalleled sparkle, which was inspired by Gian Lorenzo Bernini’s altarpiece located at the Roman church of Santa Maria della Vittoria.

*“The Aeterna theme takes us on a journey through the codes and history of Bvlgari. It’s these deeply rooted signs that make the brand even more eternal. To illustrate eternity, we decided to bring new guests on our journey. We imagined timeless mythical animals that are therefore eternal. The Pheonix is an eternal creature which is constantly reborn. From a philosophical standpoint we thought of pieces that are perennial over time. This gives us the opportunity to develop our savoir-faire and our signs throughout time, in order to project Bvlgari in the future”.* commented **Fabrizio Buonamassa Stigliani Bvlgari Watch Division Creative Director**.

##### ONE-OF-A-KIND HIGH JEWELRY BAGS

An ode to gemstone, a tribute to Rome and a celebration of a 140-year-old manufacturing expertise, the High-End Bags collection shows 16 one-of-a-kind pieces, crafted from exclusive materials, including alligator and crocodile, all enriched with special jewelry wonders, featuring two of the Roman Maison’s most iconic symbols, the Serpenti snake motif, as well the Monete antique coins.

Among the collection, in a nod to Bvlgari jewelry icon, the Aeterna Serpenti Pallini one-of-a-kind top handle bag in Midnight Plum Shiny Alligator stands out featuring two interchangeable detachable heads. Crafted in 18 carats white gold by drawing inspiration from the iconic “pallini” technique, the first head is set with 7.3 carats of pavé diamonds and 22 buff-top rubellites, while the second one is fully encrusted with pavé diamonds. In both iterations, a touch of contrast is given by magnetic black onyx eyes, while a full pavé white gold necklace completes the bags. From design to craftsmanship, the one-of-a-kind creations required about 9 months to be completed.

While the Serpenti creations embody the perpetual cycle of nature, the Monete High Jewelry bags represent an ode to Bvlgari’s Roman heritage and perpetual evolution of style. One made of Fuji Crocodile, the other in Midnight Plum Shiny Crocodile, the two Aeterna Monete one-of-a-kind bags pay homage to Bvlgari’s cultural legacy with a unique clasp featuring an ancient coin, “moneta” in Italian. Nestled into a hexagonal 18 carats yellow gold setting embellished with pavé diamonds, the silver coin dates back to 225-214 BC and depicts the profile of the Roman God Janus on one side, and a “Quadriga” chariot with the writing Roma in capital letters on the other. The clasp can be easily detached - and interchanged with an alternative element in 18 carats yellow gold and pavé diamonds. It can be transformed into a pendant, once attached to the 18 carats yellow gold necklace provided with the bag.

##### VERY HIGH-END FRAGRANCES

As master of gems of nature, creator of wonder and relentless innovator, Bvlgari infuses the same attention to preciousness and magnificence also to its fragrances by unveiling two one-of-a-kind gems, Aeterna Serpenti Fiamma and Aeterna Serpenti Anima; a fusion between the rarest exquisite olfactive ingredients and the most exceptional High Jewelry materials.

Born out of the expert hands of Murano artisans, the flacons embody the venetian tradition of glass art. The scales of Bvlgari icon Serpenti are incorporated in the bottle’s gold cage adornment, while, for the first time, a majestic Serpenti head is set on top of the cap. The Aeterna Serpenti Fiamma features rubellites, onyx and chrysoprase gemstones and diamonds, while the Aeterna Serpenti Anima presents tanzanite, onyx and turquoise gemstones and diamonds. The Serpenti heads turn into a transformable piece of jewelry to become a unique necklace.

Created by Master Perfumer Yann Vasnier the fragrance is shaped around three sumptuous olfactive raw materials expressing the eternal renewal of Rome and Serpenti with unexpected contrasts: Jasmine Sambac absolute, essences of Magnolia Champaca and Sandalwood, blended together to create a noble floral woody signature.

Bvlgari (the Roman jeweler) unveiled "Aeterna," its most extraordinary High-End collection ever, in celebration of the Maison's 140th anniversary. The collection was revealed in Rome at the Terme di Diocleziano, marking the first major private event at this ancient architectural complex, made possible through cooperation between the Italian Culture Ministry and Fondazione Bvlgari. Published by Luxferity on May 27, 2024.

The collection consists of over 500 masterpieces spanning High Jewelry, High Jewelry Watches, High-End Bags, and Fragrances.

**Centerpiece: Serpenti Aeterna Necklace** — The most precious diamond High Jewelry piece ever crafted by Bvlgari. A rough diamond of over 200 carats was cut to create seven D-flawless pear diamond drops totaling 140 carats (one for each year of the brand's history), set in a platinum wave structure embellished with 698 baguette diamonds weighing 61.81 carats. The necklace required over 2,800 hours to complete.

**Key High Jewelry pieces** include: Sapphire Aeterna Waves (38.93-carat Sri Lanka cushion sapphire necklace); Sapphire Brocade necklace (13 cushion sapphires, 63.48 carats of sapphires, with buff-top emeralds); Aurea Chandra (spherical choker revisiting the 1980s' Chandra Line); Tubogas Flower of Time (31.07-carat Zambian emerald necklace); Bvlgari Lotus Cabochon (rubellite, turquoise, emerald, amethyst cabochons); Earth Song (345.68 carats of colorful gems); Serpenti Chiseled necklace (77.78-carat pear rubellite suspended from snake's mouth); Serpenti Sapphire Echo (two 37.34-carat pear-cut Sri Lanka sapphires from 1930s Bvlgari earrings); Mosaic of Time (150 modules, Paraiba tourmalines, 100+ carats of gems); Monete Aeterna Augustus Emerald (615.04 carats of emerald beads with an ancient Tiberius-era coin featuring Augustus); Sequence of Eternity earrings (two Mozambican oval rubies of 8.92 and 8.06 carats).

**High Jewelry Watches**: Fuochi D'Artificio collection (equipped with Bvlgari Piccolissimo, the smallest micro mechanical movement in the world; the High Jewelry Manchette required 1,450+ hours); Fenice High Jewelry Watch (over 3,000 hours, featuring a 9.78-carat Paraiba tourmaline and 160+ carats of colored stones, inspired by Bernini's altarpiece).

**High-End Bags**: 16 one-of-a-kind pieces made from alligator and crocodile, including the Aeterna Serpenti Pallini bag (two interchangeable heads, ~9 months to craft) and two Aeterna Monete bags with a silver coin from 225-214 BC depicting the Roman God Janus and a Quadriga chariot.

**Fragrances**: Two one-of-a-kind gems — Aeterna Serpenti Fiamma (rubellites, onyx, chrysoprase) and Aeterna Serpenti Anima (tanzanite, onyx, turquoise), featuring Murano glass flacons and transformable Serpenti heads. Created by Master Perfumer Yann Vasnier around Jasmine Sambac, Magnolia Champaca, and Sandalwood.

Key figures quoted: Jean-Christophe Babin (CEO, Bvlgari Group), Paolo Bulgari (President, Bvlgari Group), Lucia Silvestri (Jewelry Creative Director), and Fabrizio Buonamassa Stigliani (Watch Division Creative Director).
args.key_excerpts:
"I'm extremely proud of my creative teams led by Lucia Silvestri and Fabrizio Buonamassa Stigliani, together with our master craftsmen, for having developed the most extraordinary High-End collection ever, not only in Bvlgari unparalleled 140 years of history, but probably overall in the 21st century. Serpenti Aeterna represents the pinnacle of excellence." — Jean-Christophe Babin, CEO Bvlgari Group.

"Serpenti Aeterna necklace is a tribute to Bvlgari 140 anniversary, it is the most precious necklace we ever crafted. We wanted to create something unique in a Bvlgari way, keep challenging ourselves and surprising everyone with the decision to give diamonds the role of the protagonist." — Lucia Silvestri, Bvlgari Jewelry Creative Director.

"The Aeterna theme takes us on a journey through the codes and history of Bvlgari. It's these deeply rooted signs that make the brand even more eternal. To illustrate eternity, we decided to bring new guests on our journey. We imagined timeless mythical animals that are therefore eternal." — Fabrizio Buonamassa Stigliani, Bvlgari Watch Division Creative Director.

"As Chairman of the Board and passionate expert of extraordinary gems, I am very proud and happy to see that 140 years after my Grand Father created his small workshop, Bvlgari today sparkles over the planet and creates and crafts the most desirable masterpieces of High Jewelry and Jewelry Watches of our times." — Paolo Bulgari, President of the Bvlgari Group.
